analyzed: tena ca śrī sahita śabdasya madhyama pada lopī samāsaḥ śāka pārthiṃva ādeḥ ākṛtigaṇa tvāt tad upādānam ca sa śaktikasya eva bhagavataḥ jagat nirmāṇa kāraṇa tvam iti dhvayitum naimi iti stutau iti dhātoḥ asmat śabda aprayoge api gamyamāna tad artha sāmānādhikaraṇyasya lakāra artha karttari sattvāt varttamāna kriyā dyotaka laṭ uttama puruṣaḥ

original: utkṛṣṭaguṇavattvamevāviṣkariti yata iti vādāntimate māyāśabalasya brahmaṇo jagadupādānatvāt "janikarttuḥ" ityupādānahetāvapādānasaṃjñānibandhanā pañcamī| `guṇa' ityukteḥ "vibhāṣā" ityasya na prasaktiḥ| tathāca yasmādupādānahetorityarthaḥ| sarvaṃ jagat sphoṭarūpaṃ vivarttata iti yojanā|

original: nanu nāmarūpātmakasya "sadeva somyedamagra āsīt" iti śrutyā sanātanatvabodhanāt kathamutpattiśālitvamata āha jagaditi vartamāne pṛṣat" iti nipātanātsādhu| tathāca gacchati-tirodhatta iti vyutpattyā tirodhāna ukte yattirodhatte tadāvirbhavatīti niyamenāvirbhāvasya lābhātsa evātropasṛṣṭārthaḥ|
analyzed: nanu nāma rūpa ātmakasya sat eva somya idam agre āsīt iti śrutyā sanātana tva bodhanāt katham utpatti śāli tvam atas āha jagat iti vartamāne pṛṣat iti nipātanāt sādhu tathā ca gacchati tirodhatte iti vyutpattyā tirodhāne ukte yat tirodhatte tat āvirbhavati iti niyamena āvirbhāvasya lābhāt saḥ eva atra upasṛṣṭa arthaḥ

analyzed: evam ca ja sattvena etasya sanātana tve pi nāma tva ādinā āvirbhava ādi abhyupagamān na ukta śruti virodhaḥ nā api tasmāt etasmāt vā ātmataḥ ākāśaḥ sambhūtaḥ ityādi utpatti bodhaka tad virodhaḥ yat kiñcid nāma rūpa ātmakasya anyatas api sambhavāt āha sarvam iti yāvadarthakam utpattiḥ upalakṣaṇam avana ādeḥ tena jagatkartṛ tva ādi rūpa utkṛṣṭa dharmasya stutyatā avacchedakasya lābhaḥ

original: atra ca "yato vā imāni bhūtāni jāyante yena jātāni jīvanti yat prayantyabhisaṃviśanti" ityādyāḥ śrutayaḥ pramāṇam|
analyzed: atra ca yatas vai imāni bhūtāni jāyante yena jātāni jīvanti yat prayanti abhisaṃviśanti ityādyāḥ śrutayaḥ pramāṇam

original: matāntare yata iti pañcamī nimittahetutāyām| vyupasṛṣṭatudhātorādyakṣaṇasambandharūpotpattirarthaḥ| nanu sarvāntargataviyadādyātmakapadārthasyānāditayā sathamutpattimattvamata āha jagaditi sthāvara-jaṅgamātmakamityarthaḥ| tathāca gacchati-naśyatīti vyutpattyā vināśitve bodhite vināśibhāvasya janyatvaniyameva tasyotpattirna viruddheti bhāvaḥ|

original: tadupapādayanneva stutyatā'vacchedakāntaramapi darśayati yata iti yasmādupādānāditi sārvavibhiktikartāsanā yasminnadhiṣṭhāne iti vā'rthaḥ| vivarttaścātāttviko'nyathābhāvaḥ| aparityaktapūrvarūpasya rūpāntaraprakārakapratītiviṣayatvamitiyāvat| jagacchabdaśca rūḍhayā nāmarūpaparaḥ|
analyzed: tat upapādayan eva stutya tā avacchedaka antaram api darśayati yatas iti yasmāt upādānāt iti sārvavibhikti kartā āsanā yasmin adhiṣṭhāne iti vā arthaḥ vivarttaḥ ca atāttvikaḥ nyathābhāvaḥ aparityakta pūrva rūpasya rūpa antara prakāraka pratīti viṣaya tvam iti yāvat jagat śabdaḥ ca rūḍhayā nāma rūpa paraḥ

original: tathāca yasminnadhiṣṭhāne etatsarvaṃ jagad bhūtendriyādi tattadrūpeṇa pratibhātityarthaḥ| "neha nānā'sti" iti śrutyā bodhitabādhasyāpi jagataḥ pratibhāse adhiṣṭhānasattāyā eva niyāmakatvāt samastārthaprakāśakatvopapattirapracyutasvarūpasyaiva vrahmaṇo jagadrūpeṇa vivarttanādavikāritvarūpotkṛṣṭadharmāvagatiśca|
analyzed: tathā ca yasmin adhiṣṭhāne etat sarvam jagat bhūta indriya ādi tat tad rūpeṇa pratibhāti iti arthaḥ na iha nānā asti iti śrutyā bodhita bādhasya api jagataḥ pratibhāse adhiṣṭhāna sattāyāḥ eva niyāmaka tvāt samasta artha prakāśaka tva upapattiḥ apracyuta svarūpasya eva vrahmaṇaḥ jagat rūpeṇa vivarttanāt avikāri tva rūpa utkṛṣṭa dharma avagatiḥ ca

original: atra ca "tameva bhāntamanubhāti sarvam" ityādyaḥ kūṭasthasvarūpapratipādikāśca śrutayaḥ pramāṇatvenānusandheyā iti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: atra ca tam eva bhāntam anubhāti sarvam iti ādyaḥ kūṭastha svarūpa pratipādikāḥ ca śrutayaḥ pramāṇa tvena anusandheyāḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: atra bhagavadviṣayakaratibhāvasya hetvalaṅkāro'ṅgam jagadupādānatvena stutvā apavargasādhanajñānaviṣayatvenaitacchāstravyākhyātṛśeṣabhūṣaṇatvena ca stuvaccheṣoktasamāstasiddhāntapratipattaye prārthayate aśeṣeti phalaṃ pravṛttyuddeśyam svargādiyatkiñcit‌phaladātṛtvasya devatāntarasādhāraṇyādāha-aśeṣeti tathācāpavargarūpaphalasyāpyaśeṣapadena

original: kukṣīkṛtatvāt taddātṛtvasyānanyasādhasṇyāt prārthyatā'vacchedakadharmalābhaḥ| tadeva viśadayati bhavābdhīti bhava evabdhiriti rūpakam, abdhīyagrāhādisadṛśakāmalobhādyākrāntatvād duravagāhatvena bhave tadāropaḥ| tena ca bhavasya dustaratvaṃ vyajyate| tasya taraṇaṃ pāradeśaprāptistasminnityarthaḥ tarim sādhanam|
analyzed: kukṣīkṛta tvāt tad dātṛ tvasya ananya sādhasṇyāt prārthya tā avacchedaka dharma lābhaḥ tat eva viśadayati bhava abdhi iti bhavaḥ eva abdhiḥ iti rūpakam abdhīya grāha ādi sadṛśa kāma lobha ādi ākrānta tvāt duravagāha tvena bhave tad āropaḥ tena ca bhavasya dustara tvam vyajyate tasya taraṇam pāradeśa prāptiḥ tasmin iti arthaḥ tarim sādhanam

original: yadyapi tarantyanayā iti vyutpattyā taraṇasādhanaṃ taripadārthastathā'pi tadaghaṭakībhūtataraṇasya sannihitapadenaiva lābhād dviruktirmā bhūditi viśeṣyamātraparatayā vyākhyātam| suktisādhanajñānaviṣayamiti yāvat| muktuśca vedāntimate'jñānanivṛttisamakālāsvarūpaprāptiḥ|
analyzed: yadi api taranti anayā iti vyutpattyā taraṇa sādhanam tari padārthaḥ tathā api tad aghaṭakībhūta taraṇasya sannihita padena eva lābhāt dviruktiḥ mā bhūt iti viśeṣya mātra para tayā vyākhyātam sukti sādhana jñāna viṣayam iti yāvat muktuḥ ca vedānti mate jñāna nivṛtti sama kāla asvarūpa prāptiḥ

original: nanvajñānanivṛtteradhikaraṇānatiriktāyāḥ svarūpasyāpi ca siddhatvāttadrūpāyāstasyāstattvājñānasādhyatvānupapattiriti cenna, pareṣāṃ prāgabhāvasyeva siddhāya evājñānanivṛtteryogakṣemasādhāraṇyāḥ sādhyatāyāḥ sambhavāt| adhikamanyato'vadheyam|
analyzed: nanu ajñāna nivṛtteḥ adhikaraṇa anatiriktāyāḥ svarūpasya api ca siddhatvāt tad rūpāyāḥ tasyāḥ tattva ajñāna sādhya tva anupapattiḥ iti ced na pareṣām prāgabhāvasya iva siddhāya eva ajñāna nivṛtteḥ yogakṣema sādhāraṇyāḥ sādhyatāyāḥ sambhavāt adhikam anyatas vadheyam

original: naiyāyikāstu-ātyantikaduḥkhadhvaṃso mokṣaḥ| dhvaṃse ātyantikatvañca-svasamānādhikaraṇaduḥkhāsāmānakālikatvam| atraiva tattvajñānasyopayogaḥ| viśeṣyāṃśasya svāsādhāraṇasāmagrayā eva sambhavānnityasukhābhivyaktirvā sa ityāhuḥ|
analyzed: naiyāyikāḥ tu ātyantika duḥkha dhvaṃsaḥ mokṣaḥ dhvaṃse ātyantika tvam ca sva samāna adhikaraṇa duḥkha asāmānakālika tvam atra eva tattva jñānasya upayogaḥ viśeṣya aṃśasya sva asādhāraṇa sāmagrayā eva sambhavāt nitya sukha abhivyaktiḥ vā saḥ iti āhuḥ

original: śeṣaśeṣeti karmadhārayottarapadaḥ ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣaḥ| tasya ca lābhapadena samāso lābhāyedamiti vigrahe caturthyantalābhapadasyārthapadena saḥ| śeṣaḥ-patañjaliḥ,śeṣāṃśatvāttasya| tathāca śeṣoktabhāṣyapratipāditanikhilasiddhāntajñānāyetyarthaḥ| śeṣabhūṣaṇamiti śeṣo'nantaḥ, sa bhūṣaṇaṃ yasyetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: śeṣa śeṣa iti karmadhāraya uttara padaḥ ṣaṣṭhī tatpuruṣaḥ tasya ca lābha padena samāsaḥ lābhāya idam iti vigrahe caturthī anta lābha padasya artha padena saḥ śeṣaḥ patañjaliḥ śeṣa aṃśa tvāt tasya tathā ca śeṣa ukta bhāṣya pratipādita nikhila siddhānta jñānāya iti arthaḥ śeṣa bhūṣaṇam iti śeṣaḥ ūnantaḥ sa bhūṣaṇam yasya iti arthaḥ

original: evāprāmāṇikatvenaikārthaparataiva nyāyyeti bhāvaḥ| nanvākhyātasya vyāpārāvācakatve kathaṃ tatastad‌bodho'ta āha bhāvanāyā iti| kṛdādivaditi `tatra tasyeva' iti vatiḥ, kṛdādisthale ivetyarthaḥ| ādipadāt karttavihitataddhita ityādeḥ parigrahaḥ|

original: śaktigrāhakeṣu parigaṇitādvivaraṇādbhāvanāvācakatvamākhyātasyā''pyāsyatītyāśaṅkate bhāvanāyā iti vivaraṇeti tatsamānā'rthakapadā'ntareṇa tadarthakathanasya vivaraṇatayā prakṛte pacatītyasya pākabhāvanetyākhyātasya bhāvanāpadena vivaraṇāttasya bhāvanāvācakatvamityarthaḥ|

original: vivaraṇasya svasvabodhānusāritayā na tenā'rthanirṇaya ityāha pākā'nukūleti pacatītyasyaikakarttṛkā pacikriyeti kartturvivaraṇasyā'pi darśanenā'khyātasya bhāvanāyāṃ śaktiruta karttarītyatra vinigamakā'bhāvāditi bhāvaḥ| itaretarayogadvandva iti samāhāradvandve uttarapadalakṣyā'rthasamāhārasya caśabdena vivaraṇāduktamitaretareti|

original: tatra sāhityasya dvitvā''dyatiriktasyā'nanubhavāttasya dvivacanādinaivopasthiterna tatra samāsaghaṭakapratyekapadavṛttiḥ| tasyaiva cena vivaraṇamiti matā'ntarantu vakṣyate| tulyatvāditi bhāvanāpadenā''khyātasya vivaraṇamapyapadārthavivaraṇamityasyāpi vaktuṃ śakyatvādityarthaḥ| svasvabodhā'nusārivivaraṇasya nā'rthanirṇāyakatvamityapyubhayoḥ|

original: samānamiti bhāvaḥ|

analyzed: iti abhiyukta ukteḥ śābdabodhe praṅnirdiṣṭasya eva uddeśya tayā vivakṣita artha alābhāt atas eva vṛddhi śabdasya prāṅnirddeśaḥ maṅgala arthaḥ iti ākara uktam saṅgacchate evam agre api ākhyāta tva avacchinne pradhāna bhāva artha pratipādaka tva rūpa lakṣaṇa tātparya avadhāraṇāt ca lakṣaṇa vākyāt śabda maryādayā prakṛta pada dvaya artha abhedasya adhikasya bhāne api na kṣatiḥ

original: mūle phalavyāpārayostatreti| tatreti dhātūpasthāpyayorityarthaḥ| `phalavyāpārayoḥ' iti nirddhāraṇe saptamītyāśayena vyācaṣṭe sāre phala iti| vyabhicāra iti| yagādīnāmanvaye, śabādīnāṃ vyatireke cetyarthaḥ| yagādisattve'pi phale āśrayā'nvayā'bodhācchabādyabhāve'pi vyāpāre tiṅartha āśrayānvayāt tadevopapādayati karmaṇaḥ karttṛtvavivakṣāyāmityādi|
analyzed: mūle phala vyāpārayoḥ tatra iti tatra iti dhātu upasthāpyayoḥ iti arthaḥ phala vyāpārayoḥ iti nirddhāraṇe saptamī iti āśayena vyācaṣṭe sāre phale iti vyabhicāre iti yak ādīnām anvaye śap ādīnām vyatireke ca iti arthaḥ yak ādi sattve api phale āśraya anvaya ābodhāt śap ādi abhāve pi vyāpāre tiṅ arthe āśraya anvayāt tat eva upapādayati karmaṇaḥ karttṛ tva vivakṣāyām ityādi

original: saukaryyātiśayadyotanārthā ca tadvivakṣā taṇḍulādigatāgnisaṃyogādirūpavyāpārasyaiva phalajanakatayā dhātvarthatvavivakṣāyāmisyarthaḥ|

analyzed: vastutas tu phalasya api janaka vyāpāra gata paurvāparyya āropeṇa vyāpāra tvena bhānāt iti pūrvam ukta tvāt taṇḍula gata phalasya eva vyāpāra tvena vivakṣāyām iti arthaḥ sādhanāt iti tathā ca vyābhicārāt na taṅ ādīnām dyotaka tā iti bhāvaḥ

original: kramādityāditi| karmakarttṛviṣayādāviti mūlasthādipadenetyarthaḥ sāmānyetyādikramādityasya vivaraṇam, saviṣayadhātvarthanirūpitakarmatvasya viṣayatve paryyavasānamityabhipretyāha viṣayaketi| sakarmakadhātusamabhivyāhṛtayagādīnāṃ karmadyotakatvādāha sakarmaketi pacyate taṇḍulaḥ svayamevetyādau yagādi tu na tathā, kintvātideśikam|
analyzed: kramāt ityāt iti karma karttṛ viṣaya ādau iti mūla stha ādi padena iti arthaḥ sāmānya ityādi kramāt ityasya vivaraṇam sa viṣaya dhātvartha nirūpita karmatvasya viṣaya tve paryyavasānam iti abhipretya āha viṣayaka iti sakarmaka dhātu samabhivyāhṛta yak ādīnām karma dyotaka tvāt āha sa karmaka iti pacyate taṇḍulaḥ svayam eva ityādau yak ādi tu na tathā kintu ātideśikam

original: `karmavatkarmaṇā' iti vihitātideśatvasyā''kare siddhāntitatvānna tatra vyabhicāra iti bhāvaḥ| bhāvasādhāraṇeti| bhāvakarmaṇoḥ sārvadhātuke yagityādivihitetyarthaḥ| tena, `dīpajana' ityādivihitvyāvṛttiḥ|| evamiti uktaprakāreṇetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: karmavat karmaṇā iti vihita atideśa tvasya ākare siddhāntita tvāt na tatra vyabhicāraḥ iti bhāvaḥ bhāva sādhāraṇā iti bhāva karmaṇoḥ sārvadhātuke yak ityādi vihitā iti arthaḥ tena dīpa janaḥ ityādi vihitvī āvṛttiḥ evam iti ukta prakāreṇa iti arthaḥ

original: nanu phalavyāpārayorityanena sāmānyato dhātoḥ phalavyāpāravācakatva pratījñātasyottarakṣaṇe evopapattibhistad‌vyavasthāpanaṃ karttumucitam, natu vākyārthanirūpaṇānantaram, tena jijñāsāvicchedādityāśaṅkāyāmāha sūcīkaṭāhanyāyeneti|
analyzed: nanu phala vyāpārayoḥ iti anena sāmānyatas dhātoḥ phala vyāpāra vācaka tva pratījñātasya uttara kṣaṇe eva upapattibhiḥ tad vyavasthāpanam karttum ucitam na tu vākya artha nirūpaṇa anantaram tena jijñāsā vicchedāt iti āśaṅkāyām āha sūcī kaṭāha nyāyena iti

original: tathāca sāmānyataḥ phalavyāpārayordhātvarthatve, āśrayasya tiṅarthatve ca jñāte, nidṛsanīyavādavipratipattikatvena supratipādyatayā ca prathamaṃ vākyārthe eva śiṣyajījñāsitatvāditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca sāmānyatas phala vyāpārayoḥ dhātvartha tve āśrayasya tiṅ artha tve ca jñāte supratipādya tayā ca prathamam vākya arthe eva śiṣya jījñāsita tvāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: `laḍādyante' ityatad‌guṇasaṃvijñānabahuvrīhiṇā dhātuparam| tathāca, yajeta, pacetetyādau yajyādidhātāvityarthaḥ| avācyatvam vācyatānirūpakatvā'vā'bhāvam| `prabhākaradīn' ityādinā naiyāyikasaṃgrahaḥ|
analyzed: laṭ ādi ante iti a tad guṇa saṃvijñāna bahuvrīhiṇā dhātu param tathā ca yajeta paceta ityādau yaji ādi dhātau iti arthaḥ avācya tvam ityādinā naiyāyika saṃgrahaḥ

original: yadyapi vyāpāro dhātvarthatvena naiyāyikasammatastathāpi nā'sau tanmate bhāvanāpadavyapadeśya iti bhāvaḥ| `vyāparo bhāvanā saiva' ityādipūrvārddhasya yo `guṇabhūtairavayavaiḥ' ityādyuktalakṣaṇalakṣito'rthastadvācakavyāpārapadaṃ bhāvanādipadaivivriyate| vivriyamāṇasya vivaramasamānārthakatvena dhātorbhāvanāvācakatvasiddhirityarthaḥ|
analyzed: yadi api vyāpāraḥ dhātvartha tvena naiyāyika sammataḥ tathā api na asau tad mate bhāvanā pada vyapadeśyaḥ iti bhāvaḥ vyāparaḥ bhāvanā sā eva ityādi pūrva arddhasya yaḥ guṇa bhūtaiḥ avayavaiḥ ityādi ukta lakṣaṇa lakṣita ūrthaḥ tad vācaka vyāpāra padam bhāvanā ādi padaiḥ vivriyate vivriyamāṇasya vivaram asamāna arthaka tvena dhātoḥ bhāvanā vācaka tva siddhiḥ iti arthaḥ

original: nanu sambhavedevaṃ dhātorvyāpārārthakatve, tatra ca kiṃ mānamityāśaṅkakṣa kṛñā dhātuvivaraṇe mānaṃ darśayati sāre pacati pākamutpādayatīti nanu `yā kriyā bhāvanā saivotpādanā'pi ca sā smṛtā' ityukte'pi kriyāyā bhāvanātvalābhe kimiti vyāpārapadopādānamata āha-vyāpārapadañceti tathāca vyāpriyate'neneti karaṇavyutpannena, bhāvavyutpannena vā
analyzed: nanu sambhavet evam dhātoḥ vyāpāra arthaka tve tatra ca kim mānam iti āśaṅkakṣa dhātu vivaraṇe mānam darśayati sāre pacati pākam utpādayati iti nanu yā kriyā bhāvanā sā eva utpādanā api ca sā smṛtā iti ukte api kriyāyāḥ bhāvanā tva lābhe kim iti vyāpāra pada upādānam atas āha vyāpāra padam ca iti tathāca vyāpriyate enena iti karaṇa vyutpannena bhāva vyutpannena vā

original: vyāpārapadena phalānukūlayāvatāmadhiśrayaṇādīnāṃ bhāvanātvalābhāya tadupādānam| kriyāpadena tu kṛtipadavadyatnamātrārthakatvasyāpi sambhavena tanmātrasyaiva tadvivaraṇena bhāvanātvalābhaḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: vyāpāra padena phala anukūla yāvatām adhiśrayaṇa ādīnām bhāvanā tva lābhāya tad upādānam kriyā padena tu kṛti pada vat yatna mātra arthaka tvasya api sambhavena tad mātrasya eva tad vivaraṇena bhāvanā tva lābhaḥ syāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: ata eveti tattadrūpeṇa phūtkāravādīnāṃ dhātuvācyatvādevetyarthaḥ| sarvasiddha iti| ata eva pacatītyukte phūtkārādimānna veti sandehānudayāditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: atas eva iti tad tad rūpeṇa phūtkāra vādīnām dhātu vācya tvāt eva iti arthaḥ sarva siddhaḥ iti atas eva pacati iti ukte phūtkāra ādimān na vā iti sandeha anudayāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: yadrityāṃ naiyāyikairvyāpāratvasyākhyātavācyatāvacchedakatvaṃ nirasya kṛtitvasya tad‌vyavasthāpitaṃ tadrītyaiva dhātoḥ kṛtitvamātraṃ śakyatā'vacchedakaṃ bhavivyatīti taṭasthā''śaṅkāṃ nirākaroti nacaiva meṣāmityādi `naca' iti sādhvītyanenānvitam|
analyzed: naiyāyikaiḥ vyāpāra tvasya ākhyāta vācya tā avacchedaka tvam nirasya kṛti tvasya tat vyavasthāpitam tad rītyā eva dhātoḥ kṛti tva mātram śakyatā avacchedakam bhavivyati iti taṭastha āśaṅkām nirākaroti na ca eva meṣām ityādi na ca iti sādhvī iti anena anvitam

original: eṣām adhiśrayaṇatvādīnām| gauraveti dhātuvācyatvāvacchedakatve gauravāpattyetyarthaḥ| teṣāṃ kṛtitvāpekṣayā gurutvānnānātvācceti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: eṣām adhiśrayaṇa tva ādīnām gaurava iti dhātu vācya tva avacchedaka tve gaurava āpattyā iti arthaḥ teṣām kṛti tva apekṣayā guru tvāt nānātvāt ca iti bhāvaḥ

original: tadavacchedakamiti dhātuvācyatā'vacchedakamityarthaḥ| nanu kṛtereva dhātvarthatve rathādāvacenate tad‌bādhāttādṛśaprayogānupapattirata āha ratho gacchatītyādi vyāpārādityādinā''śrayatva-pratiyogitvaparigrahaḥ| jānātītyādāvityādipadagrāhye ghaṭo naśyatītyādau nāśāśrayatvasya bādhātpratiyogitve eva lakṣaṇāyā draṣṭavyatvāt|
analyzed: tad avacchedakam iti dhātu vācyatā avacchedakam iti arthaḥ nanu kṛteḥ eva dhātvartha tve ratha ādau tad bādhāt tādṛśa prayoga anupapattiḥ atas āha rathaḥ gacchati ityādi vyāpārāt iti ādinā āśrayatva pratiyogitva parigrahaḥ jānāti ityādau iti ādi pada grāhye ghaṭaḥ naśyati ityādau nāśa āśraya tvasya bādhāt pratiyogitve eva lakṣaṇāyāḥ draṣṭavya tvāt

original: naiyāyikarītiriti ākhyātārthavicāre hi tairvyāpāre lakṣaṇām, kṛtau ca śaktiṃ svīkṛtyā'yaṃ prayoṃgaḥ samarthirastadvanmayā'pi samarthanīya iti sādṛśyāt rītipadopādānam, na tvanyāṃ'śe tanmatādara iti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: naiyāyika rītiḥ iti ākhyāta artha vicāre hi taiḥ vyāpāre lakṣaṇām kṛtau ca śaktim svīkṛtya ayam prayoṃgaḥ tadvat mayā api samarthanīyaḥ iti sādṛśyāt rīti pada upādānam na tu anya aṃśe tanmata ādaraḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: lāghavopaṣṭhabdhamānādevā'rthasiddha rna kevalāllāghavādityāśayena mīmāṃsakarītyā tadrīterevā'sādhutvamāviṣkaroti śakyatā'vacchedakatvasyeti tathāca asati bādhake śaktirguruṇā'pi dharmeṇāvacchidyate, kṛtitvāllakṣaṇāvadityanumānātteṣu śaktiḥ setsyatīti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: lāghava upaṣṭhabdha mānāt eva artha siddhaḥ na kevalāt lāghavāt iti āśayena mīmāṃsaka rītyā tad rīteḥ eva asādhu tvam āviṣkaroti śakyatā avacchedaka tvasya iti tathāca asati bādhake śaktiḥ guruṇā api dharmeṇa avacchidyate kṛti tvāt lakṣaṇā vat iti anumānāt teṣu śaktiḥ setsyati iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu teṣāṃ kṛtītvā'pekṣayā gurutvameva bādhakamata āha tayoriti śakyatāvacchedakatva lakṣyatāvacchedakatvayorityarthaḥ| bījābhāvāditi sambhavati samaniyate laghau dharme gurau tadabhāvādityasya prakṛte'navatāreṇa yadyavacchedakatvaṃ svarūpasambandhaviśeṣastadā tatsvarūpatvasya gurūṇāmapi sattvātkimanupapannam|
analyzed: nanu teṣām kṛtī tva apekṣayā guru tvam eva bādhakam atas āha tayoḥ iti śakyatā avacchedaka tva lakṣyatā avacchedaka tvayoḥ iti arthaḥ bīja abhāvāt iti sambhavati sama niyate laghau dharme gurau tad abhāvāt iti asya prakṛtena avatāreṇa yadi avacchedaka tvam svarūpa sambandha viśeṣaḥ tadā tad svarūpa tvasya gurūṇām api sattvāt kim anupapannam

original: athātiriktaṃ tadā gurudharme'pi tatsvīkāra āvaśyakaḥ| gaṅgātīratvaṃ lakṣyatā'vacchedakamiti vyavahārāt, vṛttyavacchedakakoṭipraviṣṭatvasyobhayatra samyācca| tatra nyūnā'tiriktavṛttitvarūpā'vacchedakatvamādāya tādṛśavyavahāro yadi, tadā sarvatraiva tathāstviti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: atha atiriktam tadā guru dharme pi tad svīkāraḥ āvaśyakaḥ gaṅgā tīra tvam lakṣya tā avacchedakam iti vyavahārāt vṛtti avacchedaka koṭi praviṣṭa tvasya ubhayatra samyāt ca tatra nyūna atirikta vṛtti tva rūpa avacchedaka tvam ādāya tādṛśa vyavahāraḥ yadi tadā sarvatra eva tathā astu iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu lāghavādeva na tasyā'vacchedakatvaṃ vadāmaḥ, kintu mānādapītyāśaṅkate naceti yatnārthakakarotinetyuktayā vyāpārajanyatvapratisandhānā'viśeṣe'pi ghaṭāṅkurayoḥ kṛtā'kṛtavyavahārātkṛño yatnārthakatvaṃ siddhameveti dhvanayati vivaraṇāditi tadarthapratipādakapadakathanarūpādityarthaḥ|

original: atra grāmaṃ gacchatītyādau dvitīyā'rthasaṃyogādirūpaphalā'nvayitvasyaiva vinigamakatvād gamanakriyāyāṃ saṃyogasyaivopalakṣaṇatvamityasya suvacatayā'nyatra lakṣaṇayopapatteśca noktarītiḥ sādhvītyasvaraso'pi vadantibhyāṃ sūcitaḥ| upasaṃharati-tasmāditi uktayuktisaṅgaterityarthaḥ|

original: nirvivādameveti svārthaphalasamānā'dhikaraṇavyāpāravācakatvarūpā'karmakatvasya dhātoḥ phalavācakatvaṃ vinā'nupapannatvāditi bhāvaḥ| nanu sakarmakatvaṃ pūrvoktameva, tadbhinnadhātutvaṃ cā'karmakatvamiti noktā'nupapattirata āha- bhū sattāyāmiti gaṇeṣu phalasyaiva nirddeśāditi bhāvaḥ| ata eveti dhātumātrasya palavācakatvādevetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: nirvivādam eva iti svārtha phala samāna adhikaraṇa vyāpāra vācakatva rūpa akarmakatvasya dhātoḥ phala vācakatvam vinā anupapannatvāt iti bhāvaḥ nanu sakarmaka tvam pūrvoktam eva tad bhinna dhātu tvam ca akarmakatvam iti na ukta anupapattiḥ atas āha bhū sattāyām iti gaṇeṣu phalasya eva nirddeśāt iti bhāvaḥ atas eva iti dhātu mātrasya pala vācakatvāt eva iti arthaḥ

original: dvyartha iti dvyarthapadaṃ phalavyāpārobhayārthakamityāśayaḥ| nanu `dvyarthaḥ paciḥ' iti bhāṣyaṃ pacerupādānātsakarmakāṇāṃ phalārthakatve sādhakamastu, na tvakarmakāṇāmata āha-digiti tathā sati sattādyarthanirddeśavaiyarthyā''patteḥ|
analyzed: dvi arthaḥ iti dvi artha padam phala vyāpāra ubhaya arthakam iti āśayaḥ nanu dvi arthaḥ paciḥ iti bhāṣyam paceḥ upādānāt sakarmakāṇām phala arthaka tve sādhakam astu na tu akarmakāṇām atas āha diś iti tathā sati sattā ādi artha nirddeśa vaiyarthya āpatteḥ

original: dhātusāmānyaśaktyā pacyāderiva bhavatyāderapi vyāpārabodhasambhavāditi digartho'vaseyaḥ nanu `vyāpāro bhāvanā saiva' ityuktavivaraṇena na vyāpārasya dhātvarthatānirṇayaḥ, pacati-pākaṃ karotīti vivaraṇena ākhyātārthatāyā api vaktuṃ śakyatvāditi mīmāṃsakāśaṅkāsamādhānaparatayā mūlamavatārayati-evamityādinā|
analyzed: dhātu sāmānya śaktyā paci ādeḥ iva bhavati ādeḥ api vyāpāra bodha sambhavāt iti diś arthaḥ uvaseyaḥ nanu vyāpāraḥ bhāvanā sā eva iti ukta vivaraṇena na vyāpārasya dhātvartha tā nirṇayaḥ pacati pākam karoti iti vivaraṇena ākhyāta artha tāyāḥ api vaktum śakya tvāt iti mīmāṃsaka āśaṅkā samādhāna para tayā mūlam avatārayati evam ityādinā

original: vācyatvamiti tiṅantajanyabodhaviṣayatvamityarthaḥ| tathāca pākā'nukūlā bhāvanetyādivivaraṇenā'pi pacatītyasya pākā'nukūlabhāvanābodhakatvamastvityarthaḥ| yathāśrute vivaraṇena dhātorbhāvanāvācakatvanirṇaye `kintvākhyātavācyaiva sā' ityuttaragranthāsaṅgateḥ| `prakṛtipratyayau' iti nyāyasya saṃkhyādau vyabhicāramāśaṅkyāha-tadāgame hīti
analyzed: vācyatvam iti tiṅanta janya bodha viṣayatvam iti arthaḥ tathāca pāka anukūlā bhāvanā ityādi vivaraṇena api pacati ityasya pāka anukūla bhāvanā bodhaka tvam astu iti arthaḥ yathāśrute vivaraṇena dhātoḥ bhāvanā vācaka tva nirṇaye kintu ākhyāta vācyā eva sā iti uttara grantha asaṅgateḥ prakṛti pratyayau iti nyāyasya saṃkhyā ādau vyabhicāram āśaṅkya āha tad āgame hi iti

original: idaṃ ca yaḥ pradhānaṃ sa pratyayārtha iti nyāyā'kāra ityabhipretya tanmūlasūtrālocane tu yaḥ pratyayārthaḥ sa pradhānamiti nyāyākāro labhyate|
analyzed: idam ca yaḥ pradhānam sa pratyaya arthaḥ iti nyāya ākāraḥ iti abhipretya tad mūla sūtrālocane tu yaḥ pratyaya arthaḥ sa pradhānam iti nyāya ākāraḥ labhyate

original: tathāhi-`paśunā yajeta' iti śrūyate, tatraikavacanopāttamekatvaṃ yāge viśeṣaṇamuta prakṛtyarthe iti saṃśaye paśupadārthasya yāgaṃ prati guṇatvāt sambhāvitayāvatpaśukaraṇena pradhānāvṛttau pradhānabhaṅgāpattyā yāvad‌guṇapradhānā''vṛtterayogādekatvaviśiṣṭapaśorvidhāne tvekatvasya paśuviśeṣaṇatayā yāgāṅgatvā'bhāvāttadavivakṣitameva syādityarthakena
analyzed: tathā hi paśunā yajeta iti śrūyate tatra eka vacana upāttam ekatvam yāge viśeṣaṇam uta prakṛti arthe iti saṃśaye paśu padārthasya yāgam prati guṇa tvāt sambhāvita yāvat paśu karaṇena pradhāna āvṛttau pradhāna bhaṅga āpattyā yāvat guṇa pradhāna āvṛtteḥ ayogāt ekatva viśiṣṭa paśoḥ vidhāne tu ekatvasya paśu viśeṣaṇatayā yāga aṅga tva abhāvāt tat avivakṣitam eva syāt iti arthakena

original: "tatraikatvamayāgāṅgamarthasya guṇabhūtatvāt" iti sūtreṇa pūrvapakṣite, "śabdavattūpalabhyate tadāgame hi dṛśyate tasya jñānaṃ yathā'nyeṣām" iti siddhāntasūtram| śabdavat-śabdavācyam, yathā bhavati tathopalabhyate| ekatvaṃ hi yatastadāgame-ekavacanasamavadhāne dṛśyate| atastasya prādhānyena pratītiryathānyeṣāmaruṇādīnāmityarthaḥ|
analyzed: tatra eka tvam a yāga aṅgam arthasya guṇa bhūta tvāt iti sūtreṇa pūrvapakṣite śabdavat tu upalabhyate tad āgame hi dṛśyate tasya jñānam yathā anyeṣām iti siddhānta sūtram śabdavat śabda vācyam yathā bhavati tathā upalabhyate ekatvam hi yatas tad āgame eka vacana samavadhāne dṛśyate atas tasya prādhānyena pratītiḥ yathā anyeṣām aruṇa ādīnām iti arthaḥ

original: yadvā `tadāgame' tat-ekatvam, āgame-ekavacanavidhāyakāgame `dhdyekayoḥ'ityatra dṛśyate ekavacanarūpapratyayārthatvena pratīyate, anyeṣām-karaṇādīnāmivetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: yat vā tad āgame tad ekatvam āgame ekavacana vidhāyaka āgame iti atra dṛśyate ekavacana rūpa pratyaya artha tvena pratīyate anyeṣām karaṇa ādīnām iva iti arthaḥ

original: evañca samānapratyayopāttatvapratyāsattyā vibhaktyarthakaraṇā'nvitasyā'ruṇā'dhikaraṇanyāyena prathamaṃ kriyāyāmanvayaḥ, paścāt prakṛtyarthe| tathāca paśvekatvobhayakaraṇako yāga iti bodhenaikatvasya yāgāṅgatvā'vagamānnānekapaśubhiryāga iti tadbhāvaḥ|
analyzed: evam ca samāna pratyaya upātta tva pratyāsattyā vibhakti artha karaṇa anvitasya aruṇa adhikaraṇa nyāyena prathamam kriyāyām anvayaḥ paścāt prakṛti arthe tathā ca paśu ekatva ubhaya karaṇakaḥ yāgaḥ iti bodhena ekatvasya yāga aṅga tva avagamāt na aneka paśubhiḥ yāgaḥ iti tad bhāvaḥ

original: prādhānyaṃ ca prakṛtyarthā'viśeṣaṇatvameva, pratyayārthamādāya nyāyāvatārādyaḥ pratyayārtha iti bhāgasya nyāyaghaṭakatvam| prakṛte ākhyātā'samavadhāne bhāvanā'bodhāt tasyāprādhānyena bhānamiti tatsaṅgatiriti bodhyam|
analyzed: prādhānyam ca prakṛti artha a viśeṣaṇa tvam eva pratyaya artham ādāya nyāya avatāra ādyaḥ pratyaya arthaḥ iti bhāgasya nyāya ghaṭaka tvam prakṛte ākhyāta asamavadhāne bhāvanā bodhāt tasya aprādhānyena bhānam iti tad saṅgatiḥ iti bodhyam

original: nanu sakarmakatvā'nugatakartṛtvayordurvacatvamevaitanmate dūṣaṇamata āha evañceti bhāvanāyā ākhyātavācyatve cetyarthaḥ| tathācā''rabdhe pāke phalā'nutpattidaśāyāṃ pāko jāto naveti praśne, bhaviṣyatītyuttarā'nurodhāt phalamātraṃ dhātuvācyamiti mīmāṃsakāśayaḥ|
analyzed: nanu sakarmakatva anugata kartṛ tvayoḥ durvacatvam eva etad mate dūṣaṇam atas āha evam ca iti bhāvanāyāḥ ākhyāta vācyatve ca iti arthaḥ tathā ca ārabdhe pāke phala anutpatti daśāyām pākaḥ jātaḥ na vā iti praśne bhaviṣyati iti uttara anurodhāt phala mātram dhātu vācyam iti mīmāṃsaka āśayaḥ

original: prayogāpattiriti bhāvalyuḍantagamanapadārthasaṃyogātmakaphalasya grāme sattvād grāmaḥ saṃyogavānitivad grāmo gamanavāniti prayogasya prāmāṇyāpattirityarthaḥ| evamagre'pyūhyam| phalā'nutpādeti phalānutpāde tādṛśaprayogasya sarvānanumatattvāduktam vyāpārasattva iti| bhavatītyanāpattiriti pākapadārthasya viklitteravarttamānatvādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: prayoga āpattiḥ iti bhāva lyuṭ anta gamana padārtha saṃyoga ātmaka phalasya grāme sattvāt grāmaḥ saṃyogavān iti vat grāmaḥ gamanavān iti prayogasya prāmāṇya āpattiḥ iti arthaḥ evam agre api ūhyam phala anutpāda iti phala anutpāde tādṛśa prayogasya sarva ananumata ttvāt uktam vyāpāra sattve iti bhavati iti anāpattiḥ iti pāka padārthasya viklitteḥ avartamāna tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: phalotpādadaśāyāmarthā'bādhāttādṛśaprayogasyeṣṭatvādāha vidyata ityāpattiśceti vyāpāraṃśaparityāgena phalamātrasya dhātvarthatvā'bhiprāyeṇa tu bhaviṣyatītyuttaraṃ pākamutpādayatīti vivaraṇañceti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: phala utpāda daśāyām artha ābādhāt tādṛśa prayogasya iṣṭatvāt āha vidyate iti āpattiḥ ca iti vyāpāra aṃśa parityāgena phala mātrasya dhātvartha tva abhiprāyeṇa tu bhaviṣyati iti uttaram pākam utpādayati iti vivaraṇam ca iti bhāvaḥ

original: anukūleti anukūlatvotkīrttanaṃ tvanvitā'bhadhānavādināṃ matametaditi sūcayitum| nānupapattiriti bhāvavihitalyuṅghañādyarthavyāpārasya grāmādau bādhānna pūrvoktaprayogāpattirityarthaḥ| viklityanukūlaghañādyarthavyāpārasya karttṛtayā bhāvanādāvanvayānna pūrvoktaprayogā'nupapattyāpattiriti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: anukūla iti anukūla tva utkīrttanam tu anvita ābhadhāna vādinām matam etat iti sūcayitum na anupapattiḥ iti bhāva vihita lyuṅ ghañ ādi artha vyāpārasya grāma ādau bādhāt na pūrvokta prayoga āpattiḥ iti arthaḥ vikliti anukūla ghañ ādi artha vyāpārasya karttṛtayā bhāvanā ādau anvayāt na pūrvokta prayoga anupapatti āpattiḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu karttari kṛdīti vihitasya kṛtaḥ paktā pācaka ityādau kartrarthatvadarśanāttadvihitaghañādīnāṃ vyāpārā'rthatvadaurlabhyāttadarthatvabodhanāya `bhāve' ityanuśāsanaṃ cāritārthyamityāśaṅkāmapākariṣyam̐stadanuguṇaṃ dṛṣṭāntamāha kartrākhyātavaditi|
analyzed: nanu karttari kṛdi iti vihitasya kṛtaḥ paktā pācakaḥ ityādau kartṛ artha tva darśanāt tad vihita ghañ ādīnām vyāpāra artha tva daurlabhyāt tad artha tva bodhanāya bhāve iti anuśāsanam cāritārthyam iti āśaṅkām apākariṣyan tad anuguṇam dṛṣṭāntam āha kartṛ ākhyāta vat iti

original: tathāca laḥ karmaṇīti vihitakartrākhyātasya tvanmate vyāpārā'rthakatvavat, karttari kṛdīti vihitaghañādīnāmapi vyāpārā'rthakatvasambhavādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca laḥ karmaṇi iti vihita kartṛ ākhyātasya tvad mate vyāpāra arthaka tva vat karttari kṛdi iti vihita ghañ ādīnām api vyāpāra arthaka tva sambhavāt iti arthaḥ

original: virodhā''patteśceti co heto, yato vaiyarthyamatastadvirodhāpattirityarthaḥ| uktivaicitryametat| yadvā bhāva vihitapratyayānāṃ dhātvarthānuvādakatvāt prayogasādhutāmātrārthakatvamiti tvadīyasiddhāntavirodhāpatterityarthaḥ| vyākhyānamityasya vivaraṇam-vivaraṇamiti|
analyzed: virodha āpatteḥ ca iti caḥ hetoḥ yatas vaiyarthyam atas tad virodha āpattiḥ iti arthaḥ ukti vaicitryam etat yat vā bhāva vihita pratyayānām dhātvartha anuvādaka tvāt prayoga sādhutā mātra arthaka tvam iti tvadīya siddhānta virodha āpatteḥ iti arthaḥ vyākhyānam iti asya vivaraṇam vivaraṇam iti

original: atastadapīti pacatītyasya pākaṃ karototi vivaraṇamapītyarthaḥ| apinā duṣayiṣyamāṇaprakṛtipratyayāviti nyāyasamuccayaḥ| dhātoḥ pṛthagvivaraṇaṃ tu tavā''khyātārthasaṃkhyākālavyāpārāṇāṃ madhye vyāpārasya kṛñā saṃkhyādestaduttaratiṅā vivaraṇavaddhātvarthavyāpārasyā'pyupapannamiti na tadākhyātārthatvasādhakam|
analyzed: atas tat api iti pacati ityasya pākam vivaraṇam api iti arthaḥ apinā duṣayiṣyamāṇa prakṛti pratyayau iti nyāya samuccayaḥ dhātoḥ pṛthak vivaraṇam tu tava ākhyāta artha saṃkhyā kāla vyāpārāṇām madhye vyāpārasya kṛñā saṃkhyā ādeḥ tad uttara tiṅā vivaraṇa vat dhātvartha vyāpārasya api upapannam iti na tat ākhyāta artha tva sādhakam

original: ata eva "kathaṃ jñāyate kriyāvacanāḥ pacyādayaḥ yadeṣāṃ karotinā sāmānādhikaraṇyam, kiṃ karoti? pacati" iti bhūvādisūtrabhāṣye uktama| tena vivaraṇamapi dhātoreveti spaṣṭameva bodhyate iti bhāvaḥ| pakvavāniti mūlamapi karoterākhyātavivaraṇaṃtvā'bhāvasādhyatayā vyācaṣce pakvavānityādāvitī| ananvayameva viśadayati ayambhāva ityādi|
analyzed: atas eva katham jñāyate kriyā vacanāḥ paci ādayaḥ yat eṣām karotinā sāmānādhikaraṇyam kim karoti pacati iti bhūvādi sūtra bhāṣye tena vivaraṇam api dhātoḥ eva iti spaṣṭam eva bodhyate iti bhāvaḥ pakvavān iti mūlam api karoteḥ ākhyāta vivaraṇam tva abhāva sādhyatayā vyācaṣce ananvayam eva viśadayati ayam bhāvaḥ ityādi

original: sahārthamiti sambaddhārthamityarthaḥ| brūtaḥ bodhayataḥ, tayoḥ prakṛtipratyayā'rthayormadhye, pratyayā'rthaḥ pratyayavṛttigrahaviśeṣyaḥ, pradhānamiti prakṛtyarthaprakāratānirūpitaviśeṣyatāśālītyartha-.
analyzed: saha artham iti sambaddha artham iti arthaḥ brūtaḥ bodhayataḥ tayoḥ prakṛti pratyaya arthayoḥ madhye pratyaya arthaḥ pratyaya vṛtti graha viśeṣyaḥ pradhānam iti prakṛti artha prakāratā nirūpita viśeṣya tā śāli iti artha

original: tādṛśavyutpattisiddhakāryyakāraṇabhāvamabhinayena darśayati viśeṣyatayeti pratyayasya prakṛtyarthaprakāratānirūpitaviśeṣyatāsambandhena śābdabodhaṃ pratītyarthaḥ| heturityasya viśeṣyatāsambandheneti śeṣaḥ|
analyzed: tādṛśa vyutpatti siddha kāryya kāraṇa bhāvam abhinayena darśayati viśeṣyatayā iti pratyayasya prakṛti artha prakāratā nirūpita viśeṣya tā sambandhena śābda bodham prati iti arthaḥ hetuḥ iti asya viśeṣya tā sambandhena iti śeṣaḥ

original: aruṇādhikaraṇoktarītyeti aruṇayeti padopāttā''ruṇyasya prathamaṃ karaṇatvenetarakriyāyāmanvayaḥ, nāmārthā'nvayastu pārṣṭhika iti tatroktam| vakṣyamāṇeti kārakatvasya kriyājanakatvarūpatvena kriyājanakamiti jñāte, kā hā kārakā'nvayitā'vacchedakamiti subarthanirṇaye vakṣyamāṇarityetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: aruṇādhikaraṇa ukta rītyā iti aruṇayā iti pada upātta āruṇyasya prathamam karaṇa tvena itara kriyāyām anvayaḥ nāma artha anvayaḥ tu pārṣṭhikaḥ iti tatra uktam vakṣyamāṇa iti kāraka tvasya kriyā janaka tva rūpa tvena kriyā janakam iti jñāte kā hā kāraka anvayitā avacchedakam iti subarthanirṇaye vakṣyamāṇa rityā iti arthaḥ

original: sambandhamātramiti "jyotiṣṭomena yajena" ityatra yajeteti śrutyā dhātvākhyātārthayāgabhāvanayoḥ sambandhasāmānyaṃ pratipādyate| tayoḥ kriyākārakabhāvarūpasambandhiviśeṣabodhane tu nā'syāḥ śruteḥ kaścidabhidhādirūpo vyāpāraḥ, tadvācakapadā'bhāvāditi tadarthaḥ|
analyzed: sambandha mātram iti jyotiṣṭomena yajena iti atra yajeta iti śrutyā dhātu ākhyāta artha yāga bhāvanayoḥ sambandha sāmānyam pratipādyate tayoḥ kriyā kāraka bhāva rūpa sambandhi viśeṣa bodhane tu na asyāḥ śruteḥ kaścid abhidhā ādi rūpaḥ vyāpāraḥ tad vācaka pada abhāvāt iti tad arthaḥ

original: tathāca yajetetyatra yāsambandhibhāvaneti bodhaḥ, na yāgakaraṇakabhāvaneti, tadvatprakṛte pākasambandhī kartteti bodhaḥ| karmatvādinā tatsamasargakabodhe eva kriyāyā apekṣaṇādityāśaṅkiturāśyaḥ. phalasya kārakatvenā'yogyatvāttādṛśā'nvayabodho'pyasambhavaduktika ityāha yogyatāvirahāditi|

original: nanvastu asādhutetyata āhaevañceti yājñe karmaṇītyanena "nānṛtaṃ vadenānāpabhraṃśitaṃ vā" ityādiśruteḥ kratuprakaraṇe pāṭhāditaratra tatprayoge pratyavāyābhāvaṃ sūcayati| syādeveti bhāvanābodhakatvenākhyātasya sūtrakārādibhirananuśiṣṭatvāt karttṛbodhakatvenaiva tadanuśāsanāditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: nanu astu asādhu tā iti atas āha evam ca iti yājñe karmaṇi iti anena vā ityādi śruteḥ kratu prakaraṇe pāṭhāt itaratra tad prayoge pratyavāya abhāvam sūcayati syāt eva iti bhāvanā bodhaka tvena ākhyātasya sūtrakāra ādibhiḥ ananuśiṣṭa tvāt karttṛ bodhaka tvena eva tad anuśāsanāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: mīmāṃsakaḥ śaṅkate-nanviti| tvanmate vaiyākaraṇamate| nānṛtamiti darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇe hi `nānṛtaṃ vadet' iti śrūyate| tatra kimayaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ pūruṣārthaḥ| āhosvit kratvartha iti saṃśraye, vadedityākhyātāt karttṛpratītyā karttṛvācakatvanirṇayaḥ, laḥ karmaṇītyanuśāsanāttasya karttṛparatvalābhācca|
analyzed: mīmāṃsakaḥ śaṅkate nanu iti tvad mate vaiyākaraṇa mate na anṛtam iti darśa pūrṇamāsa prakaraṇe hi na anṛtam vadet iti śrūyate tatra kim ayam pratiṣedhaḥ pūruṣa arthaḥ āhosvit kratu arthaḥ iti saṃśraye vadet iti ākhyātāt karttṛ pratītyā karttṛ vācaka tva nirṇayaḥ laḥ karmaṇi iti anuśāsanāt tasya karttṛ paratva lābhāt ca

original: pratyayārthatvena vadanaṃ prati prādhānyād vadanaṃ tāvat pūruṣārtho'taḥ pratiṣedho'pi puruṣārtha-| niṣedhapratiyogitvena vadanakriyāmanuvadatā vadediti śabdena pūruṣārthatayaiva bodhanāt tādṛśasyaivānṛtavadanasyāniṣṭasādhanatāyā viparītasvabhāvabodhakanañā bodhanādanyādṛśānṛtavadanasya cānupasthitatvāt|
analyzed: pratyaya artha tvena vadanam prati prādhānyāt vadanam tāvat pūruṣa artha utaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ api puruṣa artha niṣedha pratiyogi tvena vadana kriyām anuvadatā vadet iti śabdena pūruṣa artha tayā eva bodhanāt tādṛśasya eva anṛta vadanasya aniṣṭa sādhanatāyāḥ viparīta svabhāva bodhaka nañā bodhanāt anyādṛśa anṛta vadanasya ca anupasthita tvāt

original: ata evānārabhyādhītasmārttavadananiṣedhasyāpyetadeva mūlaṃ bhavatīti lāghavām| anyathā tanmūlabhūtaḥ pūruṣārtho'nyo niṣedhaḥ kalapya iti gauravaṃ prasajyeteti pūrvapakṣe, `ananyalabhya eva śabdārthaḥ' iti nyāyādbhāvanaivākhyaptavācyā, karttā tvākhyātavācyabhāvanāyā avinābhāvādākṣepalabhya eveti na tatra tasya śaktiḥ|
analyzed: atas eva an ārabhya adhīta smārtta vadana niṣedhasya api etat eva mūlam bhavati iti lāghavām anyathā tad mūla bhūtaḥ pūruṣa arthaḥ anyaḥ niṣedhaḥ kalapyaḥ iti gauravam prasajyeta iti pūrvapakṣe ananya labhyaḥ eva śabda arthaḥ iti nyāyāt bhāvanā eva ākhyapta vācyā karttā tu ākhyāta vācya bhāvanāyāḥ avinābhāvāt ākṣepa labhyaḥ eva iti na tatra tasya śaktiḥ

original: laḥkarmmaṇītyādismṛtirapi dvayekayorityanenaikavākyatayā tatsaṅkhyāvācitvaparaiva| `pacati devadattaḥ' ityādau ca `gauḥ śuklaḥ' itivat sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ lakṣaṇayaiveti nākhyātasya karttṛvācitvamiti karttuḥ śruteranupastitatvānna pūruṣārthatā tasya, kintu prakaraṇāt kratvarthataiveti nirṇitaṃ kartradhikaraṇe|
analyzed: laḥ karmmaṇi ityādi smṛtiḥ api dvayoḥ ekayoḥ iti anena ekavākyatayā tad saṅkhyā vāci tva parā eva pacati devadattaḥ ityādau ca gauḥ śuklaḥ iti vat sāmānādhikaraṇyam lakṣaṇayā eva iti na ākhyātasya karttṛ vāci tvam iti karttuḥ śruteḥ anupastita tvāt na pūruṣa artha tā tasya kintu prakaraṇāt kratu artha tā eva iti nirṇitam kartṛ adhikaraṇe

original: tat‌sthitaṃ pūrvapakṣamanuvadati-ākhyāteneti tiṅetyarthaḥ| tacceti prakaramañceryarthaḥ| śrutivirodha iti nirapekṣasvarūpaśrutiprātikūlya ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: tat sthitam pūrvapakṣam anuvadati ākhyātena iti tiṅā iti arthaḥ tat ca iti prakara mañceḥ iti arthaḥ śruti virodhaḥ iti nirapekṣa svarūpa śruti prātikūlye iti arthaḥ

original: tathāhi-śrutyādayaḥ ṣaḍiha viniyojakāḥ| ta6 viruddhayorekatropanipāte samuccayadaurlabhyādekenāparasya bodho vaktavyaḥ| sa ca balavatā durvalasyeti kasya daurbalyamityākāṅkṣāyāṃ pāradaurbalyapratipādakam-`śrutiliṅgavākyaprakaramasthānasamākhyānāṃ samavāye pāradaurbalyam, arthaviprakarṣāt' iti sūtraṃ praṇināya maharṣirjauminiḥ|
analyzed: tathā hi śruti ādayaḥ ṣaṭ iha viniyojakāḥ viruddhayoḥ ekatra upanipāte samuccaya daurlabhyāt ekena aparasya bodhaḥ vaktavyaḥ sa ca balavatā durvalasya iti kasya daurbalyam iti ākāṅkṣāyām pāradaurbalya pratipādakam śruti liṅga vākya prakarama sthāna samākhyānām samavāye pāradaurbalyam artha viprakarṣāt iti sūtram praṇināya mahā ṛṣiḥ jauminiḥ

original: śrutyādīnāṃ paṭhitānāṃ samāvāye ekatropanipāte pāradaurbalyamiti| parameva pāram-uttarapaṭhitam| tathācaiṣāṃ madhye yadapekṣayā yatparaṃ tad‌durbalamityrathaḥ|
analyzed: śruti ādīnām paṭhitānām samāvāye ekatra upanipāte pāra daurbalyam iti param eva pāram uttara paṭhitam tathā ca eṣām madhye yad apekṣayā yat param tat durbalam iti rathaḥ

original: tatra hetumāha-arthaviprakarṣāditi-artasya-viniyojakasya liṅagādito viprakarṣāt-uttaravarttitvāt, liṅgādervilambena pūrvāpekṣayā viniyojakatvāvagateriti yāvat tatra śrutyādīnāmudāharaṇāni-nirapekṣo ravaḥ śrutiḥ| itaraprāmāṇyānadhīnaprāmaṇyakatvañca nirapekṣatvam-yathā `vrīhīnavahanti' iti|
analyzed: tatra hetum āha artha viprakarṣāt iti artasya viniyojakasya liṅaga āditaḥ viprakarṣāt uttara vartti tvāt liṅga ādeḥ vilambena pūrva apekṣayā viniyojaka tva avagateḥ iti yāvat tatra śruti ādīnām udāharaṇa ninirapekṣaḥ ravaḥ śrutiḥ itara prāmāṇya anadhīna prāmaṇyaka tvam ca nirapekṣa tvam yathā vrīhīn avahanti iti

original: atra kriyājanyaphalabhāgitvaṃ karmatvaṃ bodhayantī dvītīyā śrutiritaranirapekṣaiva vrīhīṇāmavaghātaśeṣitvaṃ pratipādayati arthaviśeṣaprakāśanasāmarthyaṃ liṅgam| yathā `barhirdevasadanaṃ dāmi' iti| atra lavanārthaprakāśakatayā lavane asya viniyogaḥ parasparākāṅkṣāvaśādekasminnarthe paryyavasannāni padāni vākyam|
analyzed: atra kriyā janya phala bhāgi tvam karma tvam bodhayantī dvītīyā śrutiḥ itara nirapekṣā eva vrīhīṇām avaghāta śeṣi tvam pratipādayati artha viśeṣa prakāśana sāmarthyam liṅgam yathā barhiḥ deva sadanam dāmi iti atra lavana artha prakāśaka tayā lavane asya viniyogaḥ paraspara ākāṅkṣā vaśāt ekasmin arthe paryyavasannāni padāni vākyam

original: yathā `devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'śivanorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām `agnaye tvā juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi' iti| atra mantraliṅgena nirvāpe prayujyamānasya samavetārthabhāgasyaikavākyatābalena devasya tvetyādibhāgasyāpi tatraiva viniyogaḥ labdhavākyabhāvānāṃ padānāṃ kāryyāntarapekṣāvaśādvākyāntareṇa sambandha ākāṅkṣāparyavasannaṃ prakaraṇam|
analyzed: yathā devasya tvā savituḥ bāhubhyām pūṣṇaḥ hastābhyām agnaye tvā juṣṭam nirvapāmi iti atra mantra liṅgena nirvāpe prayujyamānasya samaveta artha bhāgasya ekavākya tā balena devasya tvā ityādi bhāgasya api tatra eva viniyogaḥ labdha vākya bhāvānām padānām kāryya antar apekṣā vaśāt vākya antareṇa sambandhaḥ ākāṅkṣā paryavasannam prakaraṇam

original: yathā-`samidho yajati' iti| asya hi darśapūrṇamāse kathambhāvākāṅkṣāyāḥ prakaraṇapāṭhavaśāccheṣatvam sthānām-kramaḥ| sa cānekasyāmnātasya sannidhiviśeśāmnānam| yathā-dadhirasītyatrāgneyo pāṃśavagnīṣomīyayāgāḥ krameṇa paṭhitam| tatrāgneyāgnīṣomayordvayorliṅgenaiva viniyogasiddhiḥ|
analyzed: yathā samidhaḥ yajati iti asya hi darśa pūrṇamāse kathambhāva ākāṅkṣāyāḥ prakaraṇa pāṭha vaśāt śeṣa tvam sthānām kramaḥ sa ca anekasya āmnātasya sannidhi viśeśa āmnānam yathā dadhiḥ asi iti atra āgneya upāṃśu agnīṣomīya yāgāḥ krameṇa paṭhitam tatra āgneya agnīṣomayoḥ dvayoḥ liṅgena eva viniyoga siddhiḥ

original: dadhirasityatra tu na liṅgādiviniyojakam kintu yasmin pradeśe brāhmaṇa upāśuyāgavidhānaṃ tasmin pradeśe mantre'pyasya pāṭha iti kramādupāṃśuyāgānumantreṇa tasya viniyogaḥ samākhyā-yogabalam| yatā `hautramaud‌gātram' ityādi| tatra hi-hoturidaṃ hautramityādiyogabalena hautrādisamākhyātāni karmāṇi hotrādibhiranuṣṭheyānīti
analyzed: dadhiḥ asi iti atra tu na liṅga ādi viniyojakam kintu yasmin pradeśe brāhmaṇaḥ upāśuyāga vidhānam tasmin pradeśe mantre api asya pāṭhaḥ iti kramāt upāṃśuyāga anumantreṇa tasya viniyogaḥ samākhyā yoga balam yatā hautram audgātram ityādi tatra hi hotuḥ idam hautram ityādi yoga balena hautra ādi samākhyātāni karmāṇi hotṛ ādibhiḥ anuṣṭheyāni iti

original: virodhodāharaṇādi yathā-śrutilaṅgayorvirodhe śrutirbalīyasī, liṅgaṃ tu darbalam, arthaviprakarṣāt| yathā, kadācanastarīrasītyādikāyā ṝco viniyojikā śrutīḥ `aindrayā gārhapatyamupatiṣṭhate' iti indraprakāśanasāmarthyālliṅgādindropasthāpane viniyogo'syāḥ pratibhāti, anprakāśakasyānyatra viniyogāyogāt| śrutyā gārhapatyopasthāpane sa pratīyate|
analyzed: virodha udāharaṇa ādi yathā śruti laṅgayoḥ virodhe śrutiḥ balīyasī liṅgam tu darbalam artha viprakarṣāt yathā aindrayā gārhapatyam upatiṣṭhate iti indra prakāśana sāmarthyāt liṅgāt indra upasthāpane viniyogaḥ usyāḥ pratibhāti an prakāśakasya anyatra viniyoga ayogāt śrutyā gārhapatya upasthāpane sa pratīyate

original: gārhapatyamiti dvitīyā hi karmavibhaktitayā kāmapi kriyāmapekṣya prakṛtyarthasya śeṣitvaṃ bodhayati, kriyājanyeṣṭaphalabhāgitvasya tadarthatvāt| evamaindrayeti tṛtīyāprakṛtyarthasya śeṣatvam, kriyāṃ prati sādhakatamatvarūpakaraṇatvasya tadarthatvāt, tadanayorvirodhaḥ|
analyzed: gārhapatyam iti dvitīyā hi karma vibhakti tayā kām api kriyām apekṣya prakṛti arthasya śeṣitvam bodhayati kriyā janya iṣṭa phala bhāgi tvasya tad artha tvāt evam aindrayā iti tṛtīyā prakṛti arthasya śeṣatvam kriyām prati sādhakatamatva rūpa karaṇatvasya tad artha tvāt tat anayoḥ virodhaḥ

original: tatrāyaṃ pūrvapakṣaḥ-sāmārthyajñānamapekṣya śrutirviniyojikā| nahyasamarthaṃ śrutisahastramapi vinoyoktumalam, ato liṅgasya balavattvādindropasthāpane'syā viniyogaḥ| tadanurodhitayā dvitīyā saptamyarthatayā vyākhyeyā| gārhapatyasamīpe `indro'nayā upasthātavyaḥ' paryavasyatīti|
analyzed: tatra ayam pūrvapakṣaḥ sāmārthya jñānam apekṣya śrutiḥ viniyojikā na hi asamartham śruti sahastram api atas liṅgasya balavat tvāt indra upasthāpanā isyāḥ viniyogaḥ tad anurodhi tayā dvitīyā saptamī artha tayā vyākhyeyā gārhapatya samīpe indraḥ nayā upasthātavyaḥ paryavasyati iti

original: siddhāntastu-śrutiḥ svarūpasatsāmarthyamapekṣate, natu tajjñānamapi, yena liṅgaṃ balavadbhavet| tasya ca pūrvaṃ sata eva viniyogo'nyathānupapattyā jñānaṃ paścādupajāyate| liṅgantu viniyojane śrutimapekṣate| nahyanayendra upasthātavya iti liṅgāt svārasataḥ protīyate, kintvindra etādṛ-gityetāvanmātram|

analyzed: evam svaryate iti bhāṣya prayoga stha svaravat rūpa vikṛti karmaṇaḥ sannihita śabda rūpa prakṛti karma sākāṅkṣa tayā karoti artha ṇic antāt karmapratyaya upapattiḥ iti bodhyam kecid tu san ādi antasya dhātvartha upasaṅgṛhīta tvena akarmaka tve pi tad prakṛte sakarmaka tvam ādāya tasmāt karmapratyaya upapattim āhaḥ

original: nanu tathāpīṣṭāghaṭitasya bhavaduktasya kathaṃ karmalakṣaṇatvamata āha-tathāyuktamiti karmavyavahārasya dveṣodāsīnayorapyaviśiṣṭatvāttatsādhāraṇasyaiva lakṣaṇatvamucitam| icchāghaṭitasyaiva tasya lakṣaṇatve tu dveṣyādikarmaṇyavyāptiḥ syāt| tathāca tatsādhāraṇyāyedamevāśrayituṃ yuktamiti bhāvaḥ| evameveti itthamevetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: nanu tathā api iṣṭā ghaṭitasya bhavat uktasya katham karma lakṣaṇatvam atas āha tathā yuktam iti karma vyavahārasya dveṣa udāsīnayoḥ api aviśiṣṭa tvāt tad sādhāraṇasya eva lakṣaṇa tvam ucitam icchā ghaṭitasya eva tasya lakṣaṇa tve tu dveṣya ādi karmaṇi avyāptiḥ syāt tathāca tad sādhāraṇyāya idam eva āśrayitum yuktam iti bhāvaḥ evam eva iti ittham eva iti arthaḥ

original: ayamāśayaḥ- kriyājanyaphalāśrayaḥ karmeti sūtrapraṇayate yadyapīpsitānīpsitayoraviśeṣaṇa saṃjñā siddhayati, tathāpyagnermāṇavakaṃ vārayatītyādau kriyājanyaphalabhāgitveneṣṭasya māṇavakasyāpi viśeṣavihitena "vāraṇārthanām" ityanenāpādānasaṃjñā prasajjayeta| sūtrantu `hariṃ bhajati' ityādau caritārtham|

original: tatparihārāyepsitatamatvasya saṃjñākoṭau niveśe aprāptadveṣodāsīnasaṃjñāvidhānārthamuttarasūtramiti tathā bhoktamiti| nanu tathāpi pañcamyā iva na dvitīyāyā apyāśrayamātrārthakatā, kintu viśiṣsyaivetyata āha-
analyzed: tad parihārāya īpsitatama tvasya saṃjñā koṭau niveśe aprāpta dveṣa udāsīna saṃjñā vidhāna artham uttara sūtram iti tathā bhoktam iti nanu tathā api pañcamyāḥ iva na dvitīyāyāḥ api āśraya mātra arthakatā kintu viśiṣsya eva iti atas āha

original: tathāceti| āśraya eva ityevakāreṇa viśiṣṭārthasya śakyatvavyavacchedaḥ| nanvāśrayatvasya tattatsvarūpātmakasya tattadāśrayabhinnatvāt, kathaṃ tasya śakyatāvacchedakatvam, anugatadharmasyaiva tattvādata āha-tattvañceti āśrayatvaṃ cetyarthaḥ| akhaṇḍaśaktirūpamiti śaktiḥ-dharmaḥ; itarapadārthaghaṭitamūrttikadharmarūpamiti yāvta|
analyzed: tathā ca iti āśraye eva iti evakāreṇa viśiṣṭa arthasya śakyatva vyavacchedaḥ nanu āśraya tvasya tat tad svarūpa ātmakasya tat tad āśraya bhinnatvāt katham tasya śakyatā avacchedaka tvam anugata dharmasya eva tattvāt atas āha tattvam ca iti āśraya tvam ca iti arthaḥ akhaṇḍa śakti rūpam iti śaktiḥ dharmaḥ itara padārtha ghaṭita mūrttika dharma rūpam iti yāvta

analyzed: naiyāyikaḥ tu āśrayatāyāḥ niyata anya nirūpita svarūpāyāḥ anugamaka tva asambhavaḥ śakyatā avacchedaka tvasya api vyabhicāreṇa na akhaṇḍa tva sādhaka tvam iti na dvitīyāyāḥ āśrayaḥ ṛthaḥ tasya prakṛtyā eva lābhāt prakṛti artha bhinna tvena tatas āśrayasya ananubhavāt ca kintu phala anvayini vṛttiḥ eva tad arthaḥ

original: karmaṇi dvitīyetyasya phalaniṣṭhā'dheyatvānvaye pravṛtitātparyye taduttaraṃ dvitīyetyarthāt na tadvirodho'pi anāditātparyagrāhakatvena paramparayā śaktigrāhakatvācca na tadvaiyyarthyam| āśrayatvantu na tacchakyam|

original: viklittyāśrayatvāt karmateti karmasaṃjñetyarthaḥ| etena karttagataprakṛtadhātvarthavyāvāraprayojyatad‌vyadhikaraṇaprakṛtadhātvarthaphalāśrayatvaṃ karmatvamuktaṃ bhavati| yad vakṣyati `uktaprayatvāt iti'| `agnermāṇavaka vārayati' ityādāvagnyādāvati vyāptinirāsāya vyāpāre kartṛgatatvamupāttam|
analyzed: viklitti āśraya tvāt karmatā iti karma saṃjñā iti arthaḥ etena kartta gata prakṛta dhātvartha vyāvāra prayojya tad vyadhikaraṇa prakṛta dhātvartha phala āśraya tvam karma tvam uktam bhavati yat vakṣyati ukta prayatvāt iti agneḥ māṇavaka vārayati ityādau agni ādau ati vyāpti nirāsāya vyāpāre kartṛ gata tvam upāttam

original: vārayateśca saṃyogānukūlavyāpārābhāvānukūlavyāpāro'parthaḥ| `cainno grāmaṃ gacchati' ityādau caitrādervāraṇāya vyādhikaraṇeti| vaiyādhikaraṇyañca-tadanadhikaraṇavṛttitvam, natu tadadhikaramāvṛttitvam, tasya saṃyoge asat‌vena grāmādāvavyāpteḥ| tādṛśavaiyadhikaraṇyaviśiṣṭādhikaraṇatāyāścaitrādāvasattvānnātiprasaṅgasambhāvan'pi|
analyzed: vārayateḥ ca saṃyoga anukūla vyāpāra abhāva anukūla vyāpāra uparthaḥ grāmam gacchati ityādau caitra ādeḥ vāraṇāya vyādhi karaṇa iti vaiyādhikaraṇyam ca tad anadhikaraṇa vṛttitvam natu tad adhikaramā vṛttitvam tasya saṃyoge asatvena grāma ādau avyāpteḥ tādṛśa vaiyadhikaraṇya viśiṣṭa adhikaraṇa tāyāḥ caitra ādau asattvāt na atiprasaṅga sambhāvanpi

original: `māṣeṣvaśvaṃ badhgāti' ityādau bandhaprayojyabhakṣaṇā''śrayamāṣāṇāṃ tattvavāraṇāya prakṛtadhātvarthattvaṃ phalaviśeṣaṇam| prakṛtatvañca-tatra tatra viśiṣyopādeyam| `payasaudanaṃ bhuṅkte' ityādau tu karmatvāvivakṣaṇānna dvitīyā, kṛtabhonasya payolobhena pravṛttāvīpsitatamatvasyāpi payasi sambhavāditi|

original: nanu paraiḥ kṛño yatnamātrārthakatvābhyupagamāt kathamutpatteḥ prakṛtadhātvarthatvamata āha-utpatteriti tathāca, kṛña utpattirūpaphālarthakatvasya prāgupapādanānnārthāsaṅgatiriti bhāvaḥ| dhātvarthatvāt ityukt‌yā kṛñaḥ kevalayatnarthakatve ghaṭādīnāṃ karmatvānupapattirapi doṣatvena dhvanyate| āvaraṇabhaṅgeti prācīnamatānusāreṇedam|
analyzed: nanu paraiḥ kṛñaḥ yatna mātra arthaka tva abhyupagamāt katham utpatteḥ prakṛta dhātvartha tvam atas āha utpatteḥ iti tathā ca kṛñaḥ utpatti rūpa phāla arthaka tvasya prāk upapādanāt na artha asaṅgatiḥ iti bhāvaḥ dhātvartha tvāt iti uktyā kṛñaḥ kevala yatna arthaka tve ghaṭa ādīnām karmatva anupapattiḥ api doṣa tvena dhvanyate āvaraṇa bhaṅga iti prācīna mata anusāreṇa idam

original: niṣkṛṣṭamate tu jñānarūpaphalasya viṣayatayā ghaṭādau sattvātkarmateti bodhyam| nacākarmakatā''pattiḥ, phalatāvacchedakasambandhena sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvāt| naiyāyikamate tvetādṛśasthale yathā ghaṭādīnāṃ karmatvaṃ tathopapādita dhātvarthanirūpaṇāvasare|

original: nanu vidyamānaghaṭe jñānajanyāvaraṇabhaṅgasya sambhave'pi bhāvivinaṣṭaghaṭe nirāśrayasya tasyāsambhavena tasya karmatvānupapattirata āha-atītānāgateti| tatrā''śrayatāṅgīkāreyuktimāha-anyatheti tatrāvacaraṇabhṅagāsvīkāre ityarthaḥ| yathāpūrvamiti jānātikriyāviśaṣaṇam| padārthānativṛttāvavyayībhāvaḥ| pūrvamanatikramyetyartha-|
analyzed: nanu vidyamāna ghaṭe jñāna janya āvaraṇa bhaṅgasya sambhave api bhāvi vinaṣṭa ghaṭe nirāśrayasya tasya asambhavena tasya karmatva anupapattiḥ atas āha atīta anāgata iti tatra āśraya tā aṅgīkāre yuktim āha anyathā iti tatra avacaraṇa bhṅaga asvīkāre iti arthaḥ yathāpūrvam iti jānāti kriyā viśaṣaṇam padārtha anativṛttau avyayībhāvaḥ pūrvam an atikramya iti arthaḥ

original: pūrvajñānānatikramoyasmim̐staditi yāvat| ghaṭasya vidyamānatādaśāyāṃ tātkālikajñānasya tad‌ghaṭe āvaraṇabhaṅgajanakatayā'tītadaśāyāmādhunikājñanasya tadajanakatvena pūrvātikramasya tattvāt pūrvānatikrāntajñānābhāvasya viṣayasyābādhāttadṛśaprayogasya prāmāṇyāpatterityarthaḥ|
analyzed: pūrva jñāna anatikramaḥ yasmin tat iti yāvat ghaṭasya vidyamānatā daśāyām tātkālika jñānasya tad ghaṭe āvaraṇa bhaṅga janaka tayā atīta daśāyām ādhunika ajñanasya tad ajanaka tvena pūrva atikramasya tattvāt pūrva anatikrānta jñāna abhāvasya viṣayasya ābādhāt tadṛśa prayogasya prāmāṇya āpatteḥ iti arthaḥ

original: atītaghaṭe ādhunikajñānenāvaraṇabhṅgetpādābhyupagame tu tena pūrvajñānānatikramāt tadabhāvasya bādhādbhavati tasyāprāmāṇyamiti bhāvaḥ|

original: nanu vinaṣṭe ghaṭe vāstavatadāśrayataiva kathamata āha-atītāderiti ādinā bhāviparigrahaḥ| naiyāyikānāmiveti yathā'nubhavānurodhena tasmin viṣayatayā jñānāśrayatāṅgīkārasteṣāṃ tathāsmākamapīti bhāvaḥ| nanvatīto ghaṭo jñānaviṣaya iti pratīterastu nāmatādṛśaghaṭasya viṣayatayā jñānāśrayatā;
analyzed: nanu vinaṣṭe ghaṭe vāstava tad āśraya tā eva katham atas āha atīta ādeḥ iti ādinā bhāvi parigrahaḥ naiyāyikānām iva iti yathā anubhava anurodhena tasmin viṣayatayā jñāna āśraya tā aṅgīkāraḥ teṣām tathā asmākam api iti bhāvaḥ nanu atītaḥ ghaṭaḥ jñāna viṣayaḥ iti pratīteḥ astu nāma tādṛśa ghaṭasya viṣayatayā jñāna āśraya tā

original: āvaraṇabhaṅgaśrayatāyāntu na tathā sādhakopalabdhirata āha-satkāryyeti| tameva darśayati- "sadeva somyedamagra āsīt" iti śruteḥ kāryyajātaṃ sūkṣmarūpeṇa prāgavasthitameva| paramate janakatvenābhimatasāmagrīsambadhānāttu tadabhivyaktirbhavati| kāraṇe sūkṣmarūpeṇāvasthānameva tatprāgabhāvaḥ| tasyāmevāvasthāyāṃ sa bhaviṣyatīti vyāvahṇiyate|
analyzed: āvaraṇa bhaṅga śraya tāyān tu na tathā sādhaka upalabdhiḥ atas āha satkāryya iti tam eva darśayati sat eva somya idam agre āsīt iti śruteḥ kāryya jātam sūkṣma rūpeṇa prāk avasthitam eva para mate janaka tvena abhimata sāmagrī sambadhānāt tu tad abhivyaktiḥ bhavati kāraṇe sūkṣma rūpeṇa avasthānam eva tad prāgabhāvaḥ tasyām eva avasthāyām sa bhaviṣyati iti vyāvahṇiyate

original: tataḥ pracyutamabhivyaktilakṣaṇaṃ dharmamaprāptaṃ jāyata iti prāptābhivyaktistvastīti|
analyzed: tatas pracyutam abhivyakti lakṣaṇam dharmam aprāptam jāyate iti prāpta abhivyaktiḥ tu asti iti

original: nanu sarvadaiva sati tasmin kathaṃ nāsti naśyatīti vyāvahāro'ta āha-tirobhāvābhyupagama iti tirobhāvābhivyañjakasāmagyā tirobhāve'bhivyañjite sati, `nāsti naṣṭaḥ' `iti vyāvahāraḥ| labdhakramāyāntu tasyāṃ naśyatīti satkāryavādasiddhāntaḥ| prakṛte ghaṭasya tirodhāne'pi sūkṣmarūpeṇa sattvāttatrāvaraṇabhaṅgarūpaphalāśrayatvaṃ sūlabhamiti bhāvaḥ|

original: ye tvanukūlavyāpāra eva ṇijarstadanvayini gamanādikriyaiva dhātvarthatāvacchedakaṃ phalaṃ, tacchāliyayā'jādīnāṃ prāptameva karmatvaṃ "gatibuddhi" iti sūtreṇa niyamyate iti vadanti| teṣāṃ mate `pācayatyodanaṃ sahāyena' ityādau dvitīyātṛtīyayorniyāmakālābhaḥ| adhikamanyatrānusa-dheyamityāhuḥ|
analyzed: ye tu anukūla vyāpāre eva gamana ādi kriyā eva dhātvartha tā avacchedakam phalam tat śāli yayāja ādīnām prāptam eva karmatvam gati buddhi iti sūtreṇa niyamyate iti vadanti teṣām mate pācayati odanam sahāyena ityādau dvitīya tṛtīyayoḥ niyāmaka ālābhaḥ adhikam anyatra anusadheyam iti āhuḥ

original: `vaikuṇṭhamadhitiṣṭhati'ityādāvapi dvitīyāyā ādhāra evārthaḥ, adhyādyupasṛśīṅādiyoge "adhiśīṅ" ityādisūtrairādhārasya karmasaṃjñāvidhānāt|
analyzed: vaikuṇṭham adhitiṣṭhati ityādau api dvitīyāyāḥ ādhāraḥ eva arthaḥ adhi ādi upasṛ śīṅ ādi yoge ityādi sūtraiḥ ādhārasya karma saṃjñā vidhānāt

original: yadāpi kṛñarthavyāpārapāntarbhābeṇādhyādyupasṛṣṭaśīṅādīnāṃ lakṣaṇāmupagamya `kartṛrīpsitatamam' ityanenaiva karmasaṃjñā sūsādhā, tatāpi mukhyārthakatadyoge'pi karmapratyayasādhutvabodhanārtham `adhiśīṅ‌sthāsām' ityādisūtrāṇāmapyāvaśyakateti| karmapravacanīyayogavihitavibhaktestu yathāyathaṃ lakṣyalakṣamabhāvādiḥ sambandho dyotya iti vakṣyate|
analyzed: yadā api lakṣaṇām upagamya mukhya arthaka tad yoge pi karma pratyaya sādhu tva bodhana artham ityādi sūtrāṇām api āvaśyaka tā iti karmapravacanīya yoga vihita vibhakteḥ tu yathāyatham lakṣya lakṣam abhāva ādiḥ sambandhaḥ dyotyaḥ iti vakṣyate

original: upapadavibhaktīnāṃ tu ṣaṣṭhayapavādakatvāt sambandha evārthaḥ| "kālādhvanoratyantasaṃyoge" iti vihitadvitīyāyā vyāpakatvamarthaḥ, `māsamadhīte' ityādau māsavyāpakādhyayanamiti bodhāt, dvitīyādīnāmāśrayo'rtha ityatra vibhaktipadasya pārakavibhaktiparatvena tadavirodhādityanyatra vistaraḥ|
analyzed: upapada vibhaktīnām tu ṣaṣṭhaya apavādaka tvāt sambandhaḥ eva arthaḥ kāla adhvanoḥ atyanta saṃyoge iti vihita dvitīyāyāḥ vyāpaka tvam arthaḥ māsam adhīte ityādau māsa vyāpaka adhyayanam iti bodhāt dvitīyā ādīnām āśrayaḥ ṛthaḥ iti atra vibhakti padasya pāraka vibhakti paratvena tad avirodhāt iti anyatra vistaraḥ

original: kramaprāptaṃ tṛtāyārthaṃ nirūpayati-kartṛtīyāyā iti karaṇatṛtīyāyā vyāpārārthatvasyāpi vakṣyamāṇatvāduktam-kartriti| āśraya iti āśrayamātramityarthaḥ| āśrayārthakatve mānamupanyasyati tathāhītyādinā|
analyzed: krama prāptam tṛtāya artham nirūpayati kartṛ tīyāyāḥ iti karaṇa tṛtīyāyāḥ vyāpāra artha tvasya api vakṣyamāṇatvāt uktam kartṛ iti āśrayaḥ iti āśraya mātram iti arthaḥ āśraya arthaka tve mānam upanyasyati tathā hi ityādinā

original: nanu svātantryamitaravyāpārānadhīnavyāpāravattvam, tacca `kāṣṭhaṃ pacati' ityādau kāṣṭhādāvaprasaktam, tad‌vyāpārasya cetanavyāpārādhīnatvādata āha-svātantryañceti vyāpāraśrayatvasya karaṇe, dhātvarthāśrayatvasya karmaṇyatiprasaktatvāt tad‌vyāvṛttaye krameṇobhayam|
analyzed: nanu svātantryam itara vyāpāra anadhīna vyāpāravattvam tat ca kāṣṭham pacati ityādau kāṣṭha ādau aprasaktam tad vyāpārasya cetana vyāpāra adhīna tvāt atas āha svātantryam ca iti vyāpāra śraya tvasya karaṇe dhātvartha āśraya tvasya karmaṇi atiprasakta tvāt tad vyāvṛttaye krameṇa ubhayam

original: anye tu-kartṛpratyayasamabhivyāhāre vyāpārātāvacchedakaṃsambandhena dhātvarthaniṣṭhaviśeṣyatānirūpitaprakāratānāśryataddhātvarthāśrayatvaṃ svātantryam| tadeva ca kartṛtvam| kālikasambandhena vyāpārāśraye'tiprasaṅgavāraṇāya vyāpārātāvacchedakasambandeneti|
analyzed: anye tu kartṛ pratyaya samabhivyāhāre svātantryam tat eva ca kartṛ tvam kālika sambandhena vyāpāra āśraya iti prasaṅga vāraṇāya vyāpāra ātā avacchedaka sambandena iti

original: `grāmaṃ gacchati' ityādāvuttarasaṃyogātmake phale tādṛśadhātvarthatvābhāvānna tadāśraye'tiprasaṃṅgaḥ| `pakvastaṇḍulo devadattena' ityādau phalasya viśeṣatvena devadatte'vyāptiparihārāya kartṛpratyayasamabhivyāhāra iti| sāmagrīsādhyāyāṃ kriyāyāṃ sarveṣāṃ svasvavyāpāre svātantrye'pyuktasvātantrya yugapatsarveṣvabhāvānna sūtrānarthakyamiti|
analyzed: grāmam gacchati ityādau uttara saṃyoga ātmake phale tādṛśa dhātvartha tva abhāvāt na tad āśraya iti prasaṃṅgaḥ pakvaḥ taṇḍulaḥ devadattena ityādau phalasya viśeṣa tvena devadatte vyāpti parihārāya kartṛ pratyaya samabhivyāhāraḥ iti sāmagrī sādhyāyām kriyāyām sarveṣām sva sva vyāpāre svātantrye pi ukta svātantrya yugapad sarveṣu abhāvāt na sūtra ānarthakyam iti

original: tattu karmapratyayasamabhivyahṛtakartṛvyāvṛttatvād dhātvarthavyāpārāśrayatvasyaiva samyaktve guruviśeṣaṇasyānatiprayojanakatvāccopekṣyam| karmakarttari tu navyāmate phale vyāpāratvā''ropānnā'vyāptiḥ| vyāpāratvena kṛterapi saṅgrahānna tadanāśraye'cetane svarasataḥ kartṛvyāvahāraḥ|
analyzed: tat tu karma pratyaya samabhivyahṛta kartṛ vyāvṛtta tvāt dhātvartha vyāpāra āśraya tvasya eva samyaktve guru viśeṣaṇasya anatiprayojanaka tvāt ca upekṣyam karma karttari tu navya amate phale vyāpāra tva āropāt na avyāptiḥ vyāpāra tvena kṛteḥ api saṅgrahāt na tad anāśraye cetane svarasataḥ kartṛ vyāvahāraḥ

original: tadatiriktavyāpārasya dhātunā vivakṣāyāṃ tu kvacit kartṛtvavyāvahāro'pi| vakṣyati ca-`yadā yadīyo vyāpāraḥ' ityādi| evameva `matto bhūtaṃ na tu mayā kṛtam' ityādyupapādyamiti bhāvaḥ| tatra harivākyaṃ pramāṇayati dhātuneti| uktakriya iti viśeṣaṇadasmaduktameva svātantryaṃ irisammatamiti sūcayati|
analyzed: tad atirikta vyāpārasya dhātunā vivakṣāyām tu kvacid kartṛ tva vyāvahāraḥ api vakṣyati ca yadā yadīyaḥ vyāpāraḥ ityādi evam eva mattaḥ bhūtam na tu mayā kṛtam ityādi upapādyam iti bhāvaḥ tatra hari vākyam pramāṇayati dhātunā iti ukta kriyaḥ iti svātantryam iri sammatam iti sūcayati

original: ata eveti uktasvātantryasya kartṛtvādevetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: atas eva iti ukta svātantryasya kartṛ tvāt eva iti arthaḥ

original: saṅgacchata iti kṛtyāśrayatvādestattve tu tadasaṅgatiriti bhāvaḥ| uktavivakṣāyāḥ prayoganiyāmakatvaṃ draḍhayituṃ pṛcchati-nanvevamiti evaṃ vivakṣāyā eva prayoganiyāmakatve manomayasya-manomayaśabdapratipādyasyetyarthaḥ| jīvatve-saṃkalpakartṛrūpatve-brahmabhinnatve iti yāvta|
analyzed: saṅgacchate iti kṛtya āśraya tva ādeḥ tattve tu tad asaṅgatiḥ iti bhāvaḥ ukta vivakṣāyāḥ prayoga niyāmaka tvam draḍhayitum pṛcchati nanu evam iti evam vivakṣāyāḥ eva prayoga niyāmaka tve manaḥ mayasya manaḥ maya śabda pratipādyasya iti arthaḥ jīva tve saṃkalpa kartṛ rūpatve brahma bhinna tve iti yāvta tve

original: etamitaḥ ityāderitaḥ-śarīrāt pretya-niḥsṛtya-etaccharīraṃ parityajyeti yāvat| etam svaprakāśatvādiguṇaviśiṣṭaṃ pūrvoktamātmānam|
analyzed: etam itas ityādeḥ itas śarīrāt pretya niḥsṛtya etat śarīram parityajya iti yāvat etam sva prakāśa tva ādi guṇa viśiṣṭam pūrva uktam ātmānam

original: abhisambhavitāsmi prāptāsmītyarthaḥ| kathaṃ saṅgacchatāmiti bhavanmate vaivakṣikayoḥ kartṛtvakarmatvayorekasminnapi sambhavāditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: abhisambhavitāsmi prāptā asmi iti arthaḥ katham saṅgacchatām iti bhavat mate vaivakṣikayoḥ kartṛ tva karma tvayoḥ ekasmin api sambhavāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: saṃjñānibandhanavirodhaṃ samarthayan kartṛtvakarmatvayorvāstavāvirodhaṃ darśayati-ucyata ityādinā| jīvasyaiva jñeyatva iti `sa kratuṃ kurvita' ityanena jīvasyaivopāsyatvabodhane ityarthaḥ| prāptikarmatvamiti anyopāsanāyā aparaprāptyaphalakatvāditi bhāvaḥ| ākhyāteneti abhisambhavitā'smītyetad‌ghaṭakenetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: saṃjñā nibandhana virodham samarthayan kartṛ tva karma tvayoḥ vāstava avirodham darśayati ucyate ityādinā jīvasya eva jñeya tve iti sa kratum kurvitaḥ iti anena jīvasya eva upāsya tva bodhane iti arthaḥ prāpti karma tvam iti anya upāsanāyāḥ apara prāpti aphalaka tvāt iti bhāvaḥ ākhyātena iti abhisambhavitāsmi iti etad ghaṭakena iti arthaḥ

original: bādhāditi saṃjñāyorākaḍārīyatayā samveśāsambhavena parayā kartṛsaṃjñayā bādhādityarthaḥ| yagādyā''pattiriti| abhyuccayavādaḥ, prāpye karmaṇi karmavadbhāvāprasakteḥ| śadbavirodhadvārā-ekadā saṃjñādvayaprayuktakāryyānutpattidvārā, saḥ-saṃjñādvayavirodhastatra kartṛkarmatvavyavahāraheturityarthaḥ|
analyzed: bādhāt iti saṃjñā yoḥ ākaḍārīyatayā samveśa asambhavena parayā kartṛ saṃjñayā bādhāt iti arthaḥ yak ādi āpattiḥ iti abhyuccaya vādaḥ prāpye karmaṇi karmavat bhāva aprasakteḥ saṃjñā dvaya prayukta kārya anutpatti dvārā saḥ saṃjñā dvaya virodhaḥ tatra kartṛ karmatva vyavahāra hetuḥ iti arthaḥ

original: natu kartṛtvakarmatvayoḥ pāramārthikaṃ bhedamādāyeti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: na tu kartṛ tva karma tvayoḥ pāramārthikam bhedam ādāya iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu viśiṣṭāśrayasya tāvatā tṛtīyā'rthatvamāyātamata āha-evañceti dhātupāttavyāpārāśrayasya karttṛtve cetyarthaḥ| āśrayamātramiti ananyalabhyatvāditi bhāva-| matāntaraṃ dūṣayati-kṛtyāśrayatvamityādinā| avyāptamiti acetane tasmiṃstad‌bādhāditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: nanu viśiṣṭa āśrayasya tāvatā tṛtīyā artha tvam āyātam atas āha evam ca iti dhātu pātta vyāpāra āśrayasya karttṛ tve ca iti arthaḥ āśraya mātram iti ananya labhya tvāt iti bhāva mata antaram dūṣayati kṛtya āśraya tvam ityādinā avyāptam iti acetane tasmin tad bādhāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: atra vadanti-daṇḍādiniṣṭhavyāpārasya dhātvarthatvavivakṣayā bhavaduktasvātantryavad vāstavakārakacakraprayoktṛtvasya daṇḍādāvabhāve'pi tadāropāt kartṛtvavyāvahārastasmin sūpapādaḥ| ata eva hariṇā-
analyzed: atra vadanti daṇḍa ādi niṣṭha vyāpārasya dhātvartha tva vivakṣayā bhavat ukta svātantrya vat vāstava kāraka cakra prayoktṛ tvasya daṇḍa ādau abhāve pi tad āropāt kartṛ tva vyāvahāraḥ tasmin sūpapādaḥ atas eva hariṇā

original: prāganyataḥ śaktilābhānnayagbhāvā'ṣa़pādanādapi|
analyzed: prāk anyatas śakti lābhāt na yagbhāva āṣaḍpādanāt api

original: tadadhīnapravṛttatvāt pravṛttānāṃ nivarttanāt||
analyzed: tad adhīna pravṛtta tvāt pravṛttānām nivarttanāt

original: adṛṣṭatvātpratinidhervyatireke ca darśanāt|
analyzed: a dṛṣṭa tvāt pratinidheḥ vyatireke ca darśanāt

original: ārādapyupakāritve svātantryaṃ kartturiṣyate||
analyzed: ārāt api upakāri tve svātantryam karttuḥ iṣyate

original: ityanena karaṇādivyāpārāt pūrvaṃ karaṇādisampādakaśiktimattvena karaṇādīnāmātmādhīnatvasampādanena ca tadāyattavyāpāratvenātipravṛttānāṃ nivarttanena karttuḥ phalaprāptau svata eva nivṛttyā pratinidhyabhāvena kārakāntarābhāve'pyastyādau kartturdaśanena ca ārā (dūrā)dapyupakāritve svātantryamityarthakena kārakacakraprayoktutvameva
analyzed: iti anena karaṇa ādi vyāpārāt pūrvam karaṇa ādi sampādaka śiktimattvena karaṇa ādīnām ātma adhīna tva sampādanena ca tad āyatta vyāpāra tvena atipravṛttānām nivarttanena karttuḥ phala prāptau svatas eva nivṛttyā pratinidhi abhāvena kāraka antara abhāve pi asti ādau karttuḥ daśanena ca ārā dūrāt api upakāri tve svātantryam iti arthakena kāraka cakra prayoktu tvam eva

original: svātantryamabhihitam|
analyzed: svātantryam abhihitam

original: vastuta eṣāṃ dharmāṇāmabhāve'pi śabdena yasyaite pratipādyante sa kartteti tadāśayaḥ| `pācayati caitreṇa maitraḥ' ityādau prayojyasya prayojakavyāpārādhīnatve'pi ṇiceprakṛtyarthasādhanāntaraviṣaye uktasvātantryasya sattvāt karttṛtvopapattiḥ, dhātuvācyakriyākṛtasvātantryasyaiva vivakṣaṇāt, karttṛparatantrakaraṇāderna svavyāpāramādāya karttṛtvam,
analyzed: vastutas eṣām dharmāṇām abhāve api śabdena yasya ete pratipādyante sa karttā iti tad āśayaḥ pācayati caitreṇa maitraḥ ityādau prayojyasya prayojaka vyāpāra adhīna tve pi ukta svātantryasya sattvāt karttṛ tva upapattiḥ dhātu vācya kriyā kṛta svātantryasya eva vivakṣaṇāt karttṛ paratantra karaṇa ādeḥ na sva vyāpāram ādāya karttṛ tvam

original: prayojyasya svārthasidhdyarthamapi pravṛttyā karaṇādīnāṃ kartradhīnatvavat prayojyasya prayojakānadīnatvācca| nahi phaloddeśādhīnā karaṇādīnāṃ vyāpāravattā| prayojyasya tu tādṛśapravṛttau "sarva ime svabhūtyarthaṃ pravarttante" iti, hetumati ceti sūtrasthaṃ bhāṣyamanubhavaśca sārvajanīnaḥ pramāṇamityāhuḥ|
analyzed: prayojyasya svārtha sidhdi artham api pravṛttyā karaṇa ādīnām kartṛ adhīna tva vat prayojyasya prayojaka an adīna tvāt ca nahi phala uddeśa adhīnā karaṇa ādīnām vyāpāravat tā prayojyasya tu tādṛśa pravṛttau sarve ime sva bhūti artham pravarttante iti hetumati ca iti sūtra stham bhāṣyam anubhavaḥ ca sārvajanīnaḥ pramāṇam iti āhuḥ

original: kṛtyāśrayatvaṃ daṇḍādāvavyāptamityuktayā naiyāyikoktakarttṛtvasyopekṣaṇīyatvamāveditam| teṣāṃ tvayamāśayaḥ-karttṛtvaṃ mukhyaṃ pūrvoktameva, āśrayapratiyogitvādirūpaṃ tu gauṇam, ubhayamapi kartṛtṛtīyayā pratipādyate|
analyzed: kṛtyā āśraya tvam daṇḍa ādau avyāptam iti uktayā naiyāyika ukta karttṛ tvasya upekṣaṇīya tvam āveditam teṣām tu ayam āśayaḥ karttṛ tvam mukhyam pūrva uktam eva āśraya pratiyogi tva ādi rūpam tu gauṇam ubhayam api kartṛ tṛtīyayā pratipādyate

original: tathāhi-`caitreṇa pacyate' ityādau kṛtimadabhedena tajjnyatvaṃ vā kriyāviśeṣaṇatayā tṛtīyayā'bhidhīyate| acetanakāṣṭhachāderapi kartṛtvavivakṣaāyāṃ tu `kāṣṭhaṃ pacati' itivat `kāṣṭhena pacyate taṇḍulaḥ' ityapi prayogād vāyapārarūpe kartṛtve tajjnyatvarūpe sakartṛkatve vā tasya lakṣaṇā|
analyzed: tathā hi caitreṇa pacyate ityādau kṛtimat abhedena tad jnya tvam vā kriyā viśeṣaṇatayā tṛtīyayā abhidhīyate acetana kāṣṭha chādeḥ api kartṛ tva vivakṣaāyām tu kāṣṭham pacati iti vat kāṣṭhena pacyate taṇḍulaḥ iti api prayogāt kartṛ tve tad jnya tva rūpe sakartṛkatve vā tasya lakṣaṇā

original: evaṃ `caitreṇa jñāyate' ityādāvāśrayatvarūpe kartṛtve ādheyatvarūpe kartṛmattve vā, naśyate ghaṭenetyādau pratiyogitvātmakakartṛtve'nuyogitvarūpakartṛmattve vā lakṣaṇā| caitraḥ pacatītyādavuktasthale sukhyaṃ gauṇaṃ vā kriyāviśeṣyatayā''khyātena bodhyate| acetane svarasataḥ kartṛvyavahārābhāvena tatra kartṛpadamapi bhāktameva|

original: vaiśiṣṭayaṃ ca dhātvarthavyāpāre janyajanakabhāvasambandhena bodhyam| atra ca `yatsannihiteṣu sarveṣu kārakeṣu karttā pravarttayitā bhavati" iti sakalakārakavyāpārasya kartradhīnatvapratipādakam "kārake" iti sūtrasathaṃ bhāṣyaṃ pramāṇam|
analyzed: vaiśiṣṭayam ca dhātvartha vyāpāre janya janaka bhāva sambandhena bodhyam atra ca yat sannihiteṣu sarveṣu kārakeṣu karttā pravarttayitā bhavati iti sakala kāraka vyāpārasya kartṛ adhīna tva pratipādakam kārake iti sūtrasatham bhāṣyam pramāṇam

original: apare tu-`kriyāyāḥ pariniṣpattiryad‌vyāpārādanantaram' iti vākyasthānantarapadasvārasyāt tṛtīyārthavyāpārasya janyatāsambandhena phale'nvayaḥ| tathāca janyatāsagbandhena kāṣṭhāśrayakavyāpāraviśiṣṭaviklittyanukūlo vyāpāra iti bodhamāhuḥ| tṛtīyārthakaraṇatvasya vyāpāra evānvayaḥ, śabdaśaktisvabhāvānna phalāṃśe|
analyzed: apare tu kriyāyāḥ pariniṣpattiḥ yat vyāpārāt anantaram iti vākya stha anantara pada svārasyāt tṛtīyā artha vyāpārasya janya tā sambandhena phala anvayaḥ tathāca janya tā sagbandhena kāṣṭha āśrayaka vyāpāra viśiṣṭa viklitti anukūlaḥ vyāpāraḥ iti bodham āhuḥ tṛtīyārtha karaṇa tvasya vyāpāre eva anvayaḥ śabda śakti svabhāvāt na phala aṃśe

original: ata eva matvarthalakṣaṇayā somādipadasya nāmadheyatvaṃ siddhāntitam| anyathā vyāpāraṃ prati karaṇatvenanvite phalāṃśe karaṇatvenānvayopapattau lakṣaṇāyā aprasaṅga eva| ata eva somena yajetetyatra somapadasya matvarthe lakṣaṇeti mīmāṃsakā ityante|
analyzed: atas eva matvartha lakṣaṇayā soma ādi padasya nāmadheya tvam siddhāntitam anyathā vyāpāram prati karaṇa tvena anvite phala aṃśe karaṇa tvena anvaya upapattau lakṣaṇāyāḥ aprasaṅgaḥ eva atas eva somena yajeta iti atra soma padasya matvarthe lakṣaṇā iti mīmāṃsakāḥ iti ante

original: vastutastvāśrayo'vadhiruddeśya iti mūlasvārasyāt karaṇatṛtīyāyā apyāśrayamātramarthaḥ| prakṛtyarthānvitasya tasya svaniṣṭhavyāpārajanyatvasambandhena dhātvarthavyāpāre'nvaya ityeva jyāyāḥ|
analyzed: vastutas tu āśrayaḥ vadhiḥ uddeśyaḥ iti mūla svārasyāt karaṇa tṛtīyāyāḥ api āśraya mātram arthaḥ prakṛti artha anvitasya tasya sva niṣṭha vyāpāra janya tva sambandhena dhātvartha vyāpāra anvayaḥ iti eva jyāyāḥ

original: naiyāyikāstvasādhāraṇaṃ kāraṇaṃ karaṇam| kāraṇe asādhāraṇyaṃ ca vyāpāravattvāmeva, natu phalāyogavyāpacchinnatvam, tasya yāvatkāraṇaghaṭitatayā gauraveṇa taddharmāvacchinne śaktayasiddheḥ| sa eva ca prakarṣassādhakatamamiti tamapā bodhyate| vyāpāraśca tajjanyatve sati tajjanyatve sati tajjanyajanakatvarūpaḥ|
analyzed: naiyāyikāḥ tu asādhāraṇam kāraṇam karaṇam kāraṇe asādhāraṇyam ca na tu tasya yāvat kāraṇa ghaṭita tayā gauraveṇa tad dharma avacchinne śakti asiddheḥ saḥ eva ca prakarṣaḥ sādhakatamam iti tamapā bodhyate vyāpāraḥ ca tad janya tve sati tad janya tve sati tad janya janaka tva rūpaḥ

original: evañca janakatvasyāvyāvadhānāghaṭitatvena lābhasyāntarīyakatvānna tatra pṛthak‌śāktiriti vyāpāramātraṃ karaṇatṛtīyārthastasmin prakṛtyarthasyādheyatāsambandhenānvayaḥ| śeṣaṃ pūrvavadityāhuḥ|
analyzed: evam ca janakatvasya avyāvadhāna aghaṭita tvena lābhasya āntarīyaka tvāt na tatra pṛthak śāktiḥ iti vyāpāra mātram karaṇa tṛtīyā arthaḥ tasmin prakṛti arthasya ādheyatā sambandhena anvayaḥ śeṣam pūrvavat iti āhuḥ

original: evamiti ekasminnapi dharmiṇi kartṛtva-karamatvayoraṅgīkāra ityarthaḥ| karttṛkaraṇaśaktayoravirodha iti yāvat| śaktiviparyyayāditi "kartā śāstrārthavattvāt" iti sūtreṇa `eṣa hi draṣṭā śrotā'numantā boddhā vijñānā''tmā puruṣaḥ' ityādīnāṃ pathā karttuḥ karttvayāviśeṣapratipādakānām `yajeta' `juhuyāt' ityādīnāṃ ca sārthakyāya jīvasya kartṛtvabodhite
analyzed: evam iti ekasmin api dharmiṇi kartṛ tva karama tvayoḥ aṅgīkāraḥ iti arthaḥ karttṛ karaṇa śaktayoḥ avirodhaḥ iti yāvat śakti viparyyayāt iti kartā śāstra arthavat tvāt iti sūtreṇa eṣa hi draṣṭā śrotā anumantā boddhā vijñāna ātmā puruṣaḥ ityādīnām pathā karttuḥ yajeta juhuyāt ityādīnām ca sārthakyāya jīvasya kartṛ tva bodhite

original: vuddhipadavyāvahāryyavijñānamevāstu kartrityāśaṅkāyāṃ vijñānaśabdavācyabuddheḥ karttṛtvābhyupagame loke samarthasyāpi kartṛḥ sarvārthakārikaraṇāntarasāpekṣasyaiva kāryyakāritvadarśanena vijñānapadavyapadeśyatvabuddheḥ karaṇaśaktihānyāpattiratastadatiriktajīvasyaiva kartṛtvamucitamityarthapratipādakena "śaktiviparyayāt" iti sūtreṇetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: vuddhi pada vyāvahāryya vijñānam eva astu kartā iti āśaṅkāyām vijñāna śabda vācya buddheḥ karttṛ tva abhyupagame loke samarthasya api kartṛḥ sarva artha kāri karaṇa antara sāpekṣasya eva kāryya kāri tva darśanena vijñāna pada vyapadeśya tva buddheḥ karaṇa śakti hāni āpattiḥ atas tad atirikta jīvasya eva kartṛ tvam ucitam iti artha pratipādakena śakti viparyayāt iti sūtreṇa iti arthaḥ

original: na yujyeteti kartṛkaraṇaśaktayoravirodhasyaiva bhavadbhirabhidānāditi bhāvaḥ| samādhatte- tadevaiteṣāmiti| prāṇānām indriyāṇām| vijñānam grahaṇaśaktim| vijñānena vijñānaśabdavācyena manasā tajjanyabudhdyātmakavṛttayeti yāvat| ādāya gṛhītvā hṛdayaṃ svāpe gacchatīti śrutyarthaḥ|
analyzed: na yujyeta iti kartṛ karaṇa śaktayoḥ avirodhasya eva bhavadbhiḥ abhidānāt iti bhāvaḥ samādhatte tat eva eteṣām iti prāṇānām indriyāṇām vijñānam grahaṇa śaktim vijñānena vijñāna śabda vācyena manasā tad janya budhdi ātmaka vṛttayā iti yāvat ādāya gṛhītvā hṛdayam svāpe gacchati iti śruti arthaḥ

original: karaṇatayeti vijñānenetyatra karaṇatayā klṛptasyetyarthaḥ. niṣpramāṇetyādeḥ karttari karamaśaktisvīkāre'pi dvayoḥ śaktayorekadā vivakṣāyāmasambhavena tadviparyayaprasaṅgābhāvādityāśayādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: karaṇatayā iti vijñānena iti atra karaṇatayā klṛptasya iti arthaḥ niṣpramāṇa ityādeḥ karttari karama śakti svīkāre api dvayoḥ śaktayoḥ ekadā vivakṣāyām asambhavena tad viparyaya prasaṅga abhāvāt iti āśayāt iti arthaḥ

original: nanvidamayuktam, āpādanapratipādakagranthasyaivāpattāvaprāṇāṇyapratipādakatvāsambhavāt, āpatteḥ prāktanasūtrādaprakāntatvāccetyata āha-vastutastviti| abhyuccayamātrametaditi etat-śaktihānyāpattirūpaṃ dūṣaṇam| mātrapadena tātparyaviṣayatvasya vyavacchedaḥ| abhyuccayatvañca tātparyyajñānaviṣayārthasannihitatvam, upekṣāviṣayatvaṃ vā|
analyzed: nanu idam ayuktam āpādana pratipādaka granthasya eva āpattau aprāṇāṇī apratipādaka tva asambhavāt āpatteḥ prāktana sūtrāt aprakānta tvāt ca iti atas āha vastutas tu iti abhyuccaya mātram etat iti etat śakti hāni āpatti rūpam dūṣaṇam mātra padena tātparya viṣaya tvasya vyavacchedaḥ abhyuccaya tvam ca tātparya jñāna viṣaya artha sannihita tvam upekṣā viṣaya tvam vā

original: tacca buddheḥ karaṇaśaktiviparyaye'sti| dṛṣṭāntapratipādakasūtrād buddheḥ kartṛtvanirāsasyaiva sukhyatvāvagateriti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: tat ca buddheḥ dṛṣṭānta pratipādaka sūtrāt buddheḥ kartṛ tva nirāsasya eva sukhya tva avagateḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: bhūṣaṇe tu tadevaiteṣāmityādyabhiprāyādityantaḥ pāṭho nāstyeva| nanvevaṃ karttetyādirna yujyeteti cet satyam, "anvācayamātrametad" iti pāṭhaḥ| anvācayeti vijñānasabdārthasya jīvatve śaktiviparyyayāpattiḥ sambhāvyate, natu nirbharastatretyarthaḥ| upādhivaśena paramātmanyeva tatsambhavāditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: bhūṣaṇe tu tat eva eteṣām ityādi abhiprāyāt iti antaḥ pāṭhaḥ na asti eva nanu evam karttā ityādiḥ na yujyeta iti ced satyam anvācaya mātram etat iti pāṭhaḥ anvācaya iti vijñāna sabda arthasya jīva tve śakti viparyyaya āpattiḥ sambhāvyate na tu nirbharaḥ tatra iti arthaḥ upādhi vaśena paramātmani eva tad sambhavāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: tadeva viśadayati-yathā ceti sūtre caśabdastvarthe, parābhimatabuddhikartṛtvanirāsārthaḥ| nahi paramātmano'nyo jīvo nāma karttā bhoktāvā sambhavati, nityaśuddhamuktātmanaḥ kartṛtvādyasambhavāt, anirmokṣaprasaṅgācca|
analyzed: tat eva viśadayati yathā ca iti sūtre caśabdaḥ tu arthe para abhimata buddhi kartṛ tva nirāsa arthaḥ nahi paramātmanaḥ nyaḥ jīvaḥ nāma karttā bhoktā vā sambhavati nitya śuddha mukta ātmanaḥ kartṛ tva ādi asambhavāt anirmokṣa prasaṅgāt ca

original: kintu "dhyāyatīva lelāyativa" iti śruteradhyastaṃ tatttra vācyam, avidyopasthāpitaṃ tu tat parasyāpi sambhavati, "yatra hi dvaitamiva bhavati taditara itaraṃ paśyati" iti śruteḥ| vidyā'vasthāyāṃ tu tadabhāvaḥ "yatra tu sarvamātmaiva syāt kiṃ kena paśyat" oiti śruteḥ|
analyzed: kintu dhyāyati iva lelāyati iva iti śruteḥ adhyastam tat ttra vācyam avidyā upasthāpitam tu tat parasya api sambhavati yatra hi dvaitam iva bhavati tat itaraḥ itaram paśyati iti śruteḥ vidyā avasthāyām tu tad abhāvaḥ yatra tu sarvam ātmā eva syāt kim kena paśyat śruteḥ

original: yathā takṣā vāsyādikaraṇahastaḥ karttā duḥkhībhavati, sa eva gṛhastho vimuktavāsyādinirvyāpāraḥ sukhībhavatīti tadarthaḥ| tathāca śaktiviparyyayādityasya parābhyupagatabuddhikartṛtvanirāse tātparyam, natu baddheḥ kartṛtvena karaṇaśaktiparityāgā iti na tad‌virodha iti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: yathā takṣā vāsi ādi karaṇa hastaḥ karttā duḥkhībhavati saḥ eva gṛhasthaḥ vimukta vāsi ādi nirvyāpāraḥ sukhībhavati iti tad arthaḥ tathā ca śakti viparyyayāt iti asya para abhyupagata buddhi kartṛ tva nirāse tātparyam na tu baddheḥ kartṛ tvena karaṇa śakti parityāgāḥ iti na tad virodhaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: saptamyarthaṃ nirūpayati-saptamyā apīti| nanu tāvatā sūtrādādhārasya vācyatvaṃ labhyate, nāśrayasyetyata āha-tattvañceti ādhāratvañcetyarthaḥ| āśrayatvamiti āśrayatvaviśiṣṭatvamitvarthaḥ|
analyzed: saptamī artham nirūpayati saptamyāḥ api iti nanu tāvatā sūtrāt ādhārasya vācyatvam labhyate na āśrayasya iti atas āha tattvam ca iti ādhāra tvam ca iti arthaḥ āśraya tvam iti āśraya tva viśiṣṭa tvam iti arthaḥ

original: viśiṣṭe sūtreṇa śaktibodhane'pyāśrayāṃ'śe eva sā, natu viśeṣaṇībhūtāśrayateve'pi tatprakārakaśābdabodhe āśrayaśaktijñānasya hetutākalpanayaiva tadbhānopapatterityāśayenāha-tatrāśrayāṃśaḥ śakya iti|
analyzed: viśiṣṭe sūtreṇa śakti bodhane pi āśraya aṃśe eva sā na tu tad prakāraka śābdabodhe āśraya śakti jñānasya hetutā kalpanayā eva tad bhāna upapatteḥ iti āśayena āha tatra āśraya aṃśaḥ śakyaḥ iti

original: yadvā-nanu tāvatā paramparayā kriyā''śrayasya saptamyarthatvaṃ labdham, nā''śrayamātrasyetyata āha-āśrayāṃśa iti pūrvoktarītyā kriyāyā dhātoreva lābhadanyalabhyāśraya eva śakya ityarthaḥ| tattvamiti āśrayatvamityarthaḥ|
analyzed: yadvā ananu tāvatā paramparayā kriyā āśrayasya saptamī artha tvam labdham na āśraya mātrasya iti atas āha āśraya aṃśaḥ iti pūrva ukta rītyā kriyāyāḥ dhātoḥ eva lābha danya labhya āśrayaḥ eva śakyaḥ iti arthaḥ tattvam iti āśraya tvam iti arthaḥ

original: āśrayatvamātremeti śakyatā'vacchedakasya kartrādisādhāraṇyāt karaṇatṛtīyāyāśca vyāpāro'pityapinā āśrayārthatvapratipādanāditi bhāvaḥ| karttṛkarmadvāreti etādṛśārthalābhaśca tatsūtrasāmarthyādeva|
analyzed: āśraya tva mātra īmā iti śakyatā avacchedakasya kartṛ ādi sādhāraṇyāt karaṇa tṛtīyāyāḥ ca āśraya artha tva pratipādanāt iti bhāvaḥ karttṛ karma dvārā iti etādṛśa artha lābhaḥ ca tad sūtra sāmarthyāt eva

original: tathāhi-kārakādhikārīyeṇaitena kriyā'nvayyārasyādhikaraṇasaṃjñā vidhīyate| kriyāca dhātvarthaḥ| sākṣāttadādhārayoḥ parābhyāṃ karttṛkarmasaṃjñābhyāmākrāntatvādidaṃ sūtramanavakāśaṃ sat paramparayā dhātvarthaśrayasyādhikaraṇasaṃjñāvidhānena caritārtham, paramparāghaṭake ca kartṛkarmaṇī eveti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: tathā ahi kāraka adhikārīyeṇa etena kriyā anvayi ārasya adhikaraṇa saṃjñā vidhīyate kriyā ca dhātvarthaḥ sākṣāt tad ādhārayoḥ parābhyām karttṛ karma saṃjñābhyām ākrānta tvāt idam sūtram anavakāśam sat paramparayā dhātvartha śrayasya adhikaraṇa saṃjñā vidhānena caritārtham paramparā ghaṭake ca kartṛ karmaṇī eva iti bhāvaḥ

original: parayā karmasaṃjñayā bādhādeva `mokṣe icchāsti' itivanmokṣe icchati bhavatīti na prayogaḥ|
analyzed: parayā karma saṃjñayā bādhāt eva mokṣe icchā asti iti vat mokṣe icchati bhavati iti na prayogaḥ

original: aupaśleṣikamiti saṃyokasambandhanibandhanamityarthaḥ| sāmīpyasyāpi saṃyuktasaṃyogarūpatayā saṃyogapadena tasyāpi saṅgrahāt ādheyavyāpyatā'vacchedakayatkiñcidavayavakamityarthaḥ|
analyzed: aupaśleṣikam iti saṃyoka sambandha nibandhanam iti arthaḥ sāmīpyasya api saṃyukta saṃyoga rūpatayā saṃyoga padena tasya api saṅgrahāt ādheya vyāpya tā avacchedaka yat kiñcid avayavakam iti arthaḥ

original: vaiṣayikamiti viṣayatāsambandhanibandhanamittharthaḥ| abhivyāpakamiti ādheyavyāpyatāvacchedakayāvadavayavakamityarthaḥ| tatrādyasya kaṭe śete, gurau vasatītyudāharaṇe| dvitīyasya mokṣe icchāstīti, antyasyāntyam| `kaṭe śete' ityatra paramparayā kaṭābhinnāśrayakaḥ śayanānukūlo vyāpāra iti bodhaḥ| evamanyatrā'pyūhyam|
analyzed: vaiṣayikam iti viṣayatā sambandha nibandhanam ittharthaḥ abhivyāpakam iti ādheya vyāpya tā avacchedaka yāvat avayavakam iti arthaḥ tatra ādyasya kaṭe śete gurau vasati iti udāharaṇe dvitīyasya mokṣe icchā asti iti antyasya antyam kaṭe śete iti atra paramparayā kaṭa abhinna āśrayakaḥ śayana anukūlaḥ vyāpāraḥ iti bodhaḥ evam anyatra api ūhyam

original: bhāṣye spaṣṭamiti tatra hi saṃhitādhikārakhaṇḍanāya "ayaṃ yogaḥ śakyo'vaktum| adhikaraṇaṃ nāma triprakāram-vyāpakamaupaśleṣikaṃ vaiṣayikamiti| ik‌śabdasya ac‌śabdena ko'nyo'bhisambandho bhavitumarhatyanyadata upaśleṣāt| "ikoyaṇaci" upaśliṣṭasyeti tatrāntareṇa saṃhitāgrahaṇaṃ saṃhitāyāmeva bhaviṣyati" ityuktam|
analyzed: bhāṣye spaṣṭam iti tatra hi saṃhitā adhikāra khaṇḍanāya ayam yogaḥ śakyaḥ vaktum adhikaraṇam nāma tri prakāram vyāpakam aupaśleṣikam vaiṣayikam iti i k śabdasya a c śabdena kaḥ nyaḥ abhisambandhaḥ bhavitum arhati anyat atas upaśleṣāt upaśliṣṭasya iti tatra antareṇa saṃhitā grahaṇam saṃhitāyām eva bhaviṣyati iti uktam

original: atropaśliṣṭapadādhyāhāreṇa saptamītyarthe idameva bhāṣyaṃ| saṃhitāyāmityupalakṣaṇam-"tatra ca dīyate kāryyaṃ bhavavat" ityādisūtrasthabhāṣyavasyāpi tatrādhikaraṇatraividhyapratipādanāditi|
analyzed: atra upaśliṣṭa pada adhyāhāreṇa saptamī iti arthe idam eva bhāṣyam saṃhitāyām iti upalakṣaṇam tatra ca dīyate kāryyam bhava vat ityādi sūtra stha bhāṣya vasyā api tatra adhikaraṇa traividhya pratipādanāt iti

original: naiyāyikāstu-`saṃyogenā''dhāraḥ' samavāyenā''dhāraḥ' ityādyanugatapratītibalādādhāratvamakhaṇḍopādhiḥ| saṃyogādirūpaṃ tu na tat, kuṇḍasaṃyokino badarāderapi kuṇ‍ḍā''dhāratāpatteḥ|

original: adhyāhṛtyeti arthādhyāhārābhiprāyeṇa| padādhyāhāravāde tu ākaṅakṣitakriyovācakapadānusandhāne'pyanupāttatvarū6paviśeṣaṇaghaṭitalakṣaṇāvaikalyaṃ bodhyam| pramāṇaṃ tatraśabdādhyāhāravāde `puṣpebhyaḥ spṛhayati' ityādau spṛhayatyādiyoge sampradānādisaṃjñāvidhāyakāni `spṛherīpsitaḥ' ityādisūtrāṇi, taistattaddhātuyogeva taddhodhanāt|
analyzed: adhyāhṛtya iti artha adhyāhāra abhiprāyeṇa pada adhyāhāra vāde tu ākaṅakṣita kriyā vācaka pada anusandhāne pi anupātta tva rūpa viśeṣaṇa ghaṭita lakṣaṇā vaikalyam bodhyam pramāṇam tatra śabda adhyāhāra vāde puṣpebhyaḥ spṛhayati ityādau spṛhayati ādi yoge sampradāna ādi saṃjñā vidhāyakāni spṛheḥ īpsitaḥ ityādi sūtrāṇi taiḥ tad tad dhātu yogā iva tad hodhanāt

original: arthadhyāhāre tu `kriyārthopapadasya' ityādisūtram "lyablope" ityādivārttikāni ca|

original: caturthyarthaṃ nirūpayati-uddeśya iti nanūddeśyatvaṃ kāmanāviṣayatvam, tacca `viprāya gāṃ tatāti' ityatra kriyājanyaphalabhāgitayā kāmanāviṣaye gavādāvatiprasaktamatastadhdyāvṛttam, tatsūtraprāmāṇyena darśayati-tacca karmaṇetyādi karmaṇetyanantaraṃ sambandhumiti śeṣaḥ|
