original: yadyapi `gaurbrāhmaṇasya bhavatu' itīcchāviśeṣyatayā gāmevāvagāhate tathāpi sūtrasya phalitārthaparatvānna doṣaḥ| tathāca karmajanyatad‌vṛttiphalabhāgitvaprakārako yadviśeṣayako'bhiprāyaḥ sa sampradānamiti sūtrārthaḥ| tādṛśaphalasambandhitvaprakāratānirūpitaviśeṣyatāśraya iti yāvat|
analyzed: yadi api gauḥ brāhmaṇasya bhavatu iti icchā viśeṣyatayā gām eva avagāhate tathā api sūtrasya phalita artha paratvāt na doṣaḥ tathāca karma janya tad vṛtti phala bhāgi tva prakārakaḥ sa sampradānam iti sūtra arthaḥ tādṛśa phala sambandhi tva prakāratā nirūpita viśeṣyatā āśrayaḥ iti yāvat

original: `viprāya gāṃ tatādi' ityādau parasvatvajanakasvasvatvadhvaṃsāvacchinnecchātmakastyāgo dādhātvarthaḥ| uddeśyatvaṃ caturthyarthaḥ| (nirukvaviśeṣyatāśrayarūpasya tasya svavṛttiviśeṣyatānirūpakatvasambandhena tyāge'nvayaḥ) gorūpakarmaṇaścā''śrayatvena svatvarūpaphale|
analyzed: viprāya gām tata ādi ityādau para svatva janaka sva sva tva dhvaṃsa avacchinna icchā ātmakaḥ tyāgaḥ dā dhātvarthaḥ uddeśya tvam caturthī arthaḥ nirukva viśeṣyatā āśraya rūpasya tasya sva vṛtti viśeṣyatā nirūpaka tva sambandhena tyāga anvayaḥ go rūpa karmaṇaḥ ca āśraya tvena sva tva rūpa phale

original: tathāca govṛttisvatvajanakasvasvatvadhvaṃsānukūlo viprābhinnoddeśyakastyāga iti vaiyākaraṇamate bodhaḥ| uddeśyatvaṃ ca vipre gojanyasvatvabhāgitayecchāviṣayatvameva, evaṃ vṛkṣāyodakamāsiñcatītyatrāpyudakaniṣṭhakriyājanyasaṃyogaphalabhāgitayecchāviṣayatvāt sampradānatvamūhyam|

original: naiyāyikāstu-parasvatvecchādhīnasvasvatvadhvaṃsecchātyāga iti mate svasvatvadhvaṃsāvacchinnatyāgo dadātyartha-| viśeṣyatvaṃ caturthyarthaḥ| tasya svanirūpakaniruktecchājanyatvasambandhena dadātyarthatyāge gorūpakarmaṇastvādheyatayā svasvatvadhvaṃsarūpaphale|

original: tathāca govṛttisvasvatvadhvaṃsajanako niruktasambandena vipraniṣṭhaviśeṣyatāviśiṣṭo yastyāgastadāśrayaścai iti `viprāya gāṃ dadāti caitraḥ' vākyād bodhaḥ|

original: yadi tu gaurviprasya bhavatu mametīcchaiva tyāgaḥ, saca gavi svasvatvadhvaṃsamiva parasvatvamapi avagāhate tadā svasvatvadhvaṃsapūrvakaparasvatvotpattyavacchinnatyāgau dādhātvarthaḥ| eva़ñca uktasthale nirūpitatvenecchāviṣayatvaṃ caturtharyarthaḥ|

original: tasya ca svasvatvadhvaṃse'nvayād vipranirūpitatvena icchāviṣayagovṛttisvasvatvadhvaṃsapūrvakaparasvatvotpattyavacchinnatyāgā''śraya iti bodhaḥ| janyasvatvasya govṛttitve'vagate'rthāttasmiṃstajjanyatvaṃ labhyate eveti gojanyasvatvanirūpakatvenecchāviṣayatvarūpamuddeśyatvaṃ viprasyākṣatam|

original: vṛkṣāyodakamāsiñcatītyatra tu saṃyogāvacchinnadravadravyakriyāvacchinnavyāpāro dhātvarthaḥ. vṛttittvecchāviṣayatvaṃ caturthyarthaḥ| sa ca dhātvarthatāvacchedakasaṃyogānvayī| dvitīyārthavṛttitvaṃ tu dravadravyakriyānvayi|
analyzed: vṛkṣāya udakam āsiñcati iti atra tu saṃyoga avacchinna drava dravya kriyā avacchinna vyāpāraḥ dhātvarthaḥ vṛtti ttva icchā viṣaya tvam caturthī arthaḥ sa ca dhātvartha tā avacchedaka saṃyoga anvayī dvitīyārtha vṛtti tvam tu drava dravya kriyā anvayi

original: nacaivaṃ sicadhātvarthatvarthatāvacchedakadravadravyakriyāyāṃ dvitīyārthavṛttitvānyavaye payasā vṛkṣaṃ siñcatīti na syāt, tādṛśakriyāyā vṛkṣāvṛttitvāditi vācyam| tatra saṃyogāvacchinnadravyākriyāyā eva dhātvarthatayā tadavacchedakībhūtasaṃyoga eva vṛkṣavṛttitvānvayānnānupapattirityāhuḥ|

original: atra cutarthodvitīyābhyāṃ tulyabodhajananttatra dvitīyā mā bhūditi sampradānasaṃjñānuśiṣyate| vṛkṣaṃ payasā siñcatītyādau tu vṛkṣaśabdāt dvitīyā bhavatyeva| tatra tṛtīyārtho'bhedastasya dravadravye'nvayaḥ| dvitīyārthavṛttitvasya tu saṃyoge'nvayaḥ| tathāca vṛkṣavṛttisaṃyogānukūlodakābhinnadravyākriyeti bodhaḥ|
analyzed: atra tulya bodha janan tatra dvitīyā mā bhūt iti sampradāna saṃjñā anuśiṣyate vṛkṣam payasā siñcati ityādau tu vṛkṣa śabdāt dvitīyā bhavati eva tatra tṛtīyā arthaḥ bhedaḥ tasya drava dravya anvayaḥ dvitīyārtha vṛtti tvasya tu saṃyoga invayaḥ tathāca vṛkṣa vṛtti saṃyoga anukūla udaka abhinna dravya akriyā iti bodhaḥ

original: `śatrave'straṃ muñcati' atra duḥkhoddeśyakatvaṃ cuturthyarthaḥ| mocanaṃ vibhāgāvacchinnakriyā, kriyānukūlavyāpāro vā| prakṛtyarthasya vṛttitvena caturthyarthaikadese duḥkhe'nvayaḥ| evaṃ mitrāya dūtaṃ preṣayatītyatra vārttādānoddeśyakatvam| putrāya dhanaṃ preṣayatītyatra prītyuddeśyakatvaṃ caturthyartha ityādyūhyamityāhuḥ|
analyzed: muñcati atra duḥkha uddeśyakatvam cuturthī arthaḥ mocanam vibhāga avacchinna kriyā kriyā anukūla vyāpāraḥ vā prakṛti arthasya vṛtti tvena caturthī artha ekadeśe duḥkha invayaḥ evam mitrāya dūtam preṣayati iti atra vārttā dāna uddeśyakatvam putrāya dhanam preṣayati iti atra prīti uddeśyakatvam caturthī arthaḥ ityādi ūhyam iti āhuḥ

original: tanna samyak, sampradāne hi caturthi| naca bhavaduktasampradānatve kiñcinmānam yena vṛkṣāyetyatra caturtho syāt| kiñca saṃyogarūpadhātvarthānvayitvāviśeṣādudakapadādapi caturthyāpattiḥ| bādhakaṃ karmatvaṃ tu vṛkṣe'pyakṣatamiti na kiñcidetat| idameveti niruktoddeśyatvamevetyarthaḥ| pūrvatantre mīmāṃsāyām|
analyzed: tat na samyak sampradāne hi caturthi na ca bhavat ukta sampradānatve kiñcid mānam yena vṛkṣāya iti atra syāt kiñca saṃyoga rūpa dhātvartha anvayi tva aviśeṣāt udaka padāt api caturthī āpattiḥ bādhakam karmatvam tu vṛkṣe pi akṣatam iti na kiñcid etat idam eva iti nirukta uddeśyatvam eva iti arthaḥ pūrva tantre mīmāṃsāyām

original: ata evetati śeṣitvasyārthakarmaprayojakatvādevetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: atas eva ita iti śeṣi tvasya artha karma prayojaka tvāt eva iti arthaḥ

original: prāsanavaditi "prāsanavanmaitrāvaruṇāya daṇḍapradānaṃ kṛtārthatvāt" ityādhikaraṇe ityarthaḥ| prāsanadṛṣṭāntaścaivam jyodiṣṭome śrūyate "nītāsu dakṣiṇāsu cātvāle kṛṣṇaviṣāṇaṃ prāsyati" iti| yadā yajamānena dattā dakṣiṇā ṛtvigbhirnātāstadā yajamānaḥ svahaste dhṛtaṃ kṛṣṇamṛgaśrṛṅgaṃ cātvālanāmakagartte prakṣipediti tadarthaḥ|
analyzed: prāsana vat iti prāsana vat maitrāvaruṇāya daṇḍa pradānam kṛtārtha tvāt iti ādhikaraṇe iti arthaḥ prāsana dṛṣṭāntaḥ ca evam jyodiṣṭome śrūyate nītāsu dakṣiṇāsu cātvāle kṛṣṇaviṣāṇam prāsyati iti yadā yajamānena dattāḥ dakṣiṇāḥ ṛtvigbhiḥ nātāḥ tadā yajamānaḥ sva haste dhṛtam kṛṣṇa mṛga śrṛṅgam cātvāla nāmaka gartte prakṣipet iti tad arthaḥ

original: tatraivaṃ sandihyate-kimetat prāsanamarthakarma, pratipattikarmeti vā? arthakarmaiva bhavitumarhati, saprayojanatvāt| pratipattitāyāṃ tu apūrvābhāve nirarthakameva syāditi pūrvāpakṣe-"kṛṣṇaviṣāṇayā kaṇḍuyati" iti śrutyā kṛtārthasya pratipattyapekṣatvāt pratipattikarmataiva yuktā|
analyzed: tatra evam sandihyate kim etat prāsanam artha karma pratipatti karma iti vā artha karma eva bhavitum arhati sa prayojana tvāt pratipatti tāyām tu apūrva abhāve nirarthakam eva syāt iti pūrvāpakṣe kṛṣṇaviṣāṇayā kaṇḍuyati iti śrutyā kṛtārthasya pratipatti apekṣa tvāt pratipatti karmatā eva yuktā

original: nacānarthakyam, prāsanakriyāprayuktāpūrvābhāve'pi cātvāla eveti niyamāpūrvasadbhāvāditi siddhantitam| tadvuddaṇḍadānaṃ na pratipattiriti yojanā| ityadhikaraṇa iti caturthādhyāya iti śeṣaḥ|
analyzed: na ca ānarthakyam prāsana kriyā prayukta apūrva abhāve pi cātvāle eva iti niyama apūrva sadbhāvāt iti siddhantitam na pratipattiḥ iti yojanā iti adhikaraṇe iti caturtha adhyāye iti śeṣaḥ

original: jyotiṣṭomaṃ prakṛtyaiva some dīkṣitāya daṇḍaṃ prayacchatīti daṇḍasya dīkṣābhivyāñjakatvaṃ vidhāyakrīye some " maitrāvarūṇāya daṇḍaṃ prayacchati" iti śrūyate|
analyzed: jyotiṣṭomam prakṛtyā eva some dīkṣitāya daṇḍam prayacchati iti daṇḍasya dīkṣā abhivyāñjaka tvam vidhāyakrīye some maitrāvarūṇāya daṇḍam prayacchati iti śrūyate

original: tū daṇḍadānasyārthapratipattikarmabhāvasandehe'dhyavaryuṇā dīkṣāsiddhayai dattadaṇḍasyāsomakrayādyajamānadhāraṇena kṛtārthatvādupayuktasya tasya dānaṃ pratipattikarmaiveti pūrvapakṣe, " daṇḍī praiṣānanvāha" iti śravaṇānmaitrāvaruṇasya praiṣānuvāde'valambanāya daṇḍopekṣitaḥ.
analyzed: dīkṣā siddhayai datta daṇḍasya artha pratipatti karma bhāva sandeha idhya varyuṇā dīkṣā siddhayai datta daṇḍasya a soma krayāt yajamāna dhāraṇena kṛtārtha tvāt upayuktasya tasya dānam pratipatti karma eva iti pūrvapakṣe daṇḍī praiṣān anvāha iti śravaṇāt maitrāvaruṇasya praiṣa anuvāda avalambanāya daṇḍa upekṣitaḥ

original: eva़ñca bhaviṣyadupayogasadbhāvāt dānavyāpyamānadaṇḍayāpyamānatvena maitrāvaruṇasya prādhānyācca daṇḍadānasya pratipattikarmaṇa upayuktasaṃskārarūpādarthakammaivopayokṣyamāṇasaṃskārarūpatvena prāśastyāccārthakarmataivocitā,upayojayitumeva sarvatra saṃskārapravṛtteḥ|
analyzed: evam ca bhaviṣyat upayoga sadbhāvāt dāna vyāpyamāna daṇḍa yāpyamāna tvena maitrāvaruṇasya prādhānyāt ca daṇḍa dānasya pratipatti karmaṇaḥ upayukta saṃskāra rūpāt artha kammā eva upayokṣyamāṇa saṃskāra rūpa tvena prāśastyāt ca artha karmatā eva ucitā upayojayitum eva sarvatra saṃskāra pravṛtteḥ

original: upayukte tu pratipattirūpasaṃskārasya satkāramātraparyyavasāyitvena kāryaparyāvasānābhāvādapraśastatvamato maitrāvaruṇasaṃskārāya taddānamarthakarma| tathā sati nirūḍhapaśau asatyapi dīkṣite daṇḍasampādanasyaivaitad dānaprayojakamiti siddhāntitam|
analyzed: upayukte tu pratipatti rūpa saṃskārasya satkāra mātra paryyavasāyi tvena kārya paryāvasāna abhāvāt apraśasta tvam atas maitrāvaruṇa saṃskārāya tat dānam artha karma tathā sati nirūḍhapaśau asati api dīkṣite daṇḍa sampādanasya eva etat dāna prayojakam iti siddhāntitam

original: arthakarmatve ca śeṣitvaṃ prayojakam| tacca caturthiśrutyā maitrāvaruṇasya bodhyata ityāha-caturthiśrutyeti nanu yatra dādhāturadhīnīkaraṇādyarthakastatrādhinatvādirūpaphalanirūpakatayecchāviṣayatvarūpasampradānatvasya rajākadāvapi sambhavāt "rajakāya vastraṃ dadāti" "hotre uṣṭraṃ dadāti" ityādiprayogāḥ prasajjyerannityāśaṅkāmiṣṭāpattyā
analyzed: artha karma tve ca śeṣi tvam prayojakam tat ca caturthi śrutyā maitrāvaruṇasya bodhyate iti āha caturthi śrutyā iti nanu yatra dādhātuḥ adhīnīkaraṇa ādi arthakaḥ tatra icchā viṣaya tva rūpa sampradāna tvasya rajākadau api sambhavāt rajakāya vastram dadāti hotre uṣṭram dadāti ityādi prayogāḥ prasajjyeran iti āśaṅkām iṣṭāpattyā

original: pariharati-rajakāyeti| tatra pramāṇamupanyasyati-khaṇḍikopādhyāya iti| dadātīti dādhātvarthasaṃyogasambandhitvenecchāviṣayatvarūpoddesyatvasya tatra sattvāditi tadbhāvaḥ| asmin prayoge dadātiḥ saṃyogānukūlavyāpārārthakaḥ| capeṭāpadārthastu prasṛtakaratalam| " na śūdrāya matiṃ dadyāt" ityatra dadātirbodhanārthakaḥ|
analyzed: pariharati rajakāya iti tatra pramāṇam upanyasyati khaṇḍika upādhyāyaḥ iti dadāti iti tatra sattvāt iti tad bhāvaḥ asmin prayoge dadātiḥ saṃyoga anukūla vyāpāra arthakaḥ capeṭā padārthaḥ tu prasṛta kara talam na śūdrāya matim dadyāt iti atra dadātiḥ bodhana arthakaḥ

original: matipadārthaśca tajjnakaṃ vedādiśāstramiti bodhyam|
analyzed: mati padārthaḥ ca veda ādi śāstram iti bodhyam

original: svasvatvanivattiti parasvatvotpattyavacchinnasvasvatvadhvaṃsecchārūpaṃ vyāpāram| artham dādhātvarthamityarthaḥ| tathācoktarāthakadādhātvarthakarmaniṣṭhaphalabhāgitayecchāviṣayatvameva sampradānatvam| anvarthamahāsaṃjñākaraṇasāmarthyāduktasthale ca dadātestadarthakatvābhāvena rajakasya vastraṃ dadātītyeveti teṣāmāśayaḥ|
analyzed: sva sva tva nivattiti para sva tva utpatti avacchinna sva sva tva dhvaṃsa icchā rūpam vyāpāram artham dādhātu artham iti arthaḥ tathā ca ukta rāthaka dādhātu artha karma niṣṭha phala bhāgitayā icchā viṣayatvam eva sampradāna tvam anvartha mahāsaṃjñā karaṇa sāmarthyāt ukta sthale ca dadāteḥ tad arthaka tva abhāvena rajakasya vastram dadāti iti eva iti teṣām āśayaḥ

original: uktabhāṣyaprāmāṇyādanvarthatvamevāsiddham| mahāsaṃjñākaraṇaṃ tu prācāmanurodhādeva, sarvanāmasthānasaṃjñāvadityasvarasādāha āhuriti|
analyzed: ukta bhāṣya prāmāṇyāt anvartha tvam eva asiddham mahāsaṃjñākaraṇam tu prācām anurodhāt eva sarvanāmasthāna saṃjñā vat iti asvarasāt āha āhuḥ iti

original: nanvajāṃ grāmaṃ nayatītyatrājāyāṃ niruktasampradānasya sattvāttadvācakāccaturthyāpattiriti cet syādeva yadi parayā karmmasaṃjñāyā sampradānatvasya na bādha iti| `yūpāya dāru' ityādau na sampradānacaturtho, api tu tādarthye| tādarthyañca-sa evārthaḥ prayojanamasya tattvām|
analyzed: nanu ajām grāmam nayati iti atra ajāyām nirukta sampradānasya sattvāt tad vācakāt caturthī āpattiḥ iti ced syāt eva yadi parayā karmma saṃjñāyā sampradāna tvasya na bādhaḥ iti yūpāya dāru ityādau na sampradāna caturthaḥ api tu tādarthye tādarthyam ca saḥ eva arthaḥ prayojanam asya tat tvām

original: samabhivyāhṛtārthe tādarthyavivakṣāyāṃ tadvācakāccaturthiti `tādarthye caturthī vācyā' iti vārttikārthaḥ|
analyzed: samabhivyāhṛta arthe tādarthya vivakṣāyām tad vācakāt caturthī iti tādarthye caturthī vācyā iti vārttika arthaḥ

original: prayojanatvañca na janyatvam, duḥkhāya pāpamityasyāpyāpatteḥ| nāpi janyatayecchāviṣayatvam, svargādeḥ puṇyādijanyatayecchāviṣayatvena svargāya puṇyamityāpatteḥ| naceṣṭāpattiḥ, tathā sati paktuṃ vrajatītyrathe `pākāya vrajati' iti prayoganirvāhāya "tumarthācca" itisūtrapraṇayanavaiyartyāpatteḥ|
analyzed: prayojana tvam ca na janya tvam duḥkhāya pāpam iti asya api āpatteḥ nā api janyatayā icchā viṣaya tvam svarga ādeḥ puṇya ādi janya tayā icchā viṣaya tvena svargāya puṇyam iti āpatteḥ na ca iṣṭa āpattiḥ tathā sati paktum vrajati iti rathe pākāya vrajati iti prayoga nirvāhāya tumarthāt ca iti sūtra praṇayana vaiyartya āpatteḥ

original: pākāderniruktavrajanādyarthatayaiva tadvācakādvārttikena caturthyupapatteḥ| api tu samabhivyāhṛtapadār‌thaniṣṭhavyāpārecchānusūlecchāviṣayatvam| tatprayojanakatvarūpaṃ tādarthyaṃ tu tadicchādhīnecchāviṣayavyāpārāśrayatvam| dāruṇo yūpecchādhīnecchāviṣayatakṣaṇādirūpavyāpāravattaya yūpārthatvāttadvivakṣayā vūpapādaccaturthī|
analyzed: pāka ādeḥ nirukta vrajana ādi arthatayā eva tad vācakāt vārttikena caturthī upapatteḥ api tu samabhivyāhṛta padārtha niṣṭha vyāpāra icchā anusūla icchā viṣayatvam tad prayojanaka tva rūpam tādarthyam tu tad icchā adhīna icchā viṣaya vyāpāra āśraya tvam dāruṇaḥ yūpa icchā adhīna icchā viṣaya takṣaṇa ādi rūpa vyāpāravattaya yūpa artha tvāt tad vivakṣayā

original: tadarthaścecchādhīnecchāviṣayavyāpārāśrayatvam| prathamecchāyāṃ yūpādeḥ pravṛtyarthasya viṣayitvenānvayaḥ| tasyā''śrayatayā dārvādau, evaṃ randhanāya sthālītyādāvapyahyamiti kecit,
analyzed: tad arthaḥ ca icchā adhīna icchā viṣaya vyāpāra āśraya tvam prathama icchāyām yūpa ādeḥ pravṛti arthasya viṣayi tvena anvayaḥ tasya āśraya tayā dārva ādau evam randhanāya sthālī ityādau api ahyam iti kecid

original: nanna manoramam, tadārthyasyoktarūpatve sukkaye hariṃ bhajatītyatra caturthyanupapatteḥ| nahi bhajanasya muktīcchādhīnecchāviṣayavyāpāravattā nāpi mukteḥ sampradānatā, karmajanyaphalabhāgitayānuddśyatvāt| tasmāttadicchādhīnecchāviṣayatvameva tattādarthyam| svārgāya puṇyamityāstviṣyanta eva|
analyzed: nan na manoramam tadārthyasya ukta rūpatve sukkaye harim bhajati iti atra caturthī anupapatteḥ nahi bhajanasya mukti icchā adhīna icchā viṣaya vyāpāravat tā nā api mukteḥ sampradāna tā karma janya phala bhāgi tayā anuddūya tvāt tasmāt tad icchā adhīna icchā viṣaya tvam eva tat tādarthyam svārgāya puṇyam ityāḥ tu iṣyante eva

original: vārttikaṃ dṛṣṭvā sūtrakṛto'pravṛtterna "tumarthāt" iti sūtrānupapattirapīti| namaḥsvastyādiśabdayoge'pi tadarthaviseṣavācakāt "namaḥ svasti" sūtreṇa caturthī vidhīyate| tatra namaḥpadārthastyāgo natiśca| tatra natiḥ svāpakarṣabodhanānukūlo vyāpāraḥ| `haraye nāmaḥ `eṣo'rghaḥ śivāya namaḥ" ityādau tyāgaḥ| caturthyā ca tatroddeśyayatvaṃ pratyāyyate|
analyzed: vārttikam dṛṣṭvā sūtra kṛtā upravṛtteḥ na tumun arthāt iti sūtra anupapattiḥ api iti namaḥ svasti ādi śabda yoge pi tad artha viseṣa vācakāt namaḥ svasti sūtreṇa caturthī vidhīyate tatra namaḥ padārthaḥ tyāgaḥ natiḥ ca tatra natiḥ sva apakarṣa bodhana anukūlaḥ vyāpāraḥ haraye nāmaḥ śivāya namaḥ ityādau tyāgaḥ caturthyā ca tatra uddeśya ya tvam pratyāyyate

original: tyāgaśca yadi śivasyāyaṃ bhavatviti phalecchādhīno na mametyākārakaḥ svasvatvecchābhāvarūpastadā taduddeśyatvaṃ tyāgajanakeccāyāḥ svatvabhāgitayā viṣayatvam|
analyzed: tyāgaḥ ca yadi śivasya ayam bhavatu iti phala icchā adhīnaḥ na mama iti ākārakaḥ sva svatva icchā bhāva rūpaḥ tadā tad uddeśya tvam tyāga janaka iccāyāḥ svatva bhāgi tayā viṣaya tvam

original: yadi tyāgarūpecchaivānyadīyatvena tyajyamānagataṃ svatvamapi viṣayīkaroti tadā svatvabhāgitayā viṣayatvameva taduddeśyatvam, natu svīkārāśrayatvam, śivādervigrahavato'pi svīkārābhāvāttadākārakatayā dhyātasya mantrasya tyāgoddaśyatāmate tadabhāvācca|
analyzed: yadi tyāga rūpa icchā eva anyadīyatvena tyajyamāna gatam svatvam api viṣayīkaroti tadā svatva bhāgitayā viṣayatvam eva tad uddeśyatvam na tu svīkāra āśrayatvam śiva ādeḥ vigrahavataḥ api svīkāra abhāvāt tad ākāraka tayā dhyātasya mantrasya tyāga uddaśyatā mate tad abhāvāt ca

original: tyajyamānopacārādau śivādinirūpitasvatvābhāve'pi tadīyatvena tatra dravye svatvāvagāhinicchāvisaṃvādirūpaiva| anyadīyasvatve bādhitaṃ śivādinirūpitatvaṃ śivādīnirūpitaprasiddhasvatvāntare vā bādhinaṃ tad‌dravyāsambandhamavagāhate|
analyzed: tyajyamāna upacāra ādau śiva ādi nirūpita sva tva abhāve pi tadīya tvena tatra dravye svatva avagāhin icchā visaṃvādi rūpā eva anyadīya svatve bādhitam śiva ādi nirūpita tvam śiva ādī nirūpita prasiddha sva tva antare vā bādhinam tat dravya asambandham avagāhate

original: tatra prathame svatvaprakārakecchājanyatvaṃ janyatāsambandhena tādṛśeccāvattvaṃ vā caturthyarthaḥ| tatra prakṛtyarthasya śivāderviṣayatāviśeṣasambandhenānvayaḥ| dvitīye viṣayatāviśeṣa eva saḥ| tatra ca prakṛtyarthaśivādernirūpitatvasambandhenānvayaḥ| namaḥ-padārthatyāgasya vi,yatāviseṣasambandhenārghādidravye'ḍanvayaḥ|
analyzed: tatra prathame sva tva prakāraka icchā janya tvam janyatā sambandhena tādṛśa iccāvat tvam vā caturthī arthaḥ tatra prakṛti arthasya śiva ādeḥ viṣayatā viśeṣa sambandhena anvayaḥ dvitīye viṣayatā viśeṣaḥ eva saḥ tatra ca prakṛti artha śiva ādeḥ nirūpita tva sambandhena anvayaḥ namaḥ padārtha tyāgasya argha ādi dravya iṭ anvayaḥ

original: dravyasyaiva vā viśeṣyatayā bhāsamānatyāge'nvayaḥ| śivāyotsṛjatītyādāviva nātrānirākarttṛsampradānatā, namaḥpadasyādhātutvāt|

original: saṃsṛṣṭārtha samarthamiti bhāṣyakārokteḥ, saṃsargasya pṛthagupasthitinibandhanatvāt parasparavyapekṣaiva sāmarthyam| "isusoḥ sāmarthye" ityatra samartapadasya tādṛśārthakatvasya sarvairevāṅgīkārāt, parāṅgavadbhāvānurodhāccha| anyathā samāsādāvekārthobhāva; parāṅgavadbhāvādau vyapekṣeti vākyabhedāpatteḥ|

original: tatra vyapekṣā'nādare tu "ṛtena mitrāvaruṇāvṛtāvṛdhāvṛtaspṛśau" ityādāvṛtenetyādeḥ parāṅgavdbhāve sati "āmantritasya ca" ityādyudāttatā''pattiḥ|

original: naca "tannimittagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam" iti vārtikenā'mantritārtasya yannimittaṃ tad‌vācakameva parāṅgavadityarthakena niyamitatvāt parāṅgavadbhāvāprasaktiriti vācyam, samarthaparibhāṣāmāśritya tatpratyākhyānasyaivaṃ nyāyyatvāt| "ṛtena mitrāvaruṇo" ityetayoḥ samabhivyāhṛtakriyānvayitvena parasparamasāmarthyāt "mitrāvaruṇāvṛtaspṛśo
analyzed: na ca tad nimitta grahaṇam karttavyam iti vārtikena āmantrita ārtasya yat nimittam tat vācakam eva para aṅga vat iti arthakena niyamita tvāt para aṅga vat bhāva aprasaktiḥ iti vācyam samartha paribhāṣām āśritya tad pratyākhyānasya evam nyāyya tvāt ṛtena mitrāvaruṇau iti etayoḥ samabhivyāhṛta kriyā anvayi tvena parasparam asāmarthyāt mitrāvaruṇau ṛta spṛśaḥ iti

original: etayostu pārṣṭhikānvayabodhasattvādastayeva sāmārthayam, spaṣṭaṃ cedaṃ vedabhāṣye| ata evānanatarapāṭho'pi caritārthaḥ| `pūtro rājñaḥ puruṣo devadattasya' ityādau niruktavyapekṣārūpasāmarthyābhāvādeva samāsāprasakteḥ|
analyzed: etayoḥ tu pārṣṭhika anvaya bodha sattvāt astayā iva sāma arthayam spaṣṭam ca idam veda bhāṣye atas eva ananatara pāṭhaḥ api caritārthaḥ pūtraḥ rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ devadattasya ityādau nirukta vyapekṣā rūpa sāmarthya abhāvāt eva samāsa aprasakteḥ

original: samarthasūtrārthastu padasambandī samāsādividhiḥ sākṣātparamparayā vā svaprayojyaviṣayatānirūpivaviṣayatāprayojakatvarūpavyapekṣā'paranāmakasāmarthyavatpadā'śrito bodhya iti bahuvrīhau citra'diviṣayatāyāḥ sākṣātpratyojakatvābhāvātparamparayeti|
analyzed: samartha sūtra arthaḥ tu pada sambandī samāsa ādi vidhiḥ sākṣāt paramparayā vā sva prayojya viṣayatā nirūpi va viṣayatā prayojaka tva rūpa vyapekṣā para nāmaka sāmarthyavat pada āśritaḥ bodhyaḥ iti bahuvrīhau citra ādi viṣayatāyāḥ sākṣāt pratyojaka tva abhāvāt paramparayā iti

original: kiñca vṛttitvāvacchedanaikārthobhāvavādimate svavayavārthātiriktārthābhidhāyakatvarūpavṛttilakṣaṇasya karmadhāraye'vyāptiḥ, tatrāvayavārthātiriktārthavattvābhāvāt| vṛttitvasāmānādikaraṇyena tu rathantarā'diśuddharūḍhe paṅkajādiyogarūḍhe ca kośā'disiddhāyāḥ samudāyaśakterasmābirapyabhyupagamena siddhasādhanāt|
analyzed: kiñca vṛtti tva avacchedana ekārthaḥ bhāva vādi mate sva avayava artha atirikta artha abhidhāyakatva rūpa vṛtti lakṣaṇasya karmadhāraye vyāptiḥ tatra avayava artha atirikta arthavattva abhāvāt vṛtti tva sāmānādikaraṇyena tu rathantara ādi śuddha rūḍhe paṅkaja ādi yoga rūḍhe ca kośa ādi siddhāyāḥ samudāya śakteḥ asmābiḥ api abhyupagamena siddhasādhanāt

original: śuddhayogikacitragvādisamudāye śaktayabhyupagamastu kośā''dyanuktatvātsamāsaghaṭakapratyekapadavṛttyaivopapatteśca heya iti tadabhisandhiḥ| śaktikalpanānupapattyabhāvaṃ tatprayojanatayā darśayati-rājapūruṣa ityādāviti atra rājapūruṣapadamaśrūyamāṇavibhaktipūrvapadakaṣaṣṭhīsamāsaparam, tena `dāsyāḥ putraḥ' ityādyaluk‌samāse na doṣaḥ|
analyzed: śuddha yogika citragu ādi samudāye śakti abhyupagamaḥ tu kośa ādi anuktatvāt samāsa ghaṭaka pratyeka pada vṛttyā eva upapatteḥ ca heyaḥ iti tad abhisandhiḥ śakti kalpanā anupapatti abhāvam tad prayojanatayā darśayati rāja pūruṣaḥ ityādau iti atra rāja pūruṣa padam aśrūyamāṇa vibhakti pūrva padaka ṣaṣṭhī samāsa param tena dāsyāḥ putraḥ ityādi aluk samāse na doṣaḥ

original: naca sambandha eva lakṣyo'stvevañca vyāsasamāsayoḥ samānākārabodhakatvapravādo'pyupapatsyate| rājā''disambandharūpalakṣyārthasyottarapadārthe āśrayatayā'nvayenaivopapattau sambandini lakṣaṇā'bhyupagame prayojanābhāvaśceti vācyam, `rājā pūruṣaḥ' ityādāvapi rājādipadārthasya svasvāmibhāvasambandhena śābdabuddhiṃ prati viśeṣyatāsambandena
analyzed: naca sambandhaḥ eva vyāsa samāsayoḥ samāna ākāra bodhaka tva pravādaḥ upi upapatsyate rāja ādi sambandha rūpa lakṣya arthasya uttara padārthe āśrayatayā anvayena eva upapattau sambandini lakṣaṇa abhyupagame prayojana abhāvaḥ ca iti vācyam rājā pūruṣaḥ ityādau api rāja ādi padārthasya sva svāmi bhāva sambandhena śābda buddhim prati viśeṣya tā sambandena

original: pratyayanipātānyatarajanyopastiterhetutvāsyāvaśyakatayā prakṛte rājasambandarūpanāmārthasya pratyayanipātānyatarānupasthite pūruṣādāvanvayāsambhavāt nipātātiriktatvaviśeṣaṇāte `candra iva mukham' ityādāvivapadārthasādṛśyasya nāmārthasya pratyayajanyāpasthityaviṣete mukhe nipātātiriktanāmārthacandrasya tathopasthityaviṣaye sādṛśye'pi na kṣatiḥ|
analyzed: pratyaya nipāta anyatara janya upastiteḥ hetu tva asya āvaśyaka tayā prakṛte rāja sambanda rūpa nāmārthasya pratyaya nipāta anyatara anupasthite pūruṣa ādau anvaya asambhavāt candraḥ iva mukham ityādau iva padārtha sādṛśyasya nāmārthasya pratyaya janya apasthiti aviṣete mukhe nipāta atirikta nāmārtha candrasya tathā upasthiti aviṣaye sādṛśye api na kṣatiḥ

original: abhedātiriktasambandāvacchinnatvasya prakāratāyāṃ niveśāccha `rājā puruṣaḥ' ityādāvabhedānvaye'pi na sā|
analyzed: abheda atirikta sambanda avacchinna tvasya prakāratāyām niveśāt śa rājā puruṣaḥ ityādau abheda anvaye pi na sā

original: naca samasyamānātiriktatvenāpi nāmno viśeṣaṇīyatvānna prakṛte'nupapattiriti vācyam, gauravāt, kvacidagatyā saṅkoce'pi sarvatra saṅkocasayānyāyyatvācca, prakṛte sambandhilakṣaṇā'bhyupagamarūpagatisattvāta, nipātānāṃ dyotakatvanaye ghaṭādipadānāṃ ghaṭādipratiyokikalākṣiṇakatayaivopapattau vyatpattau nipātātiriktatvasyāpraveśācceti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: naca samasyamāna atirikta tvena api nāmnaḥ viśeṣaṇīya tvāt na prakṛte anupapattiḥ iti vācyam gauravāt kvacid agatyā saṅkoce pi sarvatra saṅkoca sayā anyāyya tvāt ca prakṛte sambandhi lakṣaṇa abhyupagama rūpa gati sattvāt nipātānām dyotaka tva naye ghaṭa ādi padānām ghaṭa ādi pratiyokika lākṣiṇakatayā eva upapattau nipāta atirikta tvasya apraveśāt ca iti bhāvaḥ

original: ata eveti pūrvapadasya sambandhilākṣaṇikatvādevetyarthaḥ| (na)viśeṣaṇānvaya iti "padarthaḥ padārthenānveti" iti vyutpatteriti bhāvaḥ| nanu `gabhīrāyāṃ nadyāṃ ghoṣaḥ' ityādau nadīpadalakṣyanadīdīrārthaikadeśanadyādau gabhīrādyanvayavadatrāpyekadeśānvayo durvāra iti cenna, dṛṣṭāntāsiddheḥ|
analyzed: atas eva iti pūrva padasya sambandhi lākṣaṇika tvāt eva iti arthaḥ na viśeṣaṇa anvayaḥ iti padarthaḥ padārthena anveti iti vyutpatteḥ iti bhāvaḥ nanu gabhīrāyām nadyām ghoṣaḥ ityādau nadī pada lakṣya nadīdīra artha eka deśa nadī ādau gabhīra ādi anvaya vat atra api eka deśa anvayaḥ durvāraḥ iti ced na dṛṣṭānta asiddheḥ

original: tatrāpyetanmate nadīpadasya gabhīranadīdīralakṣakatāyā gabhīrapadasya tātparyyagrāhakatāyāśca vakṣyamāṇatayā adoṣāt tādṛśavyutpatteḥ sasambandhivyatiriktaviṣayatayā caitrasya naptetyādāvekadeśānvaye'pi kṣativirahāditi|
analyzed: tatra api etad mate nadī padasya gabhīra nadīdīra lakṣaka tāyāḥ gabhīra padasya tātparyya grāhaka tāyāḥ ca vakṣyamāṇatayā adoṣāt tādṛśa vyutpatteḥ sa sambandhi vyatirikta viṣayatayā caitrasya naptā ityādau eka deśa anvaye pi kṣati virahāt iti

original: uktārthatayeti tatra nirādīnaṃ dyotakatayā kauśāmbyādipadasyaiva kauśāmbyavadhikaniṣkramaṇakartrādyarthe lakṣaṇā'bhyupagamenaivepsitārthabodhopapattau krāntādiśabdanāmupādānāsambhavādityarthaḥ| āvaśyakatvamiti tena pārāyaṇādāvadṛśṭārthakatayā spaṣṭhapratipattyarthakatayā vā tadupayoge'pi na kṣatiriti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: ukta artha tayā iti tatra nirādīnam dyotakatayā kauśāmbī ādi padasya eva kauśāmbī avadhika niṣkramaṇa kartṛ ādi arthe lakṣaṇa abhyupagamena eva īpsita artha bodha upapattau krānta ādi śabdanām upādāna asambhavāt iti arthaḥ āvaśyaka tvam iti tena pārāyaṇa ādau adṛśṭa arthakatayā spaṣṭha pratipatti arthakatayā vā tad upayoge api na kṣatiḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: pratibandīti paṅkajādipade padmatvādiviśiṣṭaśaktayabhyupagamarūpetyarthaḥ| avayavaśaktimajānato'pi ityāpinā dṛṣṭanta-dārṣṭantikayārvaiṣamyaṃ sūcyate| śaktyagrahe avayavaśaktigrahābhāve| tebhyaḥ paṅkajādipadaghaṭakāvayavebhyaḥ| viśiṣṭarthapratyaya iti padmatvādirūpeṇa padmādiboda ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: pratibandi iti paṅkaja ādi pade padma tva ādi viśiṣṭa śaktayabhyupagama rūpa iti arthaḥ avayava śaktim ajānataḥ api iti āpinā sūcyate śakti agrahe avayava śakti graha abhāve tebhyaḥ paṅkaja ādi pada ghaṭaka avayavebhyaḥ viśiṣṭa artha pratyayaḥ iti padma tva ādi rūpeṇa padma ādi bodaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: lakṣaṇāyāḥ śaktighaṭitatvāt, kintu samudāyaśaktyupastite tasminnavayavaśaktyupasthāpitapaṅkajanikarturabhedānvayopagama eveti bhāvaḥ| ata eveti| tatpadīyalakṣaṇagrahe tatpadaśaktijñānasya hetutvādevetyarthaḥ uttarapadalakṣaṇāyāṃ vinigamakamāha-yaugikatveneti| vilambitatvāt ityanena śīghropasthitikatvamuttarapadalakṣaṇāyāṃ vinigamakamiti sūcitam|
analyzed: lakṣaṇāyāḥ śakti ghaṭita tvāt kintu samudāya śakti upastite tasmin avayava śakti upasthāpita paṅkajanikartuḥ abheda anvaya upagamaḥ eva iti bhāvaḥ atas eva iti tatpadīya lakṣaṇa grahe tad pada śakti jñānasya hetutvāt eva iti arthaḥ uttara pada lakṣaṇāyām vinigamakam āha yaugika tvena iti vilambita tvāt iti anena śīghra upasthitika tvam uttara pada lakṣaṇāyām vinigamakam iti sūcitam

original: nanu vyutpattipakṣe yaugikatvamudakādipadānāmapi samamata āha-pratyayānāmiti| yathāśrutaprakṛtyarthatvasyodakādau bādhāt prakṛtyarthapadamanyathā vyācaṣṭe-sannihiteti `daṇḍinamānaya' ityādau vyavahitapadārthe-daṇḍādau karmatvādyanvayavāraṇāya sannihiteti|
analyzed: nanu vyutpatti pakṣe yaugika tvam udaka ādi padānām api samam atas āha pratyayānām iti yathāśruta prakṛti artha tvasya udaka ādau bādhāt prakṛti artha padam anyathā vyācaṣṭe sannihita iti daṇḍinam ānaya ityādau vyavahita padārthe daṇḍa ādau karma tva ādi anvaya vāraṇāya sannihita iti

original: tathāca "aṇurapi viśeṣo|ṭadhyavasāyakaraḥ" iti nyāyenottarapade eva lakṣaṇeti na bodhā'vṛttirūpadūṣaṇamapīti bhāvaḥ| pūrvaktadūṣaṇāntaramuddharati-
analyzed: tathā ca aṇuḥ api iti nyāyena uttara pade eva lakṣaṇā iti na bodha āvṛtti rūpa dūṣaṇam api iti bhāvaḥ pūrva kta dūṣaṇa antaram uddharati

original: ghaṭādipade ceti| kalpyamānā ityuktayā aklṛptatvaṃ sūcayati-viśiṣṭasyaiveti vyavahārādinā tatraiva tannidvārāṇādāta bhāvaḥ| asattvāt ityasya yena tatrāpi vinigamakagaveṣaṇā syāditi śeṣaḥ| uttarapada iti prāptādakādighaṭakodakādipade ityarthaḥ| sā lakṣaṇā| viśeṣa iti ghaṭādipadāt samāsasya lakṣaṇāyāṃ vaiṣamyamityarthaḥ|
analyzed: ghaṭa ādi pade ca iti kalpyamānāḥ iti uktayā aklṛpta tvam sūcayati viśiṣṭasya eva iti vyavahāra ādinā tatra eva bhāvaḥ asattvāt iti asya yena tatra api vinigamaka gaveṣaṇā syāt iti śeṣaḥ uttara pade iti prāpta ādaka ādi ghaṭaka udaka ādi pade iti arthaḥ sā lakṣaṇā viśeṣaḥ iti ghaṭa ādi padāt samāsasya lakṣaṇāyām vaiṣamyam iti arthaḥ

original: atredaṃ bodhyam-uktayuktayopakumbhamityādāvuttarapadasyaiva samīpādyarthe lakṣaṇā, pūrvapadaṃ tātparyyagrāhakam| tatpuruṣe'pi kvacidarddhapippaṃlītyādyekadeśini caramapadasyaiva sā pippalyarddādyarthe, itarad dyotakam| nīloppalamityādikarmaghāraye tu na kvā'pi sā, pratyekapadaśaktyupasthitayorabedānvayasaulabhyāt|
analyzed: atrā idam bodhyam ukta yuktayā upakumbham ityādau uttara padasya eva samīpa ādi arthe lakṣaṇā pūrva padam tātparyya grāhakam tatpuruṣe api kvacid arddhapippaṃlī ityādi eka deśini carama padasya eva sā pippalī arddha ādi arthe itarat dyotakam nīla uppalam iti ādi karma ghāraye tu na kvāpi sā pratyeka pada śakti upasthitayoḥ a beda anvaya saulabhyāt

original: bahuvrīhau tūttarapada eva seti sāra eva vyaktam| pāṇipādamityādidvandve sāhatyāpannapratyekapadārthayāruttarapadasyaiva sā| ata eva dvivacanādyarthadvitvādyanvayastatra| samāhāradvandve sāhityaṃ viśeṣyam, atra tu viśeṣaṇamiti bhedaḥ|
analyzed: bahuvrīhau tu uttara pade eva sā iti sāre eva vyaktam pāṇi pādam ityādi dvandve sāhatya āpanna pratyeka padārtha yāḥ uttara padasya eva sā atas eva dvivacana ādi artha dvi tva ādi anvayaḥ tatra samāhāra dvandve sāhityam viśeṣyam atra tu viśeṣaṇam iti bhedaḥ

original: yadvā samāhāradvandve'pi sāhityāpratīterna ta6 lakṣaṇā, kintu pratyekapadaśaktyupasthāpyayoreva sākṣād vādanakarmatvānvayaḥ| `dvandvasca prāṇi' itiprakaraṇātidiṣṭaikatvasamāsasyaiva mukhyaṃ samāhārapadavyapadesyatvam| itaratra tu tadyavahāra aupacārikaḥ| nāta itaretarayoge tatprasaṅgaḥ|
analyzed: yat vā samāhāra dvandve pi sāhitya apratīteḥ na tad lakṣaṇā kintu pratyeka pada śakti upasthāpyayoḥ eva sākṣāt vādana karma tva anvayaḥ iti prakaraṇa atidiṣṭa ekatva samāsasya eva mukhyam samāhāra pada vyapadesya tvam itaratra tu tad yavahāraḥ aupacārikaḥ na atas itaretara yoge tad prasaṅgaḥ

original: evamitaretarayoge'pi na lakṣaṇā, ekasmṛtyārūḍhapadadvayāt pratyekaśaktyupasthitārthayordvitvānvayasambhavāt, ekaktriyā'nvayitvarūpasya ekabuddhayavacchinnatvarūpasya vā sāhityasya paścādevāvagameva pūrvaṃ tatra lakṣaṇāgrahāsambhavācca| `cārthe dvandvaḥ' ityasya cārthānvayayogya ityarthātanna tad‌virodho'pi|
analyzed: evam itaretara yoge api na lakṣaṇā eka smṛti ārūḍha pada dvayāt pratyeka śakti upasthita arthayoḥ dvi tva anvaya sambhavāt eka ktriyā anvayi tva rūpasya eka buddhay avacchinna tva rūpasya vā sāhityasya paścāt eva avagama iva pūrvam tatra lakṣaṇā graha asambhavāt ca ca arthe dvandvaḥ iti asya ca artha anvaya yogyaḥ iti arthā na tad virodhaḥ api

original: yuktatrcaitat, dvandvatvāvacchinnasya pradhānībhūtārthadvayapratipādakatve eva "dvandvaḥ sāmāsikasya ca" (gītā) ityanena samāsasamūhamadhye dvandvasya vibhūtitayā parigaṇanasya bhagavatkṛtasya saṅgateḥ| viśiṣṭaśaktyā, lakṣaṇāyā vā tasya pradhānībhūtasamāhārapratipādakatve tu samāsāntarād dvandvasyāviśeṣāttadasaṅgatiḥ spaṣṭaiva|
analyzed: dvandva tva avacchinnasya pradhānībhūta artha dvaya pratipādaka tve eva dvandvaḥ sāmāsikasya ca gītāḥ iti anena samāsa samūha madhye dvandvasya vibhūti tayā parigaṇanasya bhagavat kṛtasya saṅgateḥ viśiṣṭa śaktyā lakṣaṇāyāḥ vā tasya pradhānībhūta samāhāra pratipādaka tve tu samāsa antarāt dvandvasya aviśeṣāt tad asaṅgatiḥ spaṣṭā eva

original: yattu bhāratabhāvadīpe-samamekatrā''sanaṃ samāso viduṣāṃ guruśiṣyāṇāṃ vā māntrārthe kathārthaṃ vaikatrāvasthānam| tatra viditamarthajāta sāmāsikam, cāturarthikaṣṭhak tasya "ṭhasyekaḥ" itīkādeśaḥ, "yasyeti ca' ityalopaḥ| tasya madhye dvandvaḥ-rahasyo'ham "dvandvaṃ rahasya" iti sūtre dvandvaśabdasya rahasyavācitvaṃ śāvdikaprasiddhamiti vyākhyātam|
analyzed: yat tu bhāratabhāvadīpe samam ekatra āsanam samāsaḥ viduṣām guru śiṣyāṇām vā māntra arthe kathā artham vā ekatra avasthānam tatra sāmāsikam cāturarthikaḥ ṭhak tasya ṭhasi ekaḥ iti ika ādeśaḥ yasya iti ca iti a lopaḥ tasya madhye dvandvaḥ rahasya ūham dvandvam rahasyaḥ iti sūtre dvandva śabdasya rahasya vāci tvam śāvdika prasiddham iti vyākhyātam

original: tattu viditārthasya caturthe caturarthyāñca adarśanādrathantarādhikaraṇānyāyena saṅketitasamāsaśabdāt pāribhāṣikasamāsarūpārthasyaivopasthiterucitatvena prāptasya sāmūhikaṭhakaḥ samāsaśabdāttadanabhidhānāt| "dvandvaṃ rahasya" ityanena rahasye vyutpāditadvandvasya nityapuṃsakatvena pum̐lliṅgasya tadvācitvāsambhavāt|
analyzed: tat tu vidita arthasya caturthe caturarthyāt ca adarśanāt rathantara adhikaraṇa anyāyena saṅketita samāsa śabdāt pāribhāṣika samāsa rūpa arthasya eva upasthiteḥ ucita tvena prāptasya sāmūhika ṭhakaḥ samāsa śabdāt tad anabhidhānāt dvandvam rahasye iti anena rahasye vyutpādita dvandvasya nityapuṃsaka tvena pum liṅgasya tad vāci tva asambhavāt

original: samāsavācinaśca tasya pūm̐lliṅgatāyāḥ "cārthe dvandvaḥ" ityādau dṛsṭatvāt pāribhāṣikatvāccha tena samāsasyaiva grahaṇasyocitatvācca cintyam|
analyzed: samāsa vācinaḥ ca tasya ca arthe dvandvaḥ ityādau dṛsṭa tvāt pāribhāṣika tvāt śa tena samāsasya eva grahaṇasya ucita tvāt ca cintyam

original: naca sāhityābhāne'nyatarasya kriyā'nvayavivakṣāyām `paśya dhavaṃ khadiraṃ chindhi' itivākyavat `paśya dhavakhadirau chindhi' iti prayogāpattiriti vācyam, pratyayārthadvitvāvacchinnadharmikasyaiva padārthāntarānvayavodhasyānyatra darśanenātrāpi tadavacchedenānvayasyaivocitatvāt|
analyzed: naca sāhitya ābhāne nyatarasya kriyā anvaya vivakṣāyām paśya dhavam khadiram chindhi iti vākya vat paśya dhava khadirau chindhi iti prayoga āpattiḥ iti vācyam pratyaya artha dvi tva avacchinna dharmikasya eva padārtha antara anvaya vodhasya anyatra darśanena atra api tad avacchedena anvayasya eva ucitatvāt

original: naca dvitvānvayayogyatāvacchedakasāhityabhānamantarema dvitvānvaya eva durlabha iti vācyam, yogyatā'vacchedakopasthiteranapekṣaṇāt, upasthireryogya eva tadanvayāt|
analyzed: naca dvi tva anvaya yogyatā avacchedaka sāhitya bhānam antarema dvi tva anvayaḥ eva durlabhaḥ iti vācyam yogyatā avacchedaka upasthiteḥ anapekṣaṇāt upasthireḥ yogyaḥ eva tad anvayāt

original: ata eva `ghaṭena jalamānaya' ityatra chidretarasyaiva yogyatābalenānvayaḥ, natu chidretaratvaprakārakaḥ śābdabodhaḥ, tatra prakṛtyarthatāvacchedakasyaiva dvitvānvayayogyatāvacchedakatve'pi kṣativirahācca| vivecitaṃ cedamadhikamanyatra|
analyzed: atas eva ghaṭena jalam ānaya iti atra chidra itarasya eva yogyatā balena anvayaḥ na tu chidra itara tva prakārakaḥ śābdabodhaḥ tatra prakṛti artha tā avacchedakasya eva dvi tva anvaya yogyatā avacchedaka tve pi kṣati virahāt ca vivecitam ca idam adhikam anyatra

original: naca `kṣaumavasanāvagnimādadhīyātām' ityatra samuccayasāhityalābho na syāditi vācyam, "yat karttavyaṃ tadanayā saha" iti vacanāntarāttatsiddheḥ| yadyapi dvandve parasparānvayitvarūpavyapekṣā durghaṭā, tathāpi "cārthe dvandvaḥ" iti vidhisāmarthyādeva tatra samāsaḥ, datarthastūktaḥ, samuccayānvācayayostvanabhidhānādeva na dvandva iti spaṣṭaṃ bhāṣye|
analyzed: na ca kṣauma vasanau agnim ādadhīyātām iti atra samuccaya sāhitya lābhaḥ na syāt iti vācyam yat karttavyam tat anayā saha iti vacana antarāt tad siddheḥ yadi api dvandve paraspara anvayi tva rūpa vyapekṣā durghaṭā tathā api ca arthe dvandvaḥ iti vidhi sāmarthyāt eva tatra samāsaḥ samuccaya anvācayayoḥ tu anabhidhānāt eva na dvandve iti spaṣṭam bhāṣye

original: yattvekasyāṃ kriyāyāmekarūpeṇānvayitvameva sāmarthyamiti, tanna, kvacidetasya kvacit pūrvāktasya sāmarthyasyaśrayaṇe samarthasūtre vākyabhedāpatteḥ, ekakriyānvayitvasya tato'nanubhavācceti pūrvoktāpattimiṣṭatvenāpi pariharati-svīkṛtamiti|
analyzed: yat tu ekasyām kriyāyām eka rūpeṇa anvayi tvam eva sāmarthyam iti tat na kvacid etasya kvacid pūrva aktasya sāmarthyasya śrayaṇe samartha sūtre vākya bheda āpatteḥ eka kriyā anvayi tvasya tatas ananubhavāt ca iti pūrva ukta āpattim iṣṭatvena api pariharati svīkṛtam iti

original: caramavarṇāsyaiveti pūrvapūrvavarṇānubhavajanyodubuddhasaṃskārasahitāntimavarṇasyetyarthaḥ| nātaḥ kevalacaramavarṇārthabodhāpattiḥ| adhikamagre vakṣyate| "vyapekṣāyāṃ sāmarthye samāsa eko'saṅ‌gṛhīto bhavati" iti bhāṣyāśayaṃ prakāśayannaiyāyikamataṃ dūṣayati-atrocyate iti| saṃjñādītyādinā padatvādiparigrahaḥ|
analyzed: carama varṇa asya eva iti pūrva pūrva varṇa anubhava janya udubuddha saṃskāra sahita antima varṇasya iti arthaḥ na atas kevala carama varṇa artha bodha āpattiḥ adhikam agre vakṣyate vyapekṣāyām sāmarthye samāsaḥ bhavati iti bhāṣya āśayam prakāśayan naiyāyika matam dūṣayati atra ucyate iti saṃjñā ādi ityādinā pada tva ādi parigrahaḥ

original: bhāṣyasiddhāyā iti "samāsagrahaṇamarthavatsamudāyānāṃ niyamārtham" iti bhāṣyasiddāyā ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: bhāṣya siddhāyāḥ iti samāsa grahaṇam arthavat samudāyānām niyama artham iti bhāṣya siddāyāḥ iti arthaḥ

original: spaṣṭamiti vākyasyāpyarthavattvena prātipadikatvaprasaktau tad‌vyāvṛttaye vacanārambhamāśaṅkaya niyamārthena samāsagrahaṇena samāhitam| samāse śaktyanabhyupagame tu tasya vṛttyārthabodhakatvarūpārthavattvābhāvenāprāptasaṃjñāviṣaye tasyā''vaśyakatayā viyamārthatvavyāghātaḥ spaṣṭa eva|
analyzed: spaṣṭam iti vākyasya api arthavat tvena prātipadika tva prasaktau tad vyāvṛttaye vacana ārambham āśaṅkaya niyama arthena samāsa grahaṇena samāhitam samāse śakti anabhyupagame tu tasya vṛttyā artha bodhaka tva rūpa arthavat tva abhāvena aprāpta saṃjñā viṣaye tasya āvaśyaka tayā viyama artha tva vyāghātaḥ spaṣṭaḥ eva

original: tasmādetadbhāṣyamapi samāse viśiṣṭaśaktaumānamiti tatroktatvādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: tasmāt etat bhāṣyam api samāse viśiṣṭa śaktau mānam iti tatra ukta tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: naca arthavatpadasāmarthyanārthavācakapadaghaṭite'pi prātipadikasaṃjñāsiddhiranyatā dhātvādiparyyudāsenaivā'rthavattve labdhe tadupādānavaiyarthyaṃ spaṣṭameva|
analyzed: naca arthavat pada sāmarthya nārtha vācaka pada ghaṭite api prātipadika saṃjñā siddhiḥ anyatā dhātu ādi paryyudāsena eva arthavat tve labdhe tad upādāna vaiyarthyam spaṣṭam eva

original: daśadāḍimānītyādyanarthakasamudāyasya tu niyamena vāraṇīyatvāditi vācyam, arthavad‌grahaṇasyottarārthatāyāḥ siddhāntasiddhatve tatptāmarthyābhāvāt, "arthavad‌grahaṇaṃ saṃjñivyapadeśārtham" iti bhāṣyeṇārthavattvena sādṛśyabodhanārthaṃ tadupayogadaśanācceti viśiṣṭaśaktyabhyupagamamantareṇa samāse prātipadikasaṃjñādaubhikṣyameveti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: daśa dāḍimāni ityādi anarthaka samudāyasya tu niyamena vāraṇīya tvāt iti vācyam arthavat grahaṇasya uttarārtha tāyāḥ siddhānta siddhatve arthavat grahaṇam saṃjñi vyapadeśa artham iti bhāṣyeṇa arthavat tvena sādṛśya bodhana artham tad upayoga daśanāt ca iti viśiṣṭa śakti abhyupagamam antareṇa samāse prātipadika saṃjñā daubhikṣyam eva iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu citragurityādau viśiṣṭe śaktyasvīkāre'pi nārthavattvanibandhaprātipadikasaṃjñā'nupapattiḥ| tathāhi-na śakyasambandho lakṣaṇā, `gabhīrāyāṃ nadyāṃ ghoṣaḥ' ityādāvasambhavāt| tatra tāvanna gabhīrapadaṃ tīralakṣakam, nadyāmityasyānanvayāpatteḥ| nahi tīraṃ nadī, ata eva nīdīpadamapi na tathā, gabhīrapadārthasyānanvayāpatteḥ|
analyzed: nanu citraguḥ ityādau viśiṣṭe śakti asvīkāre api na arthavat tva nibandha prātipadika saṃjñā anupapattiḥ tathā hi na śakya sambandhaḥ lakṣaṇā gabhīrāyām nadyām ghoṣaḥ ityādau asambhavāt tatra tāvat na gabhīra padam tīra lakṣakam nadyām iti asya ananvaya āpatteḥ nahi tīram nadī atas eva nīdī padam api na tathā gabhīra padārthasya ananvaya āpatteḥ

original: naca padadvaye pratyekaṃ sā, viśiṣṭanadītīrābhānaprasaṅgāt| naca nadīpadenaiva gabhīranadītīraṃ lakṣyate, gabhīrādipadaṃ tātpartyagrāhakamiti vācyam, gabhīrapadasya tātparyyagrāhakatvamuta nadīpadasyeti vinigamanāvirahāt|
analyzed: naca pada dvaye pratyekam sā viśiṣṭa nadī tīra ābhāna prasaṅgāt naca nadī padena eva gabhīra nadī tīram lakṣyate gabhīra ādi padam tātpartya grāhakam iti vācyam gabhīra padasya tātparyya grāhaka tvam uta nadī padasya iti vinigamanā virahāt

original: naca nadīpadasya dravyavācakatayā sākṣātsambandha eva lakṣaṇāyāṃ vinigamaka iti vācyam, gabhīrapadasyāpi nityaṃ guṇivācakatayā tadarthasyāpi sākṣātsambandhāviśeṣāt| tasmāt padadvayalakṣaṇāyāṃ gauravāt samudāya eva sā'ṅgīkāryyā| ata evā'rthavādavākyānāṃ prāśastye lakṣaṇeti saṅgacchete| kintu svabodhyarūpaiva sā|
analyzed: naca nadī padasya dravya vācaka tayā sākṣāt sambandhaḥ eva lakṣaṇāyām vinigamakaḥ iti vācyam gabhīra padasya api nityam guṇi vācaka tayā tad arthasya api sākṣāt sambandha aviśeṣāt tasmāt pada dvaya lakṣaṇāyām gauravāt samudāyaḥ eva sā aṅgīkāryyā atas eva arthavāda vākyānām prāśastye lakṣaṇā iti saṅgacchete kintu sva bodhya rūpā eva sā

original: asti ca gabhīrāyāṃ nadyāmityatra vākyajñāpyā gabhīrābhinnanadī tatsambandhastīre iti| evañca citragurityādisamudāyasya lakṣaṇayā citrābhinnagosvīmirūpārthabodakatvarūpārthavattvāt prātipadikasaṃjñā nānupapannetyata āha-samāsavākya iti vākya ityuktyā kvacittatsambhave'pi sarvatra rājapuruṣādisamāse tadasambhavaṃ sūcayati|
analyzed: asti ca gabhīrāyām nadyām iti atra vākya jñāpyā gabhīra abhinna nadī tad sambandhaḥ tīre iti evam ca citraguḥ ityādi samudāyasya lakṣaṇayā citra abhinna go svīmi rūpa artha bodaka tva rūpa arthavat tvāt prātipadika saṃjñā na anupapannā iti atas āha samāsa vākye iti vākye iti uktyā kvacid tad sambhave api sarvatra rāja puruṣa ādi samāse tad asambhavam sūcayati

original: ayamāśayaḥ-svajñāpyasambandhasya na lakṣaṇātvam, apabhreśe'pitatprasaṅgāt| kiñca `svajñāpya' ityasya svaniṣṭhajñāpakatānirūpakajñāpyatāvadarthasambanda ityartho vācyaḥ| tatra jñāpakatvaṃ vṛtyā bodhakatvam, uta jñānajanakajñānaviṣayatvamātram| nādyaḥ, vākye lakṣaṇā'bhāvaprasaṅgāt| tadarthasya gambhīrābhinnasya vṛttyabodhyatvāt|
analyzed: ayam āśayaḥ sva jñāpya sambandhasya na lakṣaṇā tvam apabhreśe pi tad prasaṅgāt kiñca sva jñāpyaḥ iti asya sva niṣṭha jñāpaka tā nirūpaka jñāpya tāvat artha sambandaḥ iti arthaḥ vācyaḥ tatra jñāpaka tvam vṛtyā bodhaka tvam uta jñāna janaka jñāna viṣaya tva mātram na ādyaḥ vākye lakṣaṇā bhāva prasaṅgāt tad arthasya gambhīra abhinnasya vṛtti abodhya tvāt

original: nāntyaḥ, pratyekaṃ varṇānāmarthavattvāpattyā vibhaktyāpatteriti svaśakyasambandho lakṣaṇetyevāṅgīkaraṇīyam| tathāca samāse tadasambhavena prātipadikasaṃjñā'nupapattistadavasteti tadarthaṃ viśiṣṭaśaktisvīkāra āvaśyaka iti|
analyzed: na antyaḥ pratyekam varṇānām arthavat tva āpattyā vibhakti āpatteḥ iti sva śakya sambandhaḥ lakṣaṇā iti eva aṅgīkaraṇīyam tathāca samāse tad asambhavena prātipadika saṃjñā anupapattiḥ tad avastā iti tad artham viśiṣṭa śakti svīkāraḥ āvaśyakaḥ iti

original: bhāṣyasiddha iti "tibekādeśe pratiṣedho'ntavattvāt" ityādestatrābhidhānāditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: bhāṣya siddhaḥ iti tip eka ādeśe pratiṣedhaḥ ūntavat tvāt ityādeḥ tatra abhidhānāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: sūtryatāmiti "atipsamāsaśca prātipadikam" ityeva sūtrayatāmityarthaḥ| tathāca tiṅsubantabhinnaṃ yattatprātipadikamityarthena samāsasya prātipadikatvalābhādatiricyamānaṃ samāsagrahaṇaṃ niyamārthamastviratyarthaḥ|

original: evaṃ prakṛtipratyayasamudāyasyāpyanarthakatvenāprāptasaṃjñāvidhānārthaṃ kṛttaddhitagrahaṇamiti samastasyaiva sūtrasya vidhāyakatvam| ādyasūtrasya tu avyutpannasādhuśabdasvarūpameva, natu bahupaṭurityādisamudāyo'pyuttarapadalākṣaṇikatādṛśasamudāyasyārtavattvābhāvāt|

original: prakṛtitvañca pratyayavidhānāvadhitvam| `iḥ' `ityān' ityādau tu pratyayasyaiva tadantatvānna doṣaḥ| pacatakyādisamudāyāntargatataddhitaprakṛterniruktataddhitavaiśiṣṭayābhāvānna tatrātiprasaṅgaḥ, kṛd‌grahaṇaparibhāṣāyā anantaragrahaṇajñāpitāyā asārvatrikatvācca na mūlakenopadaṃśamityādāvatadiprasaktiḥ|
analyzed: prakṛti tvam ca pratyaya vidhāna avadhi tvam ityādau tu pratyayasya eva tad anta tvāt na doṣaḥ pacatakī ādi samudāya antargata taddhita prakṛteḥ nirukta taddhita vaiśiṣṭayā abhāvāt na tatra atiprasaṅgaḥ kṛt grahaṇa paribhāṣāyāḥ anantara grahaṇa jñāpitāyāḥ asārvatrika tvāt ca na mūlakena upadaṃśam ityādau a tadi prasaktiḥ

original: evaṃ samāsagrahaṇenāpyapraptaprātipadikasaṃjñāvidhānādrājapuruṣa ityādisamudāyāt svādyutpattiḥ sulabheti tatra viśiṣṭaśaktyabhyupagamo niṣpramāṇakaḥ| vākyasya sā netyuktameva, tatra kosādinā śaktyaricchedāt|

original: yatra tu kosādikaṃ ricchedakaṃ tatra samāse paṅkajādau tāṃ nivārayāmaḥ| evañca vākyasyārthavattvābhāvena prātipadikasaṃjñā'prasaktestad‌vayāvṛttirūlābhāvena samāsagrahaṇasya niyamārthatvavarṇanamasāmpratam| bhāṣye tasya niyamaparatayā varṇanaṃ tu saṃsargasya śakyatvamityekadeśimatamanusṛtyaivaityarucerāha-kiñcaivamiti|

original: evam-samāse viśiṣṭaśaktayasvīkāre| karmatvādyananvayāpattirityasya gavādipadārtha iti śeṣaḥ| tatra hetumāha-pratyayānāmiti tathāca prakṛtitvam pratyayavidhānāvadhitvam, na tu pratyayāvyavahitapūrvatvam, bahupaṭurityādau paṭ‌vādisabde'vyāpteḥ|
analyzed: evam samāse viśiṣṭa śakti asvīkāre karma tva ādi ananvaya āpattiḥ iti asya go ādi padārthe iti śeṣaḥ tatra hetum āha pratyayānām iti tathāca prakṛti tvam pratyaya vidhāna avadhi tvam na tu pratyaya avyavahita pūrva tvam bahu paṭuḥ ityādau paṭu ādi sabde vyāpteḥ

original: naca "tāveva suptiṅau yau tataḥ parau, saiva ca prakṛtirādyā" iti bhāṣyāt pratyayāvyavahitapūrvasyaiva prakṛtitvalābha iti vācyam, tadarthānavabodhāt| yau tato vidhānāvadheairasati viśaṣānuśāsane parau tāveva suptiṅāvityupalakṣaṇam, pratyayāntarasyāpi, yato vihitau saiva prakṛtiriti tadarthāt| ādyetyabhyāsābhiprāyeṇa|

original: ānuśāsaniketi sannihitatvaṃ nāvyavahitapūrvatvam| tattvenānusandhīyamānatvaṃ vā, dhavakhadirāvityādau dhavādipadārthe vibhāktyarthānanvayaprasaṅgat, kintu sannihitatvenānuśāsanabodhitatvam| tacca dhavādipadārthānamivopādipadārthānāmastītyāśayavānāha-tathāceti|

original: samasyamānapadottaramiti samāsasyānekapadasamudāyātsakatayā samudāyasya pratyekānatiriktatayā samāsarūpaprātipadikād vihitavibhaktestattatpadasannihitatvāditi bhāvaḥ|

original: sambhavedevaṃ yadi samāsagrahaṇanibandhanā prātipadikasaṃjñā, kintu niyāmakatayā pūrvasūtreṇaiva sā vācyā| tathācoktaprakārāsambhava ityāśayenāha-arthavatsūtreṇeti tathāca śāstrabodhitasannihitatvamapi viśiṣṭasyaiva, na kebalapūrvapadasyetyuktasthale vyabhicāro duruddhara iti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: sambhavet evam yadi samāsa grahaṇa nibandhanā prātipadika saṃjñā kintu niyāmaka tayā pūrva sūtreṇa eva sā vācyā tathā ca ukta prakāra asambhavaḥ iti āśayena āha arthavat sūtreṇa iti tathāca śāstra bodhita sannihita tvam api viśiṣṭasya eva na kebala pūrva padasya iti ukta sthale vyabhicāraḥ duruddharaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: prakṛtitvasya paryyāptyākhyavilakṣaṇasambandhena samudāyamātraviśrāntatve'pi kevalāśrayatayā tadttvasya pratyekadeśe'pi sambhavāduktavyutpattiraśarīre āśrayataiva niveśanīyetyāśayena śaṅkate-atheti| prakṛtitvāśraye-prakṛtitvāśrayārthe|
analyzed: prakṛti tvasya paryyāpti ākhya vilakṣaṇa sambandhena samudāya mātra viśrānta tve api kevala āśrayatayā tad ttvasya pratyeka deśe api sambhavāt ukta vyutpattiḥ aśarīre āśraya tā eva niveśanīyā iti āśayena śaṅkate atha iti prakṛti tva āśraye prakṛti tva āśraya arthe

original: asannihitaprakṛtyarthe dūṣaṇamudbhāvya sannihite'pi tadāha-aghaṭamiti pūrvapadārthaprādhānyamatretyāsayena dūṣaṇodbhāvanam| tattvañcā'gre vakṣyate| viśeṣaṇatayeti ekatra viśeṣaṇatayā'varuddhasyāparatra tadanvaye nairākāṅkṣayāditi bhāvaḥ| yatra kvapi viśeṣaṇenāparānvaya iti yathāśrutaṃ dūṣayati-
analyzed: asannihita prakṛti arthe dūṣaṇam udbhāvya sannihite api tat āha aghaṭam iti pūrva padārtha prādhānyam atra iti āsayena dūṣaṇa udbhāvanam tattvam ca agre vakṣyate viśeṣaṇatayā iti ekatra viśeṣaṇatayā avaruddhasya aparatra tad anvaye nairākāṅkṣayāt iti bhāvaḥ yatra kva api viśeṣaṇena apara anvayaḥ iti yathāśrutam dūṣayati

original: pākānnīla ityādi nīlatva-sukhayoḥ svāśraye viseṣaṇatayā'nvitayo- pākādityādyantargatapañcamyarthahetutvasyānanvavāpatterityarthaḥ| tajjanyajñānaviṣayatveti tatpadārthaḥ prakṛtiḥ| mātrapadena vṛttipratipādyatvasya vyavacchedaḥ| atra citragvādisamāsāntargatagavādipadārthe ityarthaḥ| aviruddhamiti abādhitamityarthaḥ|

original: `ghaṭaṃ paśya' ityatra dṛśirjñānasāmānyārthaḥ| ākāśavāraṇāyeti samvāyenopasthitākāśe dṛśyarthakarmatvādyanvayavāraṇāyetyarthaḥ| vṛttyā prakṛtyarthatvasyeti vṛttijanyopasthitiviṣayatvasyetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: ghaṭam paśya iti atra dṛśiḥ jñāna sāmānya arthaḥ ākāśa vāraṇāya iti samvāyena upasthita ākāśe dṛśi artha karma tva ādi anvaya vāraṇāya iti arthaḥ vṛttyā prakṛti artha tvasya iti vṛtti janya upasthiti viṣaya tvasya iti arthaḥ

original: `vādivākye yāvanto'rthāḥ sambhavanti' iti nyāyenoktavyutpattiṃ dūṣayitumarthāntararatayā vyācaṣṭe-prasaṅgāditi pratyayaprāgvarttipadajanyopasthitiviṣayatāyāḥ kṛṣṇe sattvāditi bhāvaḥ| `pratyayānām' iti vyutptterekārthobhāvavādimate sattve'pi nāsmanmate sā sārvatrikī, samāsa evāsambhavāt|
analyzed: vādi vākye yāvantaḥ ṛthāḥ sambhavanti iti nyāyena ukta vyutpattim dūṣayitum artha antara ratayā vyācaṣṭe prasaṅgāt iti pratyaya prāc vartti pada janya upasthiti viṣaya tāyāḥ kṛṣṇe sattvāt iti bhāvaḥ pratyayānām iti vyutptteḥ ekārthaḥ bhāva vādi mate sattve api na asmad mate sā sārvatrikī samāsaḥ eva asambhavāt

original: kintu prakṛte vyuttpattyantarameva kalpyate ityabhipretyāha-atheti|
analyzed: kintu prakṛte vyuttpatti antaram eva kalpyate iti abhipretya āha atha iti

original: aklṛptakalpanāmiti samasyamānapadārthaviṣayatānirūpitaviṣayatāsambandhena śābdaṃ prati viśṣyatāsambandhena pratyayajanyopasthiteḥ kāraṇatvāntarakalpanāmityarthaḥ|

original: nanu pratyayānāṃ sannihitapadārthagatasvārthabodhakatvarūpā vyāsasamāsasādhāraṇyekaiva vyutpattiḥ| sannihitatvañca padatvasya prakṛtitvaghaṭitasya vyutpattau niveśe gauravamityādidigarthaḥ|
analyzed: nanu pratyayānām sannihita padārtha gata sva artha bodhaka tva rūpā vyāsa samāsa sādhāraṇī ekā eva vyutpattiḥ sannihita tvam ca pada tvasya prakṛti tva ghaṭitasya vyutpattau niveśe gauravam ityādi diś arthaḥ

original: nanu pratyayānāmiti vyutpatteḥ prakṛtipratyayaghaṭitatayā tatra prakṛtitvapratyayatvayoranutayordurvacatvena tattadvayaktibhedena kāryyakāraṇabhāvo vācyaḥ| tathāca samāsasthale samāsyamānapadārthasya pratyayārthānvayābhyupagame bādhakābhāvo'ta āha-api ceti|
analyzed: nanu pratyayānām iti vyutpatteḥ prakṛti pratyaya ghaṭita tayā tatra prakṛti tva pratyaya tvayoḥ anutayoḥ durvaca tvena tad tad vayakti bhedena kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ vācyaḥ tathāca samāsa sthale samāsyamāna padārthasya pratyaya artha anvaya abhyupagame āha api ca iti

original: niruktavyapekṣeva sāmarthyaṃ mulakṛdabhipretamityarthe idamapi pramāṇam| anyathā jahatsvārthavṛttipakṣe padānāmānarthakyāt pratyekapadavṛttyā'rthopasthiterasambhavena kva tanmūlakaśaktigraha iti tasyāntaraṅgatvakathanamasaṅgatameva syāditi bodhyam| tat tātparyam| kalpyate-avadhāryyate|

original: nanu "saṃyogo viprayogaśca" ityādinā hariṇā saṃyogādīnāṃ viśeṣāvagatihetutvaṃ bodhyate, tat kathaṃ tātparyyasya viśeṣaṇavagatihetutvamiti cenna, nānāsaktyupasthitānekeṣu saṃyogādinaikastimannavadhārite tātparyya viśeṣāvagatiriti sabdārthasyānavaccheda iti bhāvārthasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt|

original: saṃyogādīnāṃ tātparyyagrāhakatāyāmevopayogena tātparyyasya viseṣavagatihetutvaṃ sarvasammatameveti bhāvaḥ|

original: nanu pratyekapadavṛttipakṣe'nāyāsenaivādhikaraṇasiddhāntāpapattau viśiṣṭaśaktipakṣe tādṛśasidvāntasamarthane kleśo duṣparihara evetyata āha-pareṣāmapīti| praveśayetivaditi tātparyyasyaiva lakṣaṇāniyāmakatayā tatsattve vākyalakṣaṇayā samāsāntarabodhasya durvāratayā tātparyyābhāvenaiva tadavagatervāraṇīyatvādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: nanu pratyeka pada vṛtti pakṣena āyāsena eva adhikaraṇa siddhānta apapattau viśiṣṭa śakti pakṣe tādṛśa sidvānta samarthane kleśaḥ duṣpariharaḥ eva iti atas āha pareṣām api iti praveśaya iti vat iti tātparyyasya eva lakṣaṇā niyāmaka tayā tad sattve vākya lakṣaṇayā samāsa antara bodhasya durvāra tayā tātparyya abhāvena eva tad avagatyāḥ vāraṇīya tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: nanu "niṣādasthapatiṃ yājayet" ityatra sthapatiśabdaḥ svāmiparyyāyaḥ, śreṣṭhaparyāyo vā| ubhayathā'pyasau guṇavacanaḥ| tasya ca jātivacananiṣādapadena karmadhāraye tatra guṇavacanasyaiva pūrvanipātaniyamena sthapatiniṣādamiti prasajjayeta, natu niṣādasthapatimiti syāt|
analyzed: nanu niṣāda sthapatim yājayet iti atra sthapati śabdaḥ svāmi paryyāyaḥ śreṣṭha paryāyaḥ vā ubhayathā api asau guṇa vacanaḥ tasya ca jāti vacana niṣāda padena karmadhāraye tatra guṇa vacanasya eva pūrva nipāta niyamena sthapati niṣādam iti prasajjayeta na tu niṣāda sthapatim iti syāt

original: kiñca ubhayathāpi sthapatiśabdārthasya nityasambandhisāpekṣatvena ṣaṣṭhīsamāsa eva nayāyyaḥ, natu karmadhāraya iti kathamuktasiddhāntasaṅgatiḥ prakṛte'pītyata āha-digiti tadarathastvata evāsvarasāt "liṅgadarśanācca" iti sūtraṃ hetvantaropasaṅgrāhakaṃ praṇītaṃ maharṣiṇā|
analyzed: kiñca ubhayathā api sthapati śabda arthasya nitya sambandhi sāpekṣa tvena ṣaṣṭhī samāsaḥ eva nayāyyaḥ na tu karmadhārayaḥ iti katham ukta siddhānta saṅgatiḥ prakṛte api iti atas āha diś iti tad arathaḥ tu atas eva asvarasāt liṅga darśanāt ca iti sūtram hetu antara upasaṅgrāhakam praṇītam mahā ṛṣiṇā

original: tacca śabarasvāminā, `kūṭaṃ hi niṣādānāmevopakārakam, nāryāṇām evañca tanniṣādānāmeva svam" iti bhāṣye vyākhyātam| tathāca kūṭadakṣiṇāliṅgat karmadhārayatve nirṇite sthapatiśabdasya rājadantāditvāt paranipāto bodhyaḥ, sambandhākāṅkṣānivṛttirapyarthato niṣādānāṃ svatbalābhādupapadyate|
analyzed: tat ca śabarasvāminā kūṭam hi niṣādānām eva upakārakam nāryāṇām evam ca tat niṣādānām eva svam iti bhāṣye vyākhyātam tathā ca kūṭa dakṣiṇā liṅgat karmadhāraya tve nirṇite sthapati śabdasya rāja danta ādi tvāt para nipātaḥ bodhyaḥ sambandha ākāṅkṣā nivṛttiḥ api arthataḥ niṣādānām svat ba lābhāt upapadyate

original: evaṃ lāghavādivicārastu kathañcit sambhavamātreṇeti sarvamanavadyam
analyzed: evam lāghava ādi vicāraḥ tu kathañcid sambhava mātreṇa iti sarvam anavadyam

original: iti vaiyākaraṇabhūṣaṇasāradarpaṇe samāsaśaktinirūpaṇam|

original: prasaṅgāditi "samāse khalu bhinnaiva śaktiḥ" iti grantena smṛtāyaḥ śaktoranupekṣaṇīyatvāditi bhāvaḥ| agṛhītavṛttikāt padāt padārthopasthiteḥ śābdabodhasya cādarśanāttaddharmāvacchinnaviṣayakaśābdabuddhiṃ prati taddharmāvacchinnārthanirūpitavṛttiviṣayakapadajñānaṃ karaṇam, vṛttyā padajanyapadārthotirvyāpāraḥ, tāṃ vinā tadanutpatteḥ natu
analyzed: prasaṅgāt iti samāse khalu bhinnā eva śaktiḥ iti grantena smṛtā ayaḥ śaktoḥ anupekṣaṇīya tvāt iti bhāvaḥ agṛhīta vṛttikāt padāt padārtha upasthiteḥ śābda bodhasya ca adarśanāt tad dharma avacchinna viṣayaka śābda buddhim prati tad dharma avacchinna artha nirūpita vṛtti viṣayaka pada jñānam karaṇam vṛttyā pada janya padārtha ūtiḥ vyāpāraḥ tām vinā tad anutpatteḥ natu

original: vṛttimattvena jñānaṃ padam, atītānāgataśabdānusandhānācchābdabodhānudayaprasaṅgāt|
analyzed: vṛttimat tvena jñānam padam atīta anāgata śabda anusandhānāt śābda bodha anudaya prasaṅgāt

original: vṛttiśca-śaktilakṣaṇābhedād dvividhā| tatrārthe padasaṅketaḥ śaktiḥ| sa cedaṃpadamimamartha bādhayatu iti padaviśaṣyakeśvarecchātmakaḥ| `asmāt padādayamartho bodhyaḥ' ityākārapadārthaviśeṣyakeśvarecchārūpo vā, vinigamakābhāvāt| tayā cārthabādhakaṃ padaṃ pācakamiti vyavahriyate| śāstrakārādisaṅketaḥ paribhāṣā|
analyzed: vṛttiḥ ca śakti lakṣaṇā bhedāt dvividhā tatra arthe pada saṅketaḥ śaktiḥ sa ca idam padam imam artha bādhayatu iti pada viśaṣyaka īśvara icchā ātmakaḥ asmāt padāt ayam arthaḥ bodhyaḥ iti ākāra padārtha viśeṣyaka īśvara icchā rūpaḥ vā vinigamaka abhāvāt tayā ca artha bādhakam padam pācakam iti vyavahriyate śāstra kāra ādi saṅketaḥ paribhāṣā

original: tayā cārthabodhakaṃ padaṃ pāribhāṣikamiti vyavahriyate, yathā-nadīvṛddhayādipadam| labhaṇā tu śakyasambandhaḥ| tatkalpikā ca mukhyārthabādhonnītatātparyānupapattiḥ|
analyzed: tayā ca artha bodhakam padam pāribhāṣikam iti vyavahriyate yathā nadīvṛddhayā ādi padam labhaṇā tu śakya sambandhaḥ tad kalpikā ca mukhya artha bādha unnīta tātparya anupapattiḥ

original: tathāhi-`gaṅāgāyāṃ ghoṣaḥ' ityatra gaṅgāpadasya ghoṣābhāvavatvāhārthaktavena tīratātparyyakatve unnite tātparyaviṣayatīrasmṛtiṃ vinā'nupapadyamānena tīraśābdabodhena tatsmṛtirākṣipyate| sā ca gaṅgāpadavṛttiṃ vinānupapadyamānā tajjñānamākṣipati| tadviṣayo gaṅgāpadanirūpitā vṛttirna śaktiḥ, tasyātrābhāvādatastīrasmārikā kācidanyaiva vṛttiḥ kalpyate|
analyzed: tathā hi gaṅāgāyām ghoṣaḥ iti atra gaṅgā padasya tīra tātparyyaka tve unnite tātparya viṣaya tīra smṛtim vinā anupapadyamānena tīra śābdabodhena tad smṛtiḥ ākṣipyate sā ca gaṅgā pada vṛttim vinā anupapadyamānā tad jñānam ākṣipati tad viṣayaḥ gaṅgā pada nirūpitā vṛttiḥ na śaktiḥ tasya atra abhāvāt atas tīra smārikā kācid anyā eva vṛttiḥ kalpyate

original: sā ca gaṅgāpadaśakyasāmīpyarūpaiva tena rūpeṇa gṛhyamāṇā tīraṃ smārayatyanubhāvayacati ca| śakyādaśakyopastitistu na lakṣaṇā, upasthitihetostasyāstattvāsambhavāt| nāpi svabodhyasambandhaḥ, samāsaśaktinirūpaṇoktayukteḥ|
analyzed: sā ca gaṅgā pada śakya sāmīpya rūpā eva tena rūpeṇa gṛhyamāṇā tīram smārayati anubhāvayacati ca śakyāt aśakya upastitiḥ tu na lakṣaṇā upasthiti hetoḥ tasyāḥ tattva asambhavāt nā api sva bodhya sambandhaḥ samāsa śakti nirūpaṇa ukta yukteḥ

original: sattvācchaktyaiva nirvāhe kṛtaṃ lakṣaṇayeti cenna, gaṅgapadavācyatvavyavahārasya tīrādāvasattvena gaṅgāpadajanyabodhaviṣayatātvāvacchinnaprakāratānirūpitaviśeṣyatvasambandhena īśvarecchīyagaṅgādipadānāṃ pravāhādau śaktiḥ, tīrādiniṣṭhaviśeṣṭhaviśeṣyatāyāśca gaṅgādipadajanyabodhaviṣayatvaprakāratānirūpyatve'pi na tasyāḥ tādṛśaviṣayatātvena
analyzed: sattvāt śaktyā eva nirvāhe kṛtam lakṣaṇayā iti ced na gaṅga pada vācyatva vyavahārasya tīra ādau asattvena gaṅgā pada janya bodha viṣayatā tva avacchinna prakāratā nirūpita viśeṣyatva sambandhena īśvara icchīya gaṅgā ādi padānām pravāha ādau śaktiḥ tīra ādi niṣṭha viśeṣṭha viśeṣyatāyāḥ ca gaṅgā ādi pada janya bodha viṣayatva prakāratā nirūpya tve pi na tasyāḥ tādṛśa viṣayatā tvena

original: ananteti svatvasya tattad‌vyaktiviśrāntatvenānanugatatāyā tad‌ghaṭitāvyavahitottaratvasambandenopasthitimattvasya kāryyatāvacchedakakoṭau niveśe kāryyakāraṇabhāvānantyamiti bhāvaḥ|

original: nyāyasāmyādāha-kiñceti prāgvadeveti śaktijñānaṃ vinā'pilakṣaṇājñānāt padārthopasthiteḥ, evaṃ lakṣaṇājñānaṃ vinā'pi śaktijñānātpadārthopasthitestayorupasthitihetutāyāṃ parasparaṃ vyabhicāraḥ, avyavahitottaratvasambandhena tattatkāraṇavaiśiṣṭayasya kāryyatā'vacchedakako niveśe ca gauravaṃ tadvadevetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: nyāya sāmyāt āha kiñca iti prāgvat eva iti śakti jñānam vinā api lakṣaṇā jñānāt padārtha upasthiteḥ evam lakṣaṇā jñānam vinā api śakti jñānāt padārtha upasthiteḥ tayoḥ upasthiti hetutāyām parasparam vyabhicāraḥ avyavahitottara tva sambandhena tad tad kāraṇa vaiśiṣṭayasya niveśe ca gauravam tadvat eva iti arthaḥ

original: nanu bodhakatvaśaktivādino'pi gaṅgāpadaṃ pravāhabodakamiti śaktigrahāllakṣyārthopasthiti-śābdabodhadhayorāpattivāraṇāya kāramatāvacchedakakukṣau tattadarthaniveśa āvaśyakaḥ, tathāca lakṣaṇāvādimate kva gauravamityāśaṅkaya nirācaṣṭe-naceti|

original: paraspareti gaṅgāpadaniṣṭhatīrabodhakatvagrahaṃ vinā'pi tīrādipadaniṣṭhatādṛśaśaktigraheṇa tīrabodhāttayoḥ parasparajanyabodhe vyabhicārapratirodhāyetyarthaḥ|

original: śaktibhramānurodheneti gaṅgāpadasya tīra śaktibhramadaśāyāṃ tīropastityādeḥ sarvamatasiddhatayā tavāpi tattatkāraṇatāvacchedakakoṭau tattatpadattadatarthaniveśasyāvaśyakatvādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: śakti bhrama anurodhena iti gaṅgā padasya tīra śakti bhrama daśāyām tīra upasti tyā ādeḥ sarva mata siddhatayā tava api tad tad kāraṇatā avacchedaka koṭau tad tad pada ttada tartha niveśasya āvaśyaka tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: taveti lakṣaṇāsvīkarturityarthaḥ| śaktijñānakāraṇatāyāṃ śakteśśaktitvena niveśe syādevoktadoṣaḥ kintu vṛttitveneti na tatsambhāvanetyāśaṅkete-atheti| vācyamiti śaktijanyopasthitāviva lakṣaṇājanyopasthitāvapi śaktilakṣaṇāsādhāraṇavṛttitvāvacchinnajanyatvasattvāditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: tava iti lakṣaṇā svīkartuḥ iti arthaḥ śakti jñāna kāraṇatāyām śakteḥ śakti tvena niveśe syāt eva ukta doṣaḥ kintu vṛtti tvena iti na tad sambhāvanā iti āśaṅketa atha iti vācyam iti śakti janya upasthitau iva lakṣaṇā janya upasthitau api śakti lakṣaṇa asādhāraṇa vṛtti tva avacchinna janya tva sattvāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: śaktilakṣaṇeti śaktibhinnatve sati lakṣaṇābhinnaṃ yattadbhitvasyetyartaḥ| śābdabodheti śābdabodhajanikā yā padārthopasthitiḥ padavṛttijñānajyopasthitistadanukūletyarthaḥ, kāraṇatā'vacchedakatve ubhayasādhāraṇaṃ dūṣaṇamāha-guruvāditi asmadabhimataśaktitvamapekṣya niruktānyataratvādegurrūtvādityarthaḥ| dvitīye dūṣaṇāntaramāha-śābdabodhahetviti|
analyzed: śakti lakṣaṇā iti śakti bhinnatve sati lakṣaṇa abhinnam yat tad bhitvasya iti artaḥ śābdabodha iti śābdabodha janikā yā padārtha upasthitiḥ pada vṛtti jñāna jyā upasthitiḥ tad anukūlā iti arthaḥ kāraṇatā avacchedaka tve ubhaya sādhāraṇam dūṣaṇam āha gurutvāt iti asmad abhimata śaktitvam apekṣya nirukta anyatara tva ādi gurrū tvāt iti arthaḥ dvitīye dūṣaṇa antaram āha śābdabodha hetu iti

original: śābdabodhānukūlatvasya tajjanakatvasya kāraṇātā'vacchedakopasthityadhīnatvena tasya ca padavṛttijñānajyopasthititvātmakatayā tajjñānasya svaghaṭakavattitvajñānaṃ vinā asambhavena kāryyakāraṇabhāvagraha eva durśaṭa ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: śābdabodha anukūla tvasya tad janaka tvasya kāraṇātā avacchedaka upasthiti adhīna tvena tasya ca pada vṛtti jñāna jya upasthiti tva ātmaka tayā tad jñānasya sva ghaṭaka vatti tva jñānam vinā asambhavena kāryya kāraṇa bhāva grahaḥ eva durśaṭaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: tathāca vṛttitvagrahe śābdavodhapadārthopasthityoḥ kāryyakāraṇabhāvagrahastad‌grahe ca niruktapadapadārthasambandhatvarūpavṛttitvagraha ityanyonyāśrayeṇoktasya vṛttitvāsambhava iti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: tathāca vṛtti tva grahe śābda vodha padārtha upasthityoḥ kāryya kāraṇa bhāva grahaḥ tad grahe ca nirukta pada padārtha sambandha tva rūpa vṛtti tva grahaḥ iti anyonya āśrayeṇa uktasya vṛtti tva asambhavaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: vastutastu vijātīyapadārthopasthitijanakapadapadārthayoḥ sambandhaḥ śaktiḥ| vaijātyasya niveśācca nākāśopasthitijanakasamavāyādāvattivyāptiḥ| tādṛśavai3jātyaparicāyakañca śābdabodhānukūleti| natu tena lakṣaṇājñānasyāpi śaktijñānatvenaiva hetutvena lakṣaṇājñānajanyalakṣyārthopasthityādau śaktijñānasya hetutāyāṃ vyabhicāra ityar‌thaḥ|
analyzed: vastutas tu vijātīya padārtha upasthiti janaka pada padārthayoḥ sambandhaḥ śaktiḥ vaijātyasya niveśāt ca na ākāśa upasthiti janaka samavāya ādau attivyāptiḥ tādṛśa vaijātya paricāyakam ca śābdabodha anukūlā iti na tu tena lakṣaṇā jñānasya api śakti jñāna tvena eva hetu tvena lakṣaṇā jñāna janya lakṣya artha upasthiti ādau śakti jñānasya hetutāyām vyabhicāraḥ iti arthaḥ

original: viṣayamaniveśyaiva yadi śaktijñānapadārthopasthityoḥ kāryyakāraṇabhāvaḥ sambhavet tadā syādapyuktaprakāraḥ, sa eva na sambhavatītyāha-śaktijñāneti| āvaśyakatvāditi tadarthaviṣayakopasthitiṃ prati tadarthanirūpitatatpadaniṣṭhaśaktijñānatvena hetutāyā avaśyakalpyatvādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: viṣayam a niveśya eva yadi śakti jñāna padārtha upasthityoḥ kāryya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ sambhavet tadā syāt api ukta prakāraḥ saḥ eva na sambhavati iti āha śakti jñāna iti āvaśyaka tvāt iti tad artha viṣayaka upasthitim prati tad artha nirūpita tad pada niṣṭha śakti jñāna tvena hetutāyāḥ avaśya kalpya tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: āvasyakatvamevāha-anyatheti śaktijñānapadārthopasthityoḥ kāryyakāraṇabhāve samānaviṣayatvāniveśe ityarthaḥ| sambandhāgrahavata ityuttayā lakṣaṇājñānāsattvaṃ bodhitam|
analyzed: āvasyaka tvam eva āha anyathā iti śakti jñāna padārtha upasthityoḥ kāryya kāraṇa bhāve samāna viṣaya tva aniveśe iti arthaḥ sambandha agrahavataḥ iti uttayā lakṣaṇā jñāna asattvam bodhitam

original: gaṅgāpadeti pravāharūpārtanirūpitabodhakatvaśaktiṃ gaṅgāpade jānata ityarthaḥ tīrabodhaprasaṅga iti tīropasthitestad‌dvārakaśābdabodhasya cāpattirityarthaḥ|
analyzed: gaṅgā pada iti pravāha rūpa ārta nirūpita bodhakatva śaktim gaṅgā pade jānataḥ iti arthaḥ tīra bodha prasaṅgaḥ iti tīra upasthiteḥ tad dvāraka śābdabodhasya ca āpattiḥ iti arthaḥ

original: nanūktāpattivāraṇāya vṛttijñānajanyopasthitiśābdabodhayoreva kāryyakāraṇabhāve samānaviṣayakatvaṃ niveśyatām, kṛtaṃ vṛttijñāna-padārthopasthityoḥ kāryyakāraṇabhāve tanniveśenetyata āha-apiceti hastipakasmṛtekvṛttijñānajanyatvasampattaye hastino'pi vākyāt smṛtīviṣayatā darśitā| samūhālampanetyatrālambanapadaṃ viṣayaparam|
analyzed: nanu ukta āpatti vāraṇāya vṛtti jñāna janya upasthiti śābda bodhayoḥ eva kāryya kāraṇa bhāve samāna viṣayaka tvam niveśyatām kṛtam vṛtti jñāna padārtha upasthityoḥ kāryya kāraṇa bhāve tad niveśena iti atas āha api ca iti hastipaka smṛteḥ kvṛtti jñāna janya tva sampattaye hastinaḥ api vākyāt smṛtī viṣayatā darśitā samūha ālampanā iti atra ālambana padam viṣaya param

original: vṛttijanyopasthitiriti tadviṣayakatvāvacchinnavṛttijñānaniṣṭhakāraṇatānirūpitakāryyatāvacchedakadharmavacchinnopasthitirityarthaḥ| uktasthale hastipakopasthitervṛttijñānajanyatve'pi na tanniṣṭhā janyatā hastipakaviṣayatvenā'vacchidyate|
analyzed: vṛtti janya upasthitiḥ iti tad viṣayaka tva avacchinna vṛtti jñāna niṣṭha kāraṇatā nirūpita kāryya tā avacchedaka dharma vacchinna upasthitiḥ iti arthaḥ ukta sthale hastipaka upasthiteḥ vṛtti jñāna janya tve pi na tad niṣṭhā janyatā hastipaka viṣayatvena avacchidyate

original: nāpi vṛttijñānaniṣṭhajanakatāyāṃ hastī viṣayatvenāvacchedakaḥ, vṛttijñāne dharmitvenābhānāditi noktāpattiriti bhāvaḥ| prakṛtopayoginamarthamāha-evañceti vṛttijñānopasthitiśābodhānāṃ samānaviṣayakatvena hetuhetumadbhāvaḥ phalatītī bhāvaḥ| asambhavaduktikamiti lakṣaṇājñānasya śaktiviṣayakatve'pi tīraviṣayakaśaktigrahātmakatvasyābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: nā api vṛtti jñāna niṣṭha janakatāyām hastī viṣaya tvena avacchedakaḥ vṛtti jñāne dharmi tvena abhānāt iti na ukta āpattiḥ iti bhāvaḥ prakṛta upayoginam artham āha evam ca iti vṛtti jñāna upasthiti śā bodhānām samāna viṣayaka tvena hetu hetumat bhāvaḥ bhāvaḥ asambhavat uktikam iti lakṣaṇā jñānasya śakti viṣayaka tve api tīra viṣayaka śaktigraha ātmaka tvasya abhāvāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: eteneti dvividhavṛttijñānasyaikarūpeṇa hetutvāsambhavena, vakṣyamāṇadūṣaṇena vetyarthaḥ| asambhavaduktikamiti lakṣaṇājñānasya śaktijñānādhīnatvena tajjanyosthitau śaktiprayojyatvasattvānna lakṣaṇāvādimate hetvantarakalpanotyarthaḥ| aṃnatiprasaktsyeti|
analyzed: etena iti dvividha vṛtti jñānasya ekarūpeṇa hetutva asambhavena vakṣyamāṇa dūṣaṇena vā iti arthaḥ asambhavat uktikam iti lakṣaṇā jñānasya śakti jñāna adhīna tvena śakti prayojya tva sattvāt na lakṣaṇā vādi mate hetu antara kalpanā utyarthaḥ

original: janyajanyatvasya lakṣaṇājñānajanyopasthitāviva viśeṣaṇatāvacchedakaprakārakanirṇayavidhayā śaktijñānajanyaghaṭapadaśakyavān deśa ityākārakaviśiṣṭavaiśiṣṭayāvagāhyanuvyavasāyātmakopasthitāvapi sattvāttadviṣayasyāpi śābdabodhāpatti, sākṣājjanyopasthiterasaṃgrahaśca, sākṣājjanyatvasya tattve tu lakṣaṇājñānajanyopasthityasaṃgrahaḥ,
analyzed: janya janya tvasya lakṣaṇā jñāna janya upasthitau iva viśeṣaṇa tā avacchedaka prakāraka nirṇaya vidhayā śakti jñāna janya ghaṭa pada śakyavān deśaḥ iti ākāraka viśiṣṭa vaiśiṣṭayā avagāhi anuvyavasāya ātmaka upasthitau api sattvāt tad viṣayasya api śābdabodha āpatti sākṣāt janya upasthiteḥ asaṃgrahaḥ ca sākṣāt janya tvasya tattve tu lakṣaṇā jñāna janya upasthiti asaṃgrahaḥ

original: ityubhayasādhāraṇasya tasya nirvaktumaśakyatvāt svarūpasambandharūpasya tasyānanugatasyobhayasādhāraṇyaṃ tu sutarāmasambhāvitamiti bhāvaḥ| anthāsiddhinirūpakatānavacchedakaśaktijñānaniyatottaravartitāvacchedakadharmavattvarūpaṃ śaktiprayojyatvamubhayasādhāraṇaṃ suvacamityapi kecit| adhikamagre vakṣyate|
analyzed: iti ubhaya sādhāraṇasya tasya nirvaktum aśakya tvāt svarūpa sambandha rūpasya tasya ananugatasya ubhaya sādhāraṇyam tu sutarām asambhāvitam iti bhāvaḥ antha asiddhi nirūpaka tā anavacchedaka śakti jñāna niyata uttara varti tā avacchedaka dharmavat tva rūpam śakti prayojya tvam ubhaya sādhāraṇam suvacam iti api kecid adhikam agre vakṣyate

original: atra vadanti-artabodhajanakatvasya vastutaḥ padaniṣṭhasya vācyavācakavyavahāraniyāmakaśaktitvasambhava evoktakāryyakāraṇabhāve gauravalāghavādicarccā, natu tasya tadrūpatvasambhavaḥ| tathāhi-śābdabodhaṃ prati vṛttijñānasya hetuteti nirvivādam|
analyzed: atra vadanti arta bodha janakatvasya vastutas pada niṣṭhasya vācya vācaka vyavahāra niyāmaka śaktitva sambhavaḥ eva ukta kāryya kāraṇa bhāve gaurava lāghava ādi carccā na tu tasya tad rūpa tva sambhavaḥ tathā hi śābdabodham prati vṛtti jñānasya hetutā iti nirvivādam

original: sā ca bhavaduktārthadhījanakatvasya vṛttitve na sambhavati, tadrūpāyāstasyāḥ jñānaniṣṭhaśābdadhījanakatāyāmanavacchedakatvāt| ātmāśrayeṇa svasyaiva svāvaccedakatvāsambhavāt|
analyzed: sā ca bhavat ukta artha dhī janaka tvasya vṛtti tve na sambhavati tad rūpāyāḥ tasyāḥ jñāna niṣṭha śābda dhī janaka tāyām anavacchedaka tvāt ātma āśrayeṇa svasya eva sva avaccedaka tva asambhavāt

original: kiñca prayojyaprayojakavyavahāradraṣṭṛprayojyapravṛttyanumite prayojyaghaṭānayanādijñāne upasthitatvācchābdasyaiva hetutāyāmavadhāryyamāṇāyāmasambaddasya kāraṇatvānupapattyā kalpyamānasambandhasya janakatvātmakatvāsambhavaḥ, svayamanupapadyamānatvena gṛhītasya grahītumaśakyatvāt| tasmānna `bodhakatvaṃ śaktiḥ'|

analyzed: yadi api uttara padārtha prādhānyena nañ tatpuruṣasya brāhmaṇasya nayanam prāpnoti nañaḥ prayogāt nañ artha viśiṣṭasya ānayanam bhaviṣyati kaḥ punar asau nañ arthaḥ nivṛtta padārthakaḥ brāhmaṇa dṛṣṭasya gaura tva ādeḥ darśanāt dṛṣṭa upadeśāt vā pūrvam brāhmaṇaḥ iyam iti adhyavasyati tatas paścāt upalabhate na ayam brāhmaṇaḥ iti tatas brāhmaṇaḥ yam iti prayuṅktaḥ

original: ātaśca tad‌dṛṣṭaguṇadarsanād dṛṣṭopadeśādvā brahmaṇatvādyadhyavasāyapūrvakameva nāyaṃ brāhmaṇa iti jñānam| nahyayaṃ kālavarṇamāpaṇedṛṣṭvā'dhyavasyati brāhmaṇo'yamiti| yathāsthitaṃ vastutattvaṃ tasya nirjñātaṃ bhavati" iti nañsūtrabhāṣyaparyyalocanayā kaiyaṭoktārthasyaiva sādhutvaṃ labhyate|

original: anye tu-śāstravihitapratiṣiddhatvāt, ṣoḍaśigrahaṇāgrahaṇavadvikalpāpatternānuyājeṣvityatra nañaḥ pratiṣedhārthakatvam| tathāhi-kriyāyāḥ kārakasākāṅ‌kṣatvād‌ vinigamanāviraheṇa sakalakārakaviśiṣṭāṃ pratiyogibhūtāṃ bhāvanāmuddiśyabhāvavidhistatra vācyaḥ| evañcoddeśyasya prasidhdyarthe tatprāptirapekṣitā| prāptisāpekṣātvāt pratiṣedhasya|

original: evañca niṣedhasya śāstraviṣayatvena prābalyavad vidhiśāstrasyāpyupajīvyatvena prābalyānniṣedhena vidheratya nyabādhāyogād vikalpa eva prāpnoti|

analyzed: vikalpe ca vrīhibhiḥ juhoti yavaiḥ vā juhoti ityādau prathamam vrīhi anuṣṭhāne vedasya viparyyāsam iti janaka tva asambhavāt yava śāstrasya aprāpta prāmāṇya svīkāraḥ pratīta prāmāṇya parityāgaḥ ca iti doṣa dvayam prayoga antare yava upādāne yava śāstrasya svīkṛta a prāmāṇa aya parityāgaḥ parityakta prāmāṇya upādānam ca iti

original: caturthe yavopādāne vrīhiśāstrasyāsvīkṛtāprāmāṇyasvīkāraḥ, svīkṛtāprāmāṇyatyāgaśceti doṣadvayamiti catvāro'nye'pītyaṣṭadoṣavikalpāpattyā nañanuyājapadābhyāmanūyājabhedo bodhyate| so'yaṃ paryyudāsaḥ|

original: naca nañā niṣedhabodhane'pi padaśāstreṇā''havanīyasāstrasyeva nānuyājeṣviti viśeṣaśāstreṇa yajatiṣu ye yajāmahaṅkarotīti sāmānyaśāstrasya bādhānna vikalpa iti vācyam,

original: parasparanirapekṣatorhi bādhyabādakabhāvaḥ padaśāstreṇ''havanīyaśāstrasyānapekṣaṇāt sa ucitaḥ| niṣeśāstrasya tu pratiyogiprasiddhayarthamastyapekṣā vidhyarthasya| "prasaktaṃ hi pratiṣiddhayate' iti nyāyena na tad‌bādhaḥ, asambhavāt| kintūktayuktayā vikalpa eva| tathāca dviradṛṣkalpanāprasaṅgo'pi| vidherhyevaṃ jñāyate|
analyzed: paraspara nirapekṣatoḥ hi bādhya bādaka bhāvaḥ pada śāstreṇa havanīya śāstrasya anapekṣaṇāt saḥ ucitaḥ niṣeśa āstrasya tu pratiyogi prasiddhaya rtham asti apekṣā vidhi arthasya prasaktam hi iti nyāyena na tad bādhaḥ asambhavāt kintu ukta yuktayā vikalpaḥ eva tathā ca vidheḥ hi evam jñāyate

original: naca tatrāpi paryyudāsa eva nañā bodhyate, nañā paryyudāsabodhena viśiṣyaviśeṣaṇavācakadayoḥ samānavibhaktitvāsyeva tayoḥ samānavacanasyapi tantratvāt, tasya prakṛte'bhāvāt| anyathā na mahato rājña ityādāviva, na mahatāṃ rājña ityādāvapi mahadbhedapratīyāpattiḥ|

original: eko na dvāvitivat kathañcit kathañcit samarthane'pi dvitīyasya dātavyamityasya nairarthakyaprasaṅgaśca, `bāhmaṇebhyo dadhi dātavyaṃ kauṇiḍinyabhinnabrāhmaṇoddeśyakadadhidānabodhasambhavādityāhuḥ|

original: vikalpaprasaktirūpadoṣabhāve'pi vākyabhedā''patterjāgarūkatayā samānavibhaktikatvādestad‌bodhaniyāmakasya satt‌ve, ca nañaḥ paryyudāsādthakatvameva, nānuyājeṣvityatrocitamiti tu pare|
analyzed: vikalpa prasakti rūpa doṣa bhāve pi vākyabheda āpatteḥ jāgarūka tayā samāna vibhaktika tva ādeḥ tad bodha niyāmakasya sattve ca nañaḥ paryyudāsa adthaka tvam eva na anuyājeṣu iti atra ucitam iti tu pare

original: tatpuruṣatvamiti bhedeviśeṣaṇatve tadanupapattiḥ syāt| pūruṣeti tavibāditrikasaṅketitapuruṣetyartha-| vacaneti ekavacanatvādirūpetyarthaḥ| "ayuvāṃ bhavatha" ityādau yuṣmadasmadarthābhāvaviśeṣyakabodhe abhave dvitvādyarthasya bādhād dvivacanādyanupapattiḥ|
analyzed: tatpuruṣa tvam iti bhede viśeṣaṇa tve tad anupapattiḥ syāt pūruṣa iti vacana iti ekavacana tva ādi rūpa iti arthaḥ vacana iti ekavacana tva ādi rūpa iti arthaḥ bhavathaḥ ityādau yuṣmad asmad artha abhāva viśeṣyaka bodhe abhave dvi tva ādi arthasya bādhāt dvivacana ādi anupapattiḥ

original: `bhāvanā|ṭanvayinyeva saṅkhayā'nvayaḥ' iti tvadabhyupakamenānyārthagatasaṅkhayāmādāya dvivacanādyupapādanasya kartumaśakyatvāditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: bhāvanā anvayinī eva saṅkhayā anvayaḥ iti tvad abhyupakamena anya artha gata saṅkhayām ādāya dvivacana ādi upapādanasya kartum aśakya tvāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: anyatheti nañarthābhāvasyottarapadārthaviśeṣaṇatve tadviśeṣyatva iti yāvat| pūruṣavyavastheti "yuṣmdyupapade" iti sūtradvayāviṣayatayā "śeṣe prathamaḥ" itayasya pravṛttyā prathamapurūṣasyaivāpatterityarthaḥ| nānupapannamiti| tathācoktavyavasthā sulabheti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: anyathā iti nañ artha abhāvasya uttara padārtha viśeṣaṇa tve tad viśeṣya tve iti yāvat pūruṣa vyavasthā iti yuṣmdi upapade iti sūtra dvaya aviṣaya tayā śeṣe prathamaḥ pravṛttyā prathama purūṣasya eva āpatteḥ iti arthaḥ na anupapannam iti tathā ca ukta vyavasthā sulabhā iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu nañarthabhedasya pratiyogitayottarapadārthānvaye 'aghaṭamānaya' ityātra svabhedapratiyogitvasya ghaṭe sattvāttad‌bodhānantaraṃ ghaṭānayasyāpyāpattirata āha-mūle-viśeṣyo vetiḥ| viśeṣaṇākāṅkṣāyāmāha-sāre pratiyoginīti uttarapadārtharūpapratiyoginītyarthaḥ|
analyzed: nanu nañ artha bhedasya pratiyogitayā uttara padārtha anvaye aghaṭam ānaya ityā atra sva bheda pratiyogitvasya ghaṭe sattvāt tad bodha anantaram ghaṭa ānayasya api āpattiḥ atas āha mūle viśeṣyaḥ vā itiḥ viśeṣaṇa ākāṅkṣāyām āha sāre pratiyoginī iti uttara padārtha rūpa pratiyoginī iti arthaḥ

original: nirūpitatvaṃ saptamyraḥ| uttarapādārtharūpapratiyoginiṣṭhaviśesaṇatānirūpitaviśeṣyatāśrayo nañartha iti yāvat| nanu tarhi uttarapadārthāprādhānye pūrvoktadūṣaṇagaṇo duṣpariharo'pi āha-ayambhāva iti| gauṇatve'pīti nañ‌samāsaghaṭakaitadādyarthasya nañarthaviśeṣaṇatve'pītyarthaḥ| jñāpakāditi| tatsūtrasthānañsamāsagrahaṇājjñāpakādityrathaḥ|
analyzed: nirūpita tvam uttara pāda artha rūpa pratiyogi niṣṭha viśesaṇatā nirūpita viśeṣyatā āśrayaḥ nañ arthaḥ iti yāvat nanu tarhi uttara padārtha aprādhānye pūrvokta dūṣaṇa gaṇaḥ duṣpariharaḥ api āha ayam bhāvaḥ iti gauṇa tve pi iti nañ samāsa ghaṭaka etad ādi arthasya nañ artha viśeṣaṇa tve pi iti arthaḥ jñāpakāt iti tad sūtra sthā nañ samāsa grahaṇāt jñāpakāt iti rathaḥ

original: jñāpakatāmeva prapañcayati-asaḥ caśiva iti|

analyzed: etad tadoḥ iti anena paraspara sāhacaryyāt sarvanāma etad tad bhāyām parasya soḥ ha li lopaḥ vidhīyate nañ tatpuruṣa an ātargata etad tadoḥ upasarjana tayā sarvanāma tva abhāvāt enān atiprasaṅge vyartham sada nañ samāsa grahaṇam nañ samāse guṇībhīta arthasya api sarva ādeḥ sarvanāma tā jñāpanena caritārtham iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu viśeṣaṇasya viśeṣyasaṅkhayāviruddhasaṃkhyāvattve'pi viśeṣaṇavācakapadāttadvacanamityatra pramāṇābhāvo'ta āha-kiñceti| nanvenekaśabdopādānādeva dvayorbahūnāṃ vā tatsiddherddhiva canabahuvacanayorapi samayaparipālanārthatvasambhavādekavacanopādānaṃ vyarathamevetyata āha-autsagikaṃ veti|

original: sūpapādamiti| bhedapratiyogyekārthakatve tu durūpapādaṃ syāt, ekaśeṣeṇa samarthanaṃ tvagatikagatiriti bhāvaḥ| bhāṣyodāhṛte "naikastiṣṭhati' iti prayoge `janaḥ' ityadhyāhāryyam| pratyekaṃ sthityanvayabodhārthañca tatraikavacanam| `anekojanaḥ' iti tvasādhveva| uttarapadārthaprādānyādivyapadeśastu prāyika ityādyapi bodhyam|

original: `atvaṃ bhavasi' ityādinā `anahambhavāmi' ityādirhṛhyate| yuṣmada ityasmado|ṭapyupalakṣaṇam| evam `tvadbhinnaḥ' ityatrāpi lakṣaṇoti tu naiyāyikādyanusāreṇa, svamate tadanabhyupagamāt| `atvambhavasi' ityādāvāropādibodhasya sarvānubavaviruddhatvānnatrsamāse sarvatrottarapadasya svār‌thabhinnalākṣaṇikatvameva yuktamiti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: atvam bhavasi ityādinā an aham bhavāmi ityādiḥ hṛhyate yuṣmadaḥ iti asmadoḥ upi upalakṣaṇam evam tvad bhinnaḥ iti atra api tu naiyāyika ādi anusāreṇa sva mate tad anabhyupagamāt a tvam bhavasi ityādau āropa ādi bodhasya sarva anubava viruddha tvāt natr samāse sarvatra uttara padasya svārtha bhinna lākṣaṇika tvam eva yuktam iti bhāvaḥ

original: prasajyapratiṣedhārthakanaño vyavasthāmāha-evaṃ na tvaṃ pacasītyādi natrarthe yuṣamadarthānvaye tu prakṛte puruṣavyavasthā na sid‌dhyediti sūcayituṃ pacasīti madhyamapūruṣanirddeśaḥ| adhikaṃ tvādāvevokm| idamupalakṣaṇam-`ghaṭau nastaḥ' ityādau dvivacanādyanupapatte|

original: kriyāpratiyogikābhāvaviśeṣyakabodhe hetumāha-asamasteti vyākhyānāt nañaḥ tadarthasya prasajyapratiṣedhasya tādṛśanañarthābhāvaniṣṭhaviśeṣyatānirūpitaprakāratāsambandhena bodhe dhātujanyopasthiterbhāvanātvāvacchinnaviśeṣyatāsambandena hetutvasya pūrvamuktatvāditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: kriyā pratiyogika abhāva viśeṣyaka bodhe hetum āha asamasta iti vyākhyānāt nañaḥ tad arthasya prasajya pratiṣedhasya tādṛśa nañartha abhāva niṣṭha viśeṣyatā nirūpita prakāratā sambandhena bodhe dhātu janya upasthiteḥ bhāvanā tva avacchinna viśeṣyatā sambandena hetu tvasya pūrvam ukta tvāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanvabhāvasya kena rūpeṇa śakyatā| na tāvadabhāvatvena| `caitro na pacati' bhedabodhāpatteḥ| prasajyapratiṣedhatvena śakyatve'pi sa eva doṣaḥ, bhedasyāpi yogyānupalabdhijanyapratyakṣaviṣayatvāt| tadanupasthitāvapi naño'bhāvabodhāccetyata āha-sa ceti abhāvaścetyarthaḥ| tathāca naño'nyonyābhāvatvenātyantābhāvatvena vā'bhāve śaktikalpanānna doṣaḥ|
analyzed: nanu abhāvasya kena rūpeṇa śakyatā na tāvat abhāva tvena caitraḥ na pacati bheda bodha āpatteḥ prasajya pratiṣedha tvena śakyatve pi saḥ eva doṣaḥ bhedasya api yogya anupalabdhi janya pratyakṣa viṣaya tvāt tad anupasthitau api nañaḥ bhāva bodhāt ca iti atas āha sa ca iti abhāvaḥ ca iti arthaḥ tathāca nañaḥ anyonya abhāva tvena atyanta abhāva tvena vā abhāve śakti kalpanāt na doṣaḥ

original: atyantābhāvatveti antam-svapratiyoginiṣṭhābhāvapratiyogitvamatikrāntaḥ-vyabhicarito'tyantaḥ| sa cāsāvabhāvaśceti vigrahaḥ| tasya bhāvastattvam| svapratiyoginiṣṭhasvasadṛśābhāvapratiyogitvavyabhicāryabhāvatvamiti yāvat| `anto jaghanyaṃ caramam' ityamareṇāntaśabdasya jaghanye vṛttibodhanāt jaghanyatvañcoktārthasya jaghanavṛttibodhyatvāt|

original: ata eva guṇadīdhitau guṇatvasya guṇatvasya jātitvaṃ dīdhitikṛtā khaṇḍitamata āha-upādirveti| sāmānye-vyāpakadharme| ityarthaḥ|

analyzed: atra vadanti pramāṇānām sāmānya dharmasya avacchedaka tāyām tatra pakṣapātaḥ yatra ca bahūnām dharmāmām avacchedaka tva kalpanā prayuktam gauravam yathā karttṛ janyatva anumāne kṛti janyatāyām ghaṭa tva ādi apekṣayā kāryyatvasya yatra tu viśeṣaḥ api ekaḥ eva tatra ukta yukti virahāt tasya eva avacchedaka tvam

original: ata eva vyāpārasyādhikasaṃgrāhakatve'pi kṛtitvasyaivākhyātaśakyatāvacchedakatvaṃ svīkṛtatryaca mīmāṃsakairapi| dravyapratyakṣatvaṃ vihāya dravyacākṣuṣatvasyaiva rūpakāryyatāvacchedakatvam| prakṛte vyāpakatvānnipātatvādhikasaṃgrahakatve'pi vyāpakopasargatvasyāpyekatvena tasyaivāvacchedakatvamucitam|

original: naca prādīnāṃ dyotakatā nipātatvaliṅgenaiva setsyatīti vācyam, tasyopasargatvarūpodhimattatayā tadasādhakatvāt| naca ceṣṭādau sādhyāvyāpakatvānna tasyopādhitvamiti vācyam, śuddhasādhyayāvyāpakatvasambhavāt| asti hi nipātatvāvacchinnaṃ dyotakatvaṃ yatra tatropasargatvam, yatra nipātatvaṃ nañādau tatra tadabhāvāt|

original: nanu prakarṣadyarthaḥ, tadanvayavyatirekānuvidhāyiśābdadhīviṣayatvāt| yatra yadanvayavyatirekānuvidhayisābdadhīviṣayaḥ sa tadvācya iti sāmānyavyāptau ghaṭādidṛṣṭāntaḥ|
