original: nacānanyalabhyatvamupādhiḥ, tasya vācyatvarūpasādhyavyāpakatvāt kartrādau ākhyātānvayavyatirekānuvidhāyiśābdadhīviṣaye sādhanāvyāpakatvāditi vācyam, uktahetughaṭakaśābdabuddherākṣepādyajanyatvena viśeṣaṇenānanyalabhyatvasya sādhanavyāpakatvenopādhitvāyogāt|

original: naca svarūpāsiddhiḥ, dhātoreva prakṛṣṭajayārathakatvenopasargasya tātparyamātragrāhakatvāditi vācyam, dhātoḥ prakṛṣṭajayārthakatvasya granthakṛtaiva khaṇḍanāt| nāpi lakṣyatā tasya, prottaratvāderlakṣamatāvacchedakakoṭipraveśe gauravāt| tasmājjayatyādi dhātoḥ śakyatāvacchedakam, prakarṣatvādikaṃ tūpasargasyeti vācyam| tathāca kva detvasiddhiḥ|
analyzed: naca svarūpa asiddhiḥ dhātoḥ eva prakṛṣṭa jaya arathaka tvena upasargasya tātparya mātra grāhaka tvāt iti vācyam dhātoḥ prakṛṣṭa jaya arthaka tvasya granthakṛtā eva khaṇḍanāt nā api lakṣya tā tasya prottara tva ādeḥ lakṣamatā avacchedaka koṭi praveśe gauravāt tasmāt jayati ādi dhātoḥ śakyatā avacchedakam prakarṣa tva ādikam tu upasargasya iti vācyam tathāca kva detu asiddhiḥ

original: tathāca tato gatyabhāvābhāvavāniti dhīḥ, gamanatvaprakārakabodhastūttarakāliko mānasa eveti cenna,`pratyayānām' iti vyutpatterjāgarūkatayā gamanābhāvavāniti bodhasyāpi gaganakusumāyamānatvāt|

original: cārthasca samuccayādibhedena caturvidha iti "cārthe dvandvaḥ" ityatrākareṣu vyaktameva|

original: ivārthastu sādṛśyam| tacca tadbhinnatve sati tadratadharmavatvam| yattu-sādṛśyaṃ na bedaghaṭitamiti, tanna tāvatapi "nañivayuktam" iti paribhāṣaṇena tasyevārthatvānapāyāt| tad‌bodhakānuyogipratiyogivācakapadayoḥ samānavibhaktikatvaṃ niyāmakam| nātaścandra iva mukhamityarthe candreṇeva mukhamiti sādhu|

analyzed: eva kārasya tu anya yoga vyavacchedaḥ ayoga vyavacchedaḥ atyanta ayoga vyavacchedaḥ ca arthaḥ tatra viśeṣya gata eva stha lepa arthaḥ eva dhanurddharaḥ ityādau anya tādātmya vyavacchedaḥ ūrthaḥ tathā ca pārtha anya tādātmya abhāvavat dhanurddharā bhinna pārthaḥ iti bodhaḥ

original: `pṛthivyāmeva gandhaḥ' ityatra pṛtivyanyasamavetatvābhāvavān pṛthivīsamavetasca gandhaḥ' iti bodhāttādṛśabodhe saptamīrūpaviśe,ṇavibhaktisamabhivyāhāro'pi niyāmakaḥ| atra bhāvānvayabodhānupagame pṛthivyāmevākrāsamityapi prasajyeta| evañcaivakāreṇānyayogavyavacchedabodhe viśeṣyavācakapadaviśeṣaṇavācakasaptamyantānyatarāvyavahitottaraivaśabdo hetuḥ|
analyzed: pṛthivyām eva gandhaḥ iti atra pṛtivī anya samaveta tva abhāvavān pṛthivī samavetaḥ ca gandhaḥ iti bodhāt tādṛśa bodhe saptamī rūpa viśeṇa vibhakti samabhivyāhāraḥ api niyāmakaḥ atra bhāva anvaya bodha anupagame pṛthivyām eva ākrāsam iti api prasajyeta evam ca evakāreṇa anya yoga vyavaccheda bodhe viśeṣya vācaka pada viśeṣaṇa vācaka saptamī anta anyatara avyavahita uttara eva śabdaḥ hetuḥ

original: viśeṣaṇasaṅgataivasthale'yogavyavacchedaḥ| `śaṅkha pāṇḍura eva' ityādau śaṅkhatvāvacchedana pāṇḍuravattvasamāvāyābhāvavyavacchedabodhāt‌| `nīlaṃ sarojaṃ bhavatvayeva' ityādau kriyāsaṅgataivasthale'tyantāyogavyavacchedo'rthaḥ|

original: atra kecit-ayoge ātyantikatvaṃ vyavacchidyate| taccānvayitāvacchedakavyāpakatvam| khaṇḍaśaśca tatra śaktiḥ| tathācoktasthale sarojaniṣṭhābhāvapratiyoginīlabhavanābhāva iti bodha iti vadanti|
analyzed: atra kecid ayoge ātyantika tvam vyavacchidyate tat ca anvayi tā avacchedaka vyāpaka tvam khaṇḍaśas ca tatra śaktiḥ tathā ca ukta sthale saroja niṣṭha abhāva pratiyogi nīla bhavana abhāvaḥ iti bodhaḥ iti vadanti

original: vastutastu anyayogavyavacchedāyogavyacavcachedayorevaivakārasya śaktiḥ| anvayitāvacchedakāvacchedenāyogavyavacchedabodhagrahaṇādhyayanārthakadhānusamabhivyāhārasyāpi niyāmakatvāt `jñānamartha gṛhṇātyeva' itivanna jñānaṃ rajataṃ gṛhṇātyevetyādiprayogaḥ| kriyāntarasamabhivyāhāre tu prāyaḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyena tadbhānam|

original: itthañcānvayitāvacchedakasāmānādhikaraṇyenānyayogavyacchedo'tyantāyogavyavacchedo'nvayitāvacchedena tvayogavyavaccheda iti vyavahriyate| vistatarastvanyato'vadhāryyaḥ|
analyzed: ittham ca anvayi tā avacchedaka sāmānādhikaraṇyena anya yoga vyaccheda utyanta ayoga vyavacchedaḥ nvayi tā avacchedena tu ayoga vyavacchedaḥ iti vyavahriyate vistataraḥ tu anyatas vadhāryyaḥ

original: iti mīmāṃsakasidadhāntāsaṅgatiriti bhāvaḥ| dravyasya devatāsambandhitvañca taduddeśyakatyāgākarmatvaṃ tyāgeddeśyatvamapi vedabodhitābādhitadravyasvāmitprakāreṇecchāviṣayatvam| tadeva ca devatātvam| nāto ghṛtādisampradānabrahmaṇasya tyāgoddeśyatve'pi devatātvam|

original: tasya tatsvāmitvābādhāt `endro mantraḥ' ityādau mantrasya taddevatākatvañca na taduddeśyakatyāgakaraṇatvam| vinā'pi mantramicchāviśeṣa-mṛkatyāgotpattyā'vyabhicārāt| kintu tyāgāhgoccārayaṇakatvam| vañca devatāsambandhī pratyayārthaḥ, natu taddevatākatvam, `aindraṃ haviḥ' iti sāmānādhikaraṇyānupapatteḥ|
analyzed: tasya tad svāmi tva ābādhāt ā indraḥ mantraḥ ityādau mantrasya tad devatāka tvañca na tad uddeśyaka tyāga karaṇatvam vinā api mantram icchā viśeṣam ṛka tyāga utpattyā avyabhicārāt kintu devatā sambandhī pratyaya arthaḥ na tu tad devatāka tvam aindram haviḥ iti sāmānādhikaraṇya anupapatteḥ

analyzed: sa ca āmikṣā ādi pada sambhivyāhāre pratīyate deyam pratyaya arthaḥ iti tu tasya āmikṣā ādi pada samabhivyāhāre dāna karma tvena api pratīteḥ iti abhipretya uktam iti bhāvaḥ ukta arthe sammatim āha atas eva iti devatā sambandhinaḥ pratyaya artha tvāt eva iti arthaḥ sānnidhyāt iti sā āmikṣā vaiśvadevī iti atra āmikṣā pada samabhivyāhārāt iti arthaḥ

analyzed: tasya ca sva uddeśyaka tyāga karma tva sambandhena dravya rūpa taddhita apara padārthe iti bodhyam dyotaka tva naye iti vācaka tva naye prakarṣasya upasarga artha tvena tad viśiṣṭe dhātoḥ lakṣaṇāyāḥ akalpanena dṛṣṭhānta tva asambhavāt iti bhāvaḥ prakṛṣṭa jaya vat iti prakṛti aṃśa mātram ādāya dṛṣṭānta tvam bodhyam

original: lābhāditi samabhivyāhṛtadadhyādipadena devatārūpasambandibhānādityarthaḥ| kutaḥ punariti " ananyalabhyo hi śabdārthaḥ" iti nyāyāt| kintu sambandhārthakatvamevocitamiti bhāvaḥ| tatpratīteriti devatāsambandhipratīterityarthaḥ| tathāca tadanupapattyā taddhitasya tadarthakatvamāvaśyakamiti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: lābhāt iti samabhivyāhṛta dadhi ādi padena devatā rūpa sambandi bhānāt iti arthaḥ kutas punar iti ananya labhyaḥ hi śabda arthaḥ iti nyāyāt kintu sambandha arthaka tvam eva ucitam iti bhāvaḥ tad pratīteḥ iti devatā sambandhi pratīteḥ iti arthaḥ tathāca tad anupapattyā taddhitasya tad arthaka tvam āvaśyakam iti bhāvaḥ

original: mīmāṃsakān kaṭākṣīkṛtyāha-mīmāsakānāmiti tanmate tattaddvatākatvarūpapratyayārthena dharmiṇa ākṣepāllābhena sāmānādhikaraṇyopapattiriti bhāvaḥ| `padāntarāt' ityākṣepasyā'pyupalakṣaṇam| vācyaṃ māstviti ākhyātasya karttevaṃ taddhitasya dravyaṃ vācyaṃ māstvityarthaḥ| iṣṭhāpattau `āmikṣāṃ devatāyuktām' iti tvatsiddhāntabhaṅga iti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: mīmāṃsakān kaṭākṣīkṛtya āha mīmāsakānām iti tad mate tad tad dva tāka tva rūpa pratyaya arthena dharmiṇaḥ ākṣepāt lābhena sāmānādhikaraṇya upapattiḥ iti bhāvaḥ pada antarāt iti ākṣepasya api upalakṣaṇam vācyam mā astu iti ākhyātasya kartā ivam taddhitasya dravyam vācyam mā astu iti arthaḥ iṣṭhā āpattau āmikṣām devatā yuktām iti tvad siddhānta bhaṅgaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: naca taddhitasya tadarthakatve'pi kathaṃ tadapekṣayā caturthyā jaghanyatvam, tyāgoddaśyakarūpadevatābodhakatvasyobhayatrāviśiṣṭatvāditi vācyam, nahi detāsambandhideyamātraṃ taddhitārthaḥ| kintu vedabodhyadevatātvaghaṭitaḥ|

original: evañca taddhitārthena yāgasya devatātvāṃśe vedabodhyatvāvagāhitvena tadaṃśe apramāṇyaśaṅkāyā anudayāttaditi viniyojakatayā balavattvaṃ caturthyā tu tadaṃśe vedabodhyatvānavagāhivodhasyaiva jananena tatrāprāmāṇyaśaṅkānirāsārthamupāyāntara syāpekṣaṇājjaghanyatavam|

original: yadvā taddhitena devatātvena rūpema devatābodhe "sā'sya devatā' smāraṇamasti| caturthyāstu devatātve na smaraṇam, "caturtho sampradāne" iti iti sampradāna eva tatsmaraṇāt| sampradānatvañca-tyajyamānadravyoddeśyakatve sati pratigrahītṛtvam|

original: evaṃ mantravarṇādadhiṣṭhānapratītāvapi devatātvasya sākṣādapratītermantravarmasya caturthyapekṣayā jaghanyatvaṃ bodhayam| taddhitasya devatārthakatvānabhyupagame tu tadasaṅtiḥ spaṣṭaiveti|

original: anupapattijñānapūrvokāyāmapi tīraniṣṭhagaṅgāpadalakṣaṇāyāṃ nirūḍhatvavyavahārādāha-anāditi etattattvamabhihitaṃ prāk‌ ekadeśānvayaprasaṅgamāśaṅ‌kyāha-praharaṇakrīḍeti vyutpattivaicitryādekapadopasthitayorapi tayoḥ parasparamanvaya iti bhāvaḥ| praharamasyāpi prakṛtyaiva lābhamabhipretyāha-kraḍāmātrañceti krīḍārūpasambandhyevetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: anupapatti jñāna pūrvokāyām api tīra niṣṭha gaṅgā pada lakṣaṇāyām nirūḍha tva vyavahārāt āhaanāt iti etat tattvam abhihitam prāk eka deśa anvaya prasaṅgam āśaṅkya āha praharaṇa krīḍā iti vyutpatti vaicitryāt eka pada upasthitayoḥ api tayoḥ parasparam anvayaḥ iti bhāvaḥ praharamasya api prakṛtyā eva lābham abhipretya āha kraḍā mātram ca iti krīḍā rūpa sambandhī eva iti arthaḥ

original: mātrapadena tatpraharaṇasya taddhitārthatvavyavacchedaḥ| tathāca daṇḍābhinnapraharasādhanaviśiṣṭā krīḍeti bodhaḥ| so'syeti etatsūtravihitapratyayasya nivāsaḥ sambandhī cārthaḥ| atra nivāsaśabdo'dhikaraṇaghañantaḥ-niśabdena ca vāse nairantaryyarūpātiśayaḥ pratyāyyate| sa ca prakaraṇādinā tattatkālaghaṭito grahyaḥ|
analyzed: mātra padena tad praharaṇasya taddhita artha tva vyavacchedaḥ tathāca daṇḍa abhinna prahara sādhana viśiṣṭā krīḍā iti bodhaḥ saḥ usya iti etad sūtra vihita pratyayasya nivāsaḥ sambandhī ca arthaḥ atra nivāsa śabda udhikaraṇa ghañ antar niśabdena ca vāse nairantarya rūpa atiśayaḥ pratyāyyate sa ca prakaraṇa ādinā tat tat kāla ghaṭitaḥ grahyaḥ

original: tathāca stru dhnābhinnanivāsādhikaraṇasambandhīti bodhaḥ| nivāsaśca pratyāsattyā pratyayārthasambandhikartṛka eva| ata eva kādācitkastru dhne vāsakartari na tathāprayogaḥ|

original: sā'sminniti sūtravihitataddhitasya tu paurṇamāsīghaṭaṭitatvāvacchinno'rtha-| nakṣatranuktakālavihitāṇādyantapauṣyādiśabdānāṃ puṣyādyabhinnanakṣatrakarmakaśaśibhogāśrayakālo'rthaḥ| tasyoktārthaikadeśapaurṇamāsyāmabhedenānvayaḥ| tathāca `pauṣomāsaḥ' ityādau puṣyādyabhinnanakṣatrakarmakaśaśibhogāśrayakālābhinnapaurṇamāsīghaṭito māsa ityādibodhaḥ|
analyzed: sā asmin iti sūtra vihita taddhitasya tu paurṇamāsī ghaṭa ṭita tva avacchinna ūrtha nakṣatra anukta kāla vihita aṇ ādi anta pauṣya ādi śabdānām puṣya ādi abhinna nakṣatra karmaka śaśi bhoga āśraya kāla ūrthaḥ tasya ukta artha eka deśa paurṇamāsyām abhedena anvayaḥ tathāca pauṣaḥ māsaḥ ityādau puṣya ādi abhinna nakṣatra karmaka śaśi bhoga āśraya kāla abhinna paurṇamāsī ghaṭitaḥ māsaḥ ityādi bodhaḥ

analyzed: pauṣa ādi padam ca na kevala yogikam pauṣaḥ paśraḥ iti vyavahāra virahāt kintu rūḍham api etad bodhanāya eva sūtre saṃjñā grahaṇam rūḍhi nirūpaka tā avacchedakam ca na triṃśat tithi samudāya tva rūpa māsa tva mātram

original: yatkiñcittithyavadhikatriṃśaktithisamudāye māsādivyavahāre'pi cādrasaurapauṣādibahirbhūtapauṣyādighaṭitatraṃśattithyantargatatithiṣu pauṣādivyavahāravirahāt, kintu śuklapratipadādirśāntatithisamudāyatvamato noktadoṣa ityādyanyatra vistaraḥ|
analyzed: yat kiñcid tithi avadhika triṃśat tithi samudāye māsa ādi vyavahāre api ca adra saura pauṣa ādi bahis bhūta pauṣya ādi ghaṭita traṃśat tithi antargata tithiṣu pauṣa ādi vyavahāra virahāt kintu śukla pratipad ādiḥ śānta tithi samudāya tvam atas na ukta doṣaḥ ityādi anyatra vistaraḥ

original: "tadasyāstyasmin" iti sūtreṇa prathamāntādastyarthopādhikāt sambandinyādhikaraṇe ca matvarthoyo vidhīyate| yadyapyasyetyukteḥ ṣaṣṭhayarthasambanda eva manubādividhānamābhāti tathā'pi `gomām̐ścaitraḥ' iti sāmānādhikaraṇyānurodhāt sambandhivācakataivetyuktaṃ prāk‌| evañca `gomān' ityādau gonirupitasvāmitvasambandhavānityādyanvayabodhaḥ| naca-
analyzed: tat asya asti asmin iti sūtreṇa prathamā antāt astyartha upādhikāt sambandinyā adhikaraṇe ca vidhīyate yadi api asya iti ukteḥ ṣaṣṭhayartha sambande eva manup ādi vidhānam ābhāti tathā api gomān caitraḥ iti sāmānādhikaraṇya anurodhāt sambandhi vācaka tā eva iti uktam prāk evam ca gomān ityādau go nirupita svāmi tva sambandhavān ityādi anvaya bodhaḥ naca

original: ityādikamityādipadāt `tasyāpatyam' "tena raktaṃ rāgāt" "saṃrakṛtaṃ bhakṣāḥ" ityādisaṅgrahaḥ| tatra 'gārgiḥ' ityādau taddhitārthāpatyasya janyapuruṣasyaikadeśe janyatve-prakṛtyarthagargādernirūpakatayā'nvayāt 'garganirūpitajanyatāśrayaḥ pumān' ityādibodhaḥ|
analyzed: ityādikam iti ādi padāt tasya apatyam tena raktam rāgāt bhakṣāḥ iti ādi saṅgrahaḥ tatra gārgiḥ ityādau taddhita artha apatyasya janya puruṣasya eka deśe janya tve prakṛti artha garga ādeḥ nirūpaka tayā anvayāt garga nirūpita janyatā āśrayaḥ pumān ityādi bodhaḥ

original: `gārgyaḥ' ityādau tu janyapuruṣajanyapuruṣādyātmakagotrāpatyarthaikadeśe janyatve prakṛtyarthānvayaḥ| `gārgyāyaṇaḥ' ityādau taddhitārthayuvāpatyaikadeśe gotrapratyayāntārthasya nirūpakatayā'nvayaḥ| parantu "jīvati tu vaṃsye yuva"| iti paribhāṣaṇād gargajīvanasamānakālikatvamapi pradhānapratyayārtha viśeṣaṇam, tasyāpi pratyayaśakyatvāt|
analyzed: gārgyaḥ ityādau tu janya puruṣa janya puruṣa ādi ātmaka gotra apati artha eka deśe janya tve prakṛti artha anvayaḥ gārgyāyaṇaḥ ityādau taddhita artha yuva apatya eka deśe gotra pratyaya anta arthasya nirūpakatayā anvayaḥ parantu jīvati tu vaṃsye yuvaḥ iti paribhāṣaṇāt garga jīvana samāna kālika tvam api pradhāna pratyaya artha viśeṣaṇam tasya api pratyaya śakya tvāt

original: evañca, gargajīvanasamānakāliko gargagotrāpatyanirūpitajanyatāvānayaṃ pumāniti bodhaḥ|
analyzed: evañca garga jīvana samāna kālikaḥ garga gotra apatya nirūpita janyatāvān ayam pumān iti bodhaḥ

original: "ne raktam" iti vihitapratyayasya tatsampabandhādhīnatadīyarūpāropaviṣayo'rthaḥ| tādṛśāropaviṣayatvamva tena raktatvam| `śaṅkhaḥ pīta.' ityāropamādāya śaṅkhāderāropyapītimāśrayaharitālādinā raktatvavāraṇāyādhīnāntamāropraviseṣaṇam| māñjiṣṭhapaṭādeścakṣurādinā raktatvavāraṇāya tadīyatvarūpaviśeṣaṇam|
analyzed: raktam iti vihita pratyayasya tad sampabandha adhīna tadīya rūpa āropa viṣayaḥ ṛthaḥ tādṛśa āropa viṣaya tvam vai tena rakta tvam śaṅkhaḥ pītaḥ iti āropam ādāya śaṅkha ādeḥ āropya pītim āśraya haritāla ādinā rakta tva vāraṇāya adhīna antam āropra viśeṣaṇam māñjiṣṭha paṭa ādeḥ cakṣuḥ ādinā rakta tva vāraṇāya tadīya tva rūpa viśeṣaṇam

original: atra ca rāgakaraṇasya mañjiṣṭhādeḥ prakṛtyarthasya taddhitārtha syaikadeśasambandhe pratiyogitayā rūpe cādheyatayā'nvayaḥ| tathāca mañjiṣṭhāsambandhādhīno yo mañjiṣṭhāniṣṭharūpāropastadviṣayatāśraya iti `māñjiṣṭhaḥ' ityato bodha-.
analyzed: atra ca rāga karaṇasya mañjiṣṭhā ādeḥ prakṛti arthasya taddhita artha sya eka deśa sambandhe pratiyogitayā rūpe ca ādheyatayā anvayaḥ tathā ca mañjiṣṭhā sambandha adhīnaḥ yaḥ mañjiṣṭhā niṣṭha rūpa āropaḥ tad viṣayatā āśrayaḥ iti māñjiṣṭhaḥ iti atas bodhaḥ

original: "śūlyam," "ukhyam" ityādau "saskṛtaṃ bhakṣāḥ" iti sūtravihitataddhitārthaikadeśe pākādisaṃskāre śūlokhādeḥ prakṛtyarthasyādhikaraṇatvenānvayaḥ| anayaiva rītyā taddhitāntarād bādha ūhanīyaḥ|
analyzed: śūlyam ukhyam ityādau saskṛtam bhakṣāḥ iti sūtra vihita taddhita artha eka deśe pāka ādi saṃskāre śūla ukhā ādeḥ prakṛti arthasya adhikaraṇa tvena anvayaḥ anayā eva rītyā taddhita antarāt bādhaḥ ūhanīyaḥ

original: taddhitānāṃ kvacitprakṛtyarthe svārthaikadeśasya, kvacit svārthesyaivānvayabodhakatvāditi jahatsvārthavṛttipakṣamāvalambya mūlamavatārayati vṛttimātra iti tathāca tatpakṣe padānāmānarthak‌yāt‌ tadarthanirūpaṇe siddhāntaprañyutiriti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: taddhitānām kvacid prakṛti arthe sva artha eka deśasya kvacid sva artha īsya eva anvaya bodhaka tvāt iti jahat svārtha vṛtti pakṣam āvalambya mūlam avatārayati vṛtti mātre iti tathā ca tad pakṣe padānām ānarthakyāt tad artha nirūpaṇe siddhānta prañyutiḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: tadrītyaiveti sāstrāntarīyarītyaivetyarthaḥ| nanu vaiyākaraṇamate jahatsvārthavṛttyāśrayaṇe "na pūjanāt" "tena raktaṃ rāgāt" ityādisūtrāṇāṃ kā gatirata āha-āropiteti| viśiṣṭasaktyaiveti| viśiṣṭārthasyeti śeṣaḥ|
analyzed: tad rītyā eva iti sa astra antarīya rītyā eva iti arthaḥ nanu vaiyākaraṇa mate jahat sva artha vṛtti āśrayaṇe na pūjanāt tena raktam rāgāt ityādi sūtrāṇām kā gatiḥ atas āha āropita iti viśiṣṭa saktyā eva iti viśiṣṭa arthasya iti śeṣaḥ

original: vṛttau pakṣadvayābhyupagamena jahatsvārthapakṣe tad‌ghaṭakapadārthapūpaṇasyānupayāge'pyaja tsvārthapakṣe viśiṣṭaśaktigrahasya pratyekaśaktinirūpaṇāpajīvakatayā tannirūpaṇāsyaucityameva| etatsūcanāyaiva mūle'tīvetyupāttamiti tu rahasyam
analyzed: vṛttau pakṣa dvaya abhyupagamena jahatsvārtha pakṣe tad ghaṭaka padārtha pūpaṇasya anupayāge pi aja tsvārtha pakṣe viśiṣṭa śakti grahasya pratyeka śakti nirūpaṇa apajīvaka tayā tad nirūpaṇa asya aucityam eva etad sūcanāya eva mūla itīva iti upāttam iti tu rahasyam

original: iti vaiyākaraṇabhūṣaṇasāradārpaṇe devatāpratyayārthanirūpaṇam || 10 ||
analyzed: iti vaiyākaraṇa bhūṣaṇa sārada arpaṇe devatā pratyaya artha nirūpaṇam

original: nanu prakrānte prātipadikaghaṭakapratyayārthanirūpaṇe'bhedaikatvasaṅkhayānirūpaṇamasaṅgatamata āha-pṛttiprasaṅgāditi tathāca vṛttinirūpaṇe kriyamāṇe smṛtipathaprāptataddharmopekṣā'nuciteti prasaṅgasaṅgatisattvānnoktadoṣa iti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: nanu prakrānte prātipadika ghaṭaka pratyaya artha nirūpaṇe bheda ekatva saṅkhaya anirūpaṇam asaṅgatam atas āha pṛtti prasaṅgāt iti tathā ca vṛtti nirūpaṇe kriyamāṇe smṛti patha prāpta tad dharma upekṣā anucitā iti prasaṅga saṅgati sattvāt na ukta doṣaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: uktārthe harivākyaṃ pramāṇayati-uktañceti| āhitaśaktayaḥ āhitā-samarpitā tattaddoṣavibhedanivandhanā virodharūpā śaktiryairityarthaḥ| tyaktavirodhā iti yāvat| ata eva avibhāgena-avirodhenetyarthaḥ| tām-abhedaikatvasaṅkhayām| tādadṛśīṃ-madhuniṣṭharasasthititulyāmityarthaḥ| nanvekatvadvitvādīnāmekatra sattvamanupapannam|

original: nahi dvāvekatvena vyavahaṇiyate, nāpyeko dvāviti, "nahi dviṣutraḥ" iti bhāvaṣyāt| kiñca dṛṣṭānto'pi na samañjasaḥ, tattadrasavadārabdhe'vayavini mākṣike'vayavasajātīyarasāntarasyaibotpādābhyupagamādata āha-parityakteti vāśabdaḥ pakṣāntare| agṛhītīviseṣadharmakaṃ skhyāmātramityarthaḥ|
analyzed: nahi dvau ekatvena na api ekaḥ dvau iti nahi dviṣutraḥ iti kiñca dṛṣṭāntaḥ api na samañjasaḥ tad tad rasa vat ārabdha ivayavini mākṣika iva yava sajātīya rasa antarasya eva utpāda abhyupagamāt atas āha parityakta iti vā śabdaḥ pakṣa antare skhyā mātram iti arthaḥ

original: pūrvakalpe uktāsvarasābhisandhikaṃ vākyapadīyaṃ tatpakṣe'pi pramāṇatvenopanyasyati-bhedānāmiti bhedānām-ekatvatvadvitvatvādiviśeṣadharmaṇāṃ parityāgād-agrahāt| idañca vyāpārapadārtheabhedenānvayi| saṃkhyātmā-saṃkhyāsvarūpaḥ| saḥ-ekatvādiḥ| tathāvidhaḥ-abhedaikatvavyapadeśya ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: pūrva kalpe ukta asvarasa abhisandhikam vākyapadīyam tad pakṣe api pramāṇa tvena upanyasyati bhedānām iti bhedānām ekatva tva dvitva tva ādi viśeṣa dharmaṇām parityāgāt agrahāt idam ca vyāpāra padārthe abhedena anvayi saṃkhyā ātmā asaṃkhyā svarūpaḥ saḥ ekatva ādiḥ tathāvidhaḥ abheda ekatva vyapadeśyaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: tadeva viśadayati- jātibhāgasyeti ekatvatvāderityarthaḥ|

original: bhedāpoheneti bhedasya viśeṣamasya yo'poho'graharūpo yo vyāpāro viśeṣaṇā'tmā tato varttata ityarthaḥ| "bhedāpoho na varttate" tathācaikatvatvāderjātiviśeṣasya bhedāgraharūpo yo vyāpāro viśeṣaṇā'tmā tato varttata ityarthaḥ| "bhedāpoho na varttate" iti vā pāṭhe tu bhedarūpo yo'poho'tad‌vyāvṛttaṃ sa na varttate-na bhāsate ityartho'vaseyaḥ|

original: padyāntarāvalokanenaitatpāṭhasyaiva harisammatatvamadhyavasīyate| dvitvatvādyagrahakālisaṅkhayātvaprakārakapratītigaucaraḥ saṅkhayāpadārtho'bhedaikatvapadavyapadeśyo bhavatīti samuditārthaḥ| tatra dṛṣṭāntaramāha-agṛhītaviśeṣeṇeti śuklatvādiprakārakagrahāsamānakālikarūpatvaprakārakapratītiviṣayeṇa śuklādinaiva yathā ghaṭādī rūpavāniti pratīyate|

original: sā ca saṃkhyāpūrvottarādārthayoḥ sambandhavad vṛttisakyaiva ajahatsvārthāvṛttikṣe pūrvapadasya saṃkhyāviśeṣavācakatve gamakābhāve, tena `dviputraḥ', `maudrikaḥ' `māsajātaḥ' `tāvakīnaḥ' `bhādrirāmavasara' ityādau vṛttāvabhedaikatvasaṃkhyāyā abhāne'pi na kṣatiḥ|

original: ādyo-saṃkhyāviśaiṣasyaiva pūrvapadārthatvāt| dvitīye-ekamudrasya krayakaraṇāyogyatvād bahutvāvagatiḥ| tṛtīye-viśiṣṭakālāṃvagamāya māsapadaprayogāt saṃkhyā'dhyavasāyaḥ. caturthe-tavakādyādeśādekatvāvagātiḥ| pañcame-prakaraṇād dvitvāvagatiḥ| evam-`kārakamadhye' ityādāvapyūhyam, ekasya madhyāsambhavāt|
analyzed: ādyaḥ saṃkhyā viśaiṣasya eva pūrva padārtha tvāt dvitīye eka mudrasya kraya karaṇa ayogya tvāt bahu tva avagatiḥ tṛtīye viśiṣṭa kāla avagamāya māsa pada prayogāt saṃkhyā adhyavasāyaḥ caturthe tavaka ādi ādeśāt eka tva avagātiḥ pañcame prakaraṇāt dvi tva avagatiḥ evam kāraka madhye ityādau api ūhyam ekasya madhya asambhavāt

original: tatra trayāṇām, caturādīnāṃ vā''lambhamiti saṃśeye bahutvavyāpyatvasya tritvādiṣu sarvaiṣvapyaviśiṣṭatvādyathāprāptamevālabdhavyamiti pūrvasya caturādīnāmālamabhanam, "mā hiṃsyāt" iti sāmānyaśāstravihitaniṣedhasyālabhyatāvad‌vyaktītaraparatvarūpatātparyasaṃkocakalpane gauravād gaṇanāyāṃ prathamopasthitatritvaparatayā'pi vacanasya

original: nanu jijñāsāyāṃ śābdameva sāmānyadharmaprakārakajñānadarśanamapekṣitamiti na niyamaḥ āmrādiphaladarśanenāpi tadrasā svādanecchāyā vyabhicārāt| nacaivaṃ sāmānyadharmaprakārakajñānasyaiva hetutvaṃ vilīyeteti vācyam, āmradarśanasyod‌bodhakatayā tadrasasmaraṇena tadupapatteḥ|
analyzed: nanu jijñāsāyām śābdam eva sāmānya dharma prakāraka jñāna darśanam apekṣitam iti na niyamaḥ āmra ādi phala darśanena api tad rasā svādana icchāyāḥ vyabhicārāt na ca evam sāmānya dharma prakāraka jñānasya eva hetu tvam vilīyeta iti vācyam āmra darśanasya udbodhaka tayā tad rasa smaraṇena tad upapatteḥ

original: prakṛte tasyā aśakyatve'pi tadavyabhicaritadravyatvenānumānikatad‌bodhasambhavāt tādṛśajijñāsāyā ananubhavācca noktayuktirvṛttirebhedaikatvasakhyārthatvasādhiketyabhipretyāha-vastuta iti jijñāsaiveti-`rājapuruṣaḥ' ityādau pūrvapadārthe ekatva-dvitvādiprakārakajijñāsaivetyarthaḥ| anubhavasiddheti|

original: asya yena tadanurodhena sāmānyadharma prakārakajñānisyāvaśyakatā syāditi śeṣaḥ| `abhedaikatvasaṃkhyāyā vṛttau bhānam' iti mūlaṃ tu prācīnagranthānuvāda eveti bhāvaḥ|

original: naca tatra mānābhāvaḥ, "jāyate ca kāryye kāraṇe vā jñāte kāryaṃ kāraṇaṃ vā" iti dīdhitikṛdvākyasyaiva mānatvāt| prakṛte viśeṣadharmasya pāratantryeṇaivecchāṃ se prakāratvāttaddharmaprakārakajñānaṃ vināpi sāmānyadharmaprakārakajñānat tādṛśajijñāsāyā)ḥ sūpapādatvāt|

original: dhātoritīti pratyayavidhau "dhātoḥ" iti sūtrasthadhātupadārthaviśeṣaṇībhūtaikatvāderetacchāstre avivakṣaṇādityarthaḥ| asyamacchāstre tu uddeśyagataviśeṣaṇasyāvivakṣā mīmāṃsakānāmapi sammatetyāha-utpadyeteti| viśeṣyeteti| tadā sa pratyayārthaḥ| sarvairdhātvarthairviśiṣyetetyarthaḥ|

original: nanu neyaṃ yuktirvivakṣāsādhikā, tādṛśasamudāyasya kriyāvacanatvābāvena tataḥ pratyayotpattergaganakusumāyamāntavena svata eva vivakṣāsattvādata āha- ārddhadhātukasyeṅ‌valāderitīti| vivakṣitatvācceti| anyathā tadupādānavaiyarthyāpatteriti bhāva-. evamiti anuvādyaviśeṣamavivakṣitameva| niyamānāśrayaṇavādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: nanu nā iyam yuktiḥ vivakṣā sādhikā tādṛśa samudāyasya kriyā vacana tva abāvena tatas pratyaya utpatteḥ gaganakusumāyamāntavena svatas eva vivakṣā sattvāt atas āha ārddhadhātukasya iṅ val ādeḥ iti iti vivakṣita tvāt ca iti anyathā tad upādāna vaiyarthya āpatteḥ iti bhāvaḥ evam iti anuvādya viśeṣam avivakṣitam eva niyama anāśrayaṇavāt iti arthaḥ

original: `paśunā yajeta' ityatra yajyarthayāgasya karaṇākāṅkṣāyāṃ sādhanattvena paśurvidhīyate| evañca paśuśabdasya vidheyasamarpakatayā tadupasthitānāṃ keṣāñcid, grahaṇe, keṣācchit parityāge mānābhāvena paśutvapaṃustvādivadekatvamapi yāgasādhanatvena vivakṣitam| tena nānekapaśukaraṇayāgādadṛṣṭasiddhiḥ| evamanyatrāpi vidheyaviśeṣaṇaṃ vivakṣitam|
analyzed: paśunā yajeta iti atra yaji artha yāgasya karaṇa ākāṅkṣāyām sādhana ttvena paśuḥ vidhīyate evam ca paśu śabdasya vidheya samarpaka tayā tad upasthitānām keṣāñcid grahaṇe parityāge māna abhāvena paśu tva paṃuḥ tva ādi vat ekatvam api yāga sādhanatvena vivakṣitam tena na aneka paśu karaṇa yāgāt adṛṣṭa siddhiḥ evam anyatra api vidheya viśeṣaṇam vivakṣitam

original: atrāvivakṣākāraṇavirahāditi mīmāṃsakapariśīlitā saraṇistadanusaraṇāniyamo nāsmākamityaḥ| etacchāstre tadāśrayaṇe'niṣṭaṃ pradarśayati-radābhyāmiti| vidhānānāpatteriti `na' ityekavacanopasthitaikatvasyāpi vidheyaviśeṣaṇatayā tad‌vavakṣāyāṃ nakāradvayavidhānaṃ na syādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: atra avivakṣā kāraṇa virahāt iti mīmāṃsaka pariśīlitā saraṇiḥ tad anusaraṇa aniyamaḥ na asmākam ityaḥ etad śāstre pradarśayati radābhyām iti vidhāna anāpatteḥ iti naḥ iti ekavacana upasthita ekatvasya api vidheya viśeṣaṇatayā nakāra dvaya vidhānam na syāt iti arthaḥ

original: nanu māstu nadvayavidhānamata āha-tathāceti itañacaikavākyatayā vidhānamamipretya, vākyabhedena vidhānapakṣe tvāha-ādguṇa ityādāviti| ekātvavivakṣayaiveti vidheyagumagataikatvavivakṣayaivetyarthaḥ| tathācaikagrahaṇamevoktārthejñāpakamiti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: nanu mā astu na dvaya vidhānam atas āha tathā ca iti itañaca eka vākyatayā vidhānam amipretya vākya bhedena vidhāna pakṣe tu āha āt guṇaḥ ityādau iti ekātva vivakṣayā eva iti vidheya guma gata ekatva vivakṣayā eva iti arthaḥ tathāca eka grahaṇam eva ukta arthe jñāpakam iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu paśvekatvādivivakṣāhetūnāṃ jaiminisammatatvānna tadāśrayaṇasyānākaratvamityāśaṅkāmapākariṣyan yojanāpradarśana miṣeṇā'karapādārtha vyācaṣṭe-śabdārthastvityādiḥ|
analyzed: nanu paśu ekatva ādi vivakṣā hetūnām jaimini sammata tvāt na tad āśrayaṇasya anākaratvam iti āśaṅkām apākariṣyan yojanā pradarśana miṣeṇa ākara pāda artha vyācaṣṭe śabda arthaḥ tu ityādiḥ

original: paśvekatvādhikaraṇoktahetūnāmiti `paśunā yajet' ityatra vidheyagataikatvasyāvivakṣaṇe paśvantarālambhe prayogaprāṃśabhāvabādhena yāgavaiguṇyāpattiḥ, guṇānurodhena yāgā''va़ttau pradhānatvabhaṅgāpattiryāvatpasukaraṇakayāgāsambhavaścetvevamādayo dīṣā hetavasteṣāmityarthaḥ|
analyzed: paśu ekatva adhikaraṇa ukta hetūnām iti paśunā yajet iti atra vidheya gata ekatvasya avivakṣaṇe paśu antara ālambhe prayoga prāṃśabhāva bādhena yāga vaiguṇya āpattiḥ guṇa anurodhena yāga ava़ttau pradhāna tva bhaṅga āpattiḥ yāvat pasu karaṇaka yāga asambhavaḥ ced itu evamādayaḥ dīṣāḥ hetavaḥ teṣām iti arthaḥ

original: siddhāntasiddhamiti siddhāntārthapratipādakamahābhāṣyādisiddhamityarthaḥ ādeśabhedavāraṇāyeti| vastutasyu naikagrahaṇaṃ vidheyagaviśeṣaṇāvivakṣāyāṃ tantram, `anyoḥ pūlayoḥ kaṭaṃ kuru' ityādāviva `ād‌ guṇaḥ' ityādāvapi `pūrvaparayoḥ' iti dvandvanirdeśenaikavākyatayaivobhayoḥ sthāne ekavidhānasambhavātsthānibhedānnāneko guṇa ityekagrahaṇasya bhāṣye
analyzed: siddhānta siddham iti siddhānta artha pratipādaka mahābhāṣya ādi siddham iti arthaḥ ādeśa bheda vāraṇāya iti na eka grahaṇam tantram anyoḥ pūlayoḥ kaṭam kuru ityādau iva guṇaḥ ityādau api pūrva parayoḥ iti dvandva nirdeśena eka vākyatayā eva ubhayoḥ sthāne eka vidhāna sambhavāt sthāni bhedāt na anekaḥ guṇaḥ iti eka grahaṇasya bhāṣye

original: praṃtyākhyānāditi rahasyat|
analyzed: pratyākhyānāt iti rahasyat

original: vākyabhedādiriti `prājāpatyā navagrahāḥ' iti vākyavihitagrahoddeśena sammārgo vidhaīyate grahaṃ sammārṣṭityanena| tatrānuvādyagrahaikatvavivāyāmutpattivākyagatasaṅkhayāyā virodhād vākyasya yaco bhedo vibhinnabiśeṣyakabodhajanakatvaṃ tādapāyā dītyarthaḥ| anye tu-`grahaṃ samārṣṭi' tañacaikam' ityākārakavākyabhedāpattimāhuḥ|
analyzed: vākya bheda ādiḥ iti prājāpatyāḥ nava grahāḥ iti vākya vihita graha uddeśena sammārgaḥ vidhaīyate graham sammārṣṭ iti anena tatra anuvādya graha ekatva vivāyām utpatti vākya gata saṅkhayāyāḥ virodhāt vākyasya bhedaḥ vibhinna viśeṣyaka bodha janakatvam tādapāyāḥ anye tu graham samārṣṭi iti ākāraka vākya bheda āpattim āhuḥ

original: ādipadenotpattivākyagatanavatvasaṅkhayayā grahapadārthasya paricchinnatvātparicchedakāṅ‌kṣābhāvasya `graham' iti dvitīyayā saṃskāryyatvalakṣaṇaprādhānyabodhānāt `pratipradhānaṃ guṇāvṛttiḥ' iti nyāyādvinigamanāvirahāt somāvasekanirākaphalakasammārgasya sarvairgrahaipekṣaṇādvidheyapaśvādiviśeṣaṇavat kriyāṅgatvābhāvena
analyzed: ādi padena utpatti vākya gata nava tva saṅkhayayā graha padārthasya paricchinna tvāt pariccheda kāṅkṣā bhāvasya graham iti dvitīyayā saṃskāryya tva lakṣaṇa prādhānya bodhānāt pratipradhānam guṇa āvṛttiḥ iti nyāyāt vinigamana avirahāt soma avaseka nirāka phalaka sammārgasya sarvaiḥ graha aipekṣaṇāt vidheya paśu ādi viśeṣaṇa vat kriyā aṅga tva abhāvena

original: tadvaikalyaprayuktakriyāvaikalyāprasakteśca tadvivakṣāvirahavījasya ca saṃgrahaḥ, anākaramiti pūrvavat| `iḍāgamādeḥ' ityādinā-`udīcāmātaḥ sthāne yakapūrvāyāḥ', iti vihatetvasaṃgrahaḥ| tatrā''kārasthānikā'tamuddisyetvavidhānāt| ata eveṇniṣedhavidhāyakaikājiti sūtre `acaḥ' ityekatvavivakṣādareṇānekāckopadeśavyāvṛttirgranthaḥ kṛdbhirvyākhyātā|
analyzed: tad vaikalya prayukta kriyā vaikalya aprasakteḥ ca tad vivakṣā viraha vījasya ca saṃgrahaḥ an ākaram iti pūrvavat sthāne ya ka pūrvāyāḥ iti vihata itva saṃgrahaḥ tatra ākāra sthānika a tam uddisya itva vidhānāt atas eva iṭ niṣedha vidhāyaka eka a c iti sūtre a caḥ iti ekatva vivakṣā ādareṇa aneka a cka upadeśa vyāvṛttiḥ granthaḥ kṛdbhiḥ vyākhyātā

original: vastutastu grahaikatvadṛṣṭāntenātrāpyanuvādaviśeṣaṇanām, saṅ‌khyādīnāṃ kacidavivakṣā'stu, taditaraviśeṣaṇānāṃ vākyādevāvagamenānuṣaṅgikatvādavivakṣāyujyate| prakṛte tu na tatheti bodhyam
analyzed: vastutas tu graha ekatva dṛṣṭāntena atra api anuvāda viśeṣaṇanām saṅkhyā ādīnām kacid avivakṣā astu tad itara viśeṣaṇānām vākyāt eva avagamena ānuṣaṅgika tvāt avivakṣā āyujyate prakṛte tu na tathā iti bodhyam

original: iti vaiyākaraṇabhūṣaṇasāradarpaṇe saṅkhayāvivakṣā'dinirṇayaḥ || 12 ||
analyzed: iti vaiyākaraṇa bhūṣaṇa sāradarpaṇe saṅkhaya avivakṣā ādi nirṇayaḥ

original: avasarasaṅgati ktvādyarthanirūpaṇe darśayati-ktvāpratyayāderiti| prakṛtyarthetvasya phale'pi sattvādāha-bhāva iti tatrāpi sattvabhūte vyāpāre eva, natu pūrvakālādāvityartha-| `pākaḥ' ityādāviva `paktum' paktvetyādijanyabodhe bhāvāṃśe vaikṣyasyānanubhavāditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: avasara saṅgati ktvā ādi artha nirūpaṇe darśayati ktvā pratyaya ādeḥ iti prakṛti artha itvasya phale pi sattva ādāha bhāvaḥ iti tatra api sattva bhūte vyāpāre eva na tu pūrva kāla ādau iti artha pākaḥ ityādau iva paktum paktvā ityādi janya bodhe bhāva aṃśe vaikṣyasya ananubhavāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: vastutastu paktvā ityādijanyobodhe bhāve liṅgasaṅkhayānanvayitvaṃ tadanubhūyata eva| evaṃ `paktum' ityādau phalārthakatumunā sādhyatvena tad‌bodhāccetyuktaprāyamiti|
analyzed: vastutas tu paktvā ityādi janyaḥ bodhe bhāve liṅga saṅkhaya ananvayi tvam tat anubhūyate eva evam paktum ityādau phala arthaka tumunā sādhyatvena tad bodhāt ca iti ukta prāyam iti

original: kā gatiriti tatra `pūrvakāle' ityādyupādānāt pūrvakālādīnāṃ vācyatā pratīyate| bhāvamātrārthakatve tu tadanupapattiriti bhāvaḥ| samānakarttṛkatvādīti|
analyzed: kā gatiḥ iti tatra pūrva kāle ityādi upādānāt pūrva kāla ādīnām vācya tā pratīyate bhāva mātra arthaka tve tu tad anupapattiḥ iti bhāvaḥ samāna karttṛka tva ādi iti

original: tathāca samānakarttakayordhātvarthayormadhye pūrvakālasambandhī yo'rthastadvācakāt ktvetyarthe'rthākāṅkṣāyām `kartari kṛt' ityasya prasaktau tad‌bādhanārtha vārttikārambheṇa bhāvasyaiva vācyatā nirdhāryyate| karttuḥ pratyayaviśeṣaṇatve tu samānakarttarītyeve brūyāt| sūtropāttānāṃ tu dyotyatvameva, varttamānatvādivaditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: tathāca samāna karttakayoḥ dhātvarthayoḥ madhye pūrva kāla sambandhī yaḥ ṛthaḥ tad vācakāt ktvā iti artha irtha ākāṅkṣāyām kartari kṛt ityasya prasaktau tad bādhana artha vārttika ārambheṇa bhāvasya eva vācya tā nirdhāryyate karttuḥ pratyaya viśeṣaṇa tve tu brūyāt sūtra upāttānām tu dyotya tvam eva varttamāna tva ādi vat iti bhāvaḥ

original: vastutastu na dyotyatāyāmapi nirbharaḥ, saṃsargamaryādayaiva tadbhānasambhavādityāha-ayaṃ bhāva iti|
analyzed: vastutas tu na dyotya tāyām api nirbharaḥ saṃsarga maryādayā eva tad bhāna sambhavāt iti āha ayam bhāvaḥ iti

original: `samānakarttṛkayoḥ' ityādisūtrāṇāṃ dhātusambandhadhikārīyātvāditi bhāvaḥ| anupapanneti viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇatvayoḥ saṃsargaviṣayatānūrūpyatvena sambandhaṃ vinā viśiṣṭabuddherevāsambhavātsambandhabhānaṃ tadvācyatāṃ vināpyupapannamiti bhāvaḥ| anyatheti viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāvamantareṇāpyekavākyatābhyupagame ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: samāna karttṛkayoḥ ityādi sūtrāṇām dhātu sambandha dhikārī iyātvāt iti bhāvaḥ anupapanna iti viśeṣya viśeṣaṇa tvayoḥ saṃsarga viṣaya tā ānūrūpya tvena sambandham vinā viśiṣṭa buddheḥ eva asambhavāt sambandha bhānam tad vācyatām vinā api upapannam iti bhāvaḥ anyathā iti viśeṣya viśeṣaṇa bhāvam antareṇa api ekavākyatā abhyupagame iti arthaḥ

original: sāmānādhikaraṇyamiti ekā'śrayavṛttitvamityarthaḥ| pūrvottarabhāvaḥ-svottarasamyotpattikatvam, svapūrvasamayavṛttitvaṃ vā| vyāpyatvam-avinābhāvitvam| tumunādyante sābdabodhiśamāha-tathāceti|
analyzed: sāmānādhikaraṇyam iti eka āśraya vṛtti tvam iti arthaḥ sva pūrva samaya vṛtti tvam vā vyāpya tvam avinābhāvi tvam tumuna ādi ante

original: bhojanajaniketi janakatvasyātra saṃsargateti sphuṭīkarttumiyamuktiḥ| bodhākārastu bhojanaviśiṣṭetyeva, janakatvasyāpadārthatayā'prakāratvāt| kriyayoḥ janyajanakabhāvasyāpi sambandhatve yuktimāha-ata eveti| janyatvasya saṃsaragatvābhyupagamādevetyarthaḥ| `jalapānāntaryasya' ityanena pūrvottaravākyasambandhasattvaṃ bodhyate|
analyzed: bhojana janikā iti janakatvasya atra saṃsargatā iti sphuṭīkarttum iyam uktiḥ bodha ākāraḥ tu bhojana viśiṣṭā iti eva janakatvasya apadārtha tayā aprakāratvāt kriyayoḥ janya janaka bhāvasya api sambandha tve yuktim āha atas eva iti janyatvasya saṃsaraga tva abhyupagamāt eva iti arthaḥ jala pāna āntaryasya iti anena pūrva uttara vākya sambandha sattvam bodhyate

original: tajjanyatvavivakṣāyā natu prayoga iṣṭa eveti bhāvaḥ| sāmānādhikaraṇyasya prakṛtapadavṛttigrahāviṣayatayā saṃsargatābhyupagamastu yatra pūrvāparībhāvāpannabhojanatṛptyorvaiyadhikaraṇyaṃ tatra bhuktvā tṛpyati' itiprayogavāraṇāya| avyavahitottaratvasya tu-dināntaritapūrvakālavṛttisamānādhikaraṇabhojanādikriyāmādāya ktvāvāraṇāya|
analyzed: tad janya tva vivakṣāyāḥ na tu prayogaḥ iṣṭaḥ eva iti bhāvaḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyasya prakṛta pada vṛtti graha aviṣaya tayā saṃsargatā abhyupagamaḥ tu yatra pūrvāparībhāva āpanna bhojana tṛptyoḥ vaiyadhikaraṇyam tatra bhuktvā tṛpyati iti prayoga vāraṇāya avyavahita uttara tvasya tu dina antarita pūrva kāla vṛtti samāna adhikaraṇa bhojana ādi kriyām ādāya ktvā vāraṇāya

original: vyavadhānañca-tātparyavaśāddaṇḍamuhūrttādinā grāhyam, ato bhojanānantaraṃ daṇḍādivyavadhāne'pi na tādṛśaprayogānupapattiriti bodhyam|
analyzed: vyavadhānam ca tātparya vaśāt daṇḍa muhūrtta ādinā grāhyam atas bhojana anantaram daṇḍa ādi vyavadhāne api na tādṛśa prayoga anupapattiḥ iti bodhyam

original: nanu pūrvottarabhāvasya sambandatābhyupagame'dhyayanakāle `adhītya tiṣṭhati' iti prayogānupapattiḥ, sthitāvadhyayanānantaryyābhāvāt| evam `mukhaṃ vyādāya svapiti' iti na syāt, oṣṭhapuṭavibhāgārūpavyādānakāle eva svāpādisattve tādṛśaprayogasyeṣṭhatvena vyādānāsya svāpapūrvakatvābhāvādata āha-adhītya tiṣṭhatītyādi|
analyzed: nanu pūrva uttara bhāvasya sambandatā abhyupagame adhi ayana kāle adhītya tiṣṭhati iti prayoga anupapattiḥ sthitau adhyayana ānantaryya abhāvāt evam mukham vyādāya svapiti iti na syāt oṣṭha puṭa vibhāga ārūpa vyādāna kāle eva svāpa ādi sattve tādṛśa prayogasya iṣṭhatvena vyādāna asya svāpa pūrvakatva abhāvāt atas āha adhītya tiṣṭhati ityādi

original: kālaviśeṣeti vibhinnakālikayoḥ kālikasambandhaghaṭitavyāpyavyāpakabhāvābhāvena tatsambandhāvacchinnavyāpyatvasyāpi saṃsargatopagantavyā| na kevalaṃ tatra vyāpyatvasyaiva saṃsargatā, kintu sāmānādhikaparaṇyasyāpītyāha-sāmānādhikaraṇyañceti nāto vibhinnakarttṛkaikakālikādhyayanādikamādāyoktaprayogāpatitiḥ|
analyzed: kāla viśeṣa iti vibhinna kālikayoḥ kālika sambandha ghaṭita vyāpya vyāpaka bhāva abhāvena tad sambandha avacchinna vyāpya tvasya api saṃsarga tā upagantavyā na kevalam tatra vyāpya tvasya eva saṃsarga tā kintu sāmānādhika paraṇyasya api iti āha sāmānādhikaraṇyam ca iti na atas vibhinna karttṛka eka kālika adhyayana ādikam ādāya ukta prayoga āpatitiḥ

original: evañca `samānakartṛkayoḥ' iti sūtravihitaktvāntasthale samānakartṛkatvarūpasāmānādhikaraṇyasaṃsargasya śābdabodhaviṣayatā sārvatriki| janyatvādīnāṃ tu tātparyyavaśāt kvācitkī seti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: evam ca samāna kartṛkayoḥ iti sūtra vihita k tva anta sthale samāna kartṛka tva rūpa sāmānādhikaraṇya saṃsargasya śābda bodha viṣaya tā sārvatriki janya tva ādīnām tu tātparyya vaśāt kvācitkī sā iti bhāvaḥ

original: anyetu-sāmānādhikaraṇyasyaiva pūrvottarabhāvasyāpi kt‌vāntajabodaviṣayatā sārvatrikī, `mukhaṃ vyādāya' ityādau `suptvā mukhaṃ vyādatte' ityatreva vyādānottaramapi svāpānuvṛttestathā paurvāparyyamādāya prayogopapattiḥ| evañcoktasambandhadvayātiriktasambandhabhānasyaiva kvācitktavamityāhuḥ| naca `avajānāsi māṃ yasmādataste na bhaviṣyati|
analyzed: anya itu sāmānādhikaraṇyasya eva pūrva uttara bhāvasya api ktvā anta ja boda viṣaya tā sārvatrikī mukham vyādāya ityādau suptvā mukham vyādatte iti atra eva vyādāna uttaram api svāpa anuvṛtteḥ tathā paurvāparyyam ādāya prayoga upapattiḥ evam ca ukta sambandha dvaya atirikta sambandha bhānasya eva kvācid ktavam iti āhuḥ na ca avajānāsi mām yasmāt atas te na bhaviṣyati

original: matprasūtimanārādhya prajeti tvāṃ śaśāpasā'|| ityatra matprasūtimanārādhya te prajā na bhaviṣyatītyarthādvibhinnakartṛkādapi ktvādarśanāt samānakartṛkatvasyāpi ktvāntajanyabodhaviṣayatā na sārvatrikīti vācyam, sūtrasvārasāttādṛśasthale sthityādikriyāmadhyāhṛtyā'nārādhya sthitasyaiti bodhasyābhyupagamena sārvatrikatvākṣateriti|
analyzed: mad prasūtim an ārādhya prajā iti tvām śaśāpa saḥ iti atra mad prasūtim an ārādhya te prajā na bhaviṣyati iti arthāt vibhinna kartṛkāt api ktvā darśanāt samāna kartṛka tvasya api ktvā anta janya bodha viṣayatā na sārvatrikī iti vācyam sūtra svārasāt tādṛśa sthale sthiti ādi kriyām adhyāhṛtya an ārādhya sthitasya eti bodhasya abhyupagamena sārvatrika tva akṣateḥ iti

analyzed: tādṛśa varṇa tva avacchedena vācaka tva ādi sāvane tu vaiyākaraṇānām pareṣām vikāraṇeṣu bādhaḥ ca iti atas āha tad smṛtāḥ iti nanu yathāśrute sādhu śabda antargatā vācakaḥ tad antargata varṇa smāritā na iti artha lābhāt etad vākyasya vibhinna dharmi bodhaka tvāt vipratipatti tvasya eva asambhavaḥ eka dharmika viruddha koṭika saṃśaya janakasya eva tattvāt vyācaṣṭe

analyzed: tathāca sādhu antargata varṇa smārita varma tva avacchedena mata bhedena ubhaya sādhanāt na ukta doṣaḥ iti bhāvaḥ yathuśruta mūla ukta vipratipattim anusutya āha sādhu śabdaḥ ityādi nanu sādhu antargata varṇānām bodhakatva sādhane pi na vācakatva siddhiḥ atas āha bodhaka vācakāḥ iti tasya eva iti bodhakatvasya eva iti arthaḥ prāk iti śakti nirūpaṇa avasare iti arthaḥ

original: nacāsādhutvajñānaṃ pratibandhakam, śaktatvarūpasādhutāyā api sattvādapabhraṃśādapi bodhodayena tadīyajñānasyāpratibandhakatvācceti bhāvaḥ| tādṛśeti āpāditakartṛbodhe ityarthaḥ. samabhivyāhāra iti pūrvāparībhāvāpannavarṇasamudāya ityarthaḥ, āvaśyakatvāttaṃ vinā lakāreṇāpi bodhājananenoktasamabhivyāhārasyāpekṣatvādityarthaḥ|

original: gauravamiti yadyapyādeśavācakatāvādimate `bhūti' ityāto vidyamānabhavanakartṛbodhavāraṇāya tādṛśabodhe `bhavati' iti samabhivyāhārasya hetutāyā avaśyakalpyatvād, gauravasāmyameva, tathāpyādeśismṛtyakalpanaprayuktalāghavamakṣuṇṇameveti bhāvaḥ|

original: nanvetāvatā samabhivyāhārasya vācakaṃtvamāyātam, na prayogāntargatadhātupratyayaghaṭakānāṃ varṇānāmata āha-tathāceti vinigamanāvirahāditi naca varṇānāṃ bāhulyameva vinigamakam, uktānupūrvyāstadanugamakatvāditi bhāvaḥ|

original: anyeti anākāṅkṣe'pi śāstrapravṛttāvityarthaḥ| śaktatāvacchedakabhedasya tatrāpi sattvāditi bhāvaḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyānurodhāditi śānacaḥ kṛtivācakatve sarvānubhavasiddhābhedānvayabodhānupapatterityarthaḥ| laṅādesatvabodhanaphalaṃ dhātvarthe varttamānatvapratītireveti bodhyam| pacatikalpamiti idañca svādyantaṃ nāmeti matamanusṛtya|

original: `sattvapradhānāni nāmāni' iti niruktāt dravyaviśeṣyakabodhajanakatvaṃ nāmatvam| tadeva ca nāmārthayoriti vyutpattighaṭakam| ata eva nipātārthasya bhedānvaya iti matenedaṃ dūṣaṇamiti tu pare| lakṣaṇetyasya lasyeti śeṣaḥ|
analyzed: sattva pradhānāni nāmāni iti niruktāt dravya viśeṣyaka bodha janaka tvam nāma tvam tat eva ca nāma arthayoḥ iti vyutpatti ghaṭakam atas eva nipāta arthasya bheda anvayaḥ iti matena idam dūṣaṇam iti tu pare lakṣaṇā iti asya lasya iti śeṣaḥ

original: āpatteriti naca sā taveṣṭeti bhāvaḥ| nanvādeśānāṃ vācakatve ādeśiśaktipratipādaka `laḥ karmaṇi' ityāditrāṇāṃ vaiyarthyamata āha-laḥ karmaṇīti| uktamiti ākhyātaśaktinirūpaṇāvasara iti śeṣaḥ| evañca prayoge śruyamāṇaprakṛtipratyayaghaṭakavarṇeṣu śaktirvarṇasphoṭamiti paryyavasannam iti varṇasphoṭanirūpaṇam || 13 ||

original: padasphoṭanirūpaṇe upajīvyopajīvakabhāvasyāpi saṅgatitvaṃ sūcayan mūlamavatārayati-evamiti uktarītyetyarthaḥ| ādeśānāmapi keṣāñcit prayogāntargatatvādāha-tibvisargādaya iti prayogāntargatavarṇā iti yāvat| nanu tādṛśayāvad‌varṇānāṃ vācakatve kathaṃ padasphoṭasiddhirato bhāvārthamāha-ayamiti samabhivyāhṛtaṃ tūktārtham|
analyzed: pada sphoṭa nirūpaṇe upajīvya upajīvaka bhāvasya api saṅgati tvam sūcayan mūlam avatārayati evam iti ukta rītyā iti arthaḥ ādeśānām api keṣāñcid prayoga antargata tvāt āha tip visarga ādayaḥ iti prayoga antargata varṇāḥ iti yāvat nanu tādṛśa yāvat varṇānām vācaka tve katham pada sphoṭa siddhiḥ atas bhāva artham āha ayam iti samabhivyāhṛtam tu ukta artham

original: siddha iti ānupūrvoviśiṣṭatāvatāṃ varṇānāmavācakatve ānupūrvorūpapadasya vācakatvāśā durāśeti bhāvaḥ| nanu samudāyasya pratyekānatiriktatvena vācakatāyāḥ pratyekavarṇe viśrāmo vācyaḥ, tathāca kathaṃ samuditatādṛśavarmarūpapadasya vācakatetyataḥ pratyekavarmavācakatāṃ nirasyati-prativarṇamiti|

original: anubhavaviruddhatvāditi ghaṭaśabdādamumarthaṃ pratyemītyeva pratīterityarthaḥ| bādhakāntaramapyāha-pratyekamiti| arthavattva iti tadabhyupagama ityarthaḥ| nalopādītyādinā jaśtvādi parigrahaḥ|

original: nanu pratyekavarṇānāṃ vācakatvasya gauravaparāhatatvādevāsambhavātsamudāyasyaiva tat setsyatītyādeśā vācakāśceti samabhivyāhṛtavarṇānāṃ vācakatāyā hetutvopanyāso viphalaḥ, unmattapralapitatvaśaṅkāyā apasareṇaiva nirāsādityata āha-etacceti samabhivyāhṛtavarṇānāṃ vācakatvopanyasanañcetyarthaḥ| caramavarṇa eveti padānte śrūyamāṇavarṇe evetyarthaḥ|

original: tathāca `varṇasamudāyo vācakaḥ' iti padasphoṭapakṣe paryyavasyati pāribhāṣiketi pāṇinyādisaṅketitetyarthaḥ| pūrve tu ādeśasmāritavarṇānāṃ bodhakatvanirāsena prakṛtighaṭakavarṇasamudāyarūpasya, pratyayaghakavarṇasamudāyarūpasya ca tasya vācakatoktā| idānīntūbhayaghaṭakavarṇasamudāyasyaiva seti bhedaḥ|
analyzed: tathāca varṇa samudāyaḥ vācakaḥ iti pada sphoṭa pakṣe paryyavasyati pāribhāṣikā iti pāṇini ādi saṅketitā iti arthaḥ pūrve tu ādeśa smārita varṇānām bodhaka tva nirāsena prakṛti ghaṭaka varṇa samudāya rūpasya pratyaya ghaka varṇa samudāya rūpasya ca tasya vācaka tā uktā idānīm tu ubhaya ghaṭaka varṇa samudāyasya eva sā iti bhedaḥ

original: `ghaṭ' iti prakṛtiḥ, eneti pratyaya iti prakṛtipratyayayorvibhāgasya jñānāsambhavāditi yojanīyam| sarve sarvapadeti varṇanityatāpratipādakaṃ bhāṣyametat| vasnasāderapi pakṣatvādāha-vyājeneti tathāca niścitasādhyavattvasyaiva dṛṣṭāntatve tantratvena tasya pakṣabhinnatvābhāve'pi na dṛṣṭāntatvamanupapannamiti bhāvaḥ| tatra-vasnasādisthale|
analyzed: ghaṭ iti prakṛtiḥ enā iti pratyayaḥ iti prakṛti pratyayayoḥ vibhāgasya jñāna asambhavāt iti yojanīyam sarve sarva pada iti varṇa nityatā pratipādakam bhāṣyam etat vasnasa ādeḥ api pakṣa tvāt āha vyājena iti tathāca niścita sādhyavat tvasya eva dṛṣṭānta tve tantra tvena tasya pakṣa bhinna tva abhāve pi na dṛṣṭānta tvam anupapannam iti bhāvaḥ tatra vasnasa ādi sthale

original: vibhāga-prakṛtipratyayayoḥ pārthakyena nirṇaya ityarthaḥ| asya vaiyākaraṇānāmapīti śeṣaḥ| pare tu āmādau pratyayatvasyadṛṣṭatvena vāmityādāvāmo va ityādervasādeḥ pratyayatvamitarāṃśasya prakṛtitvamanumātumaśakyamityuktarītyā na prakṛtipratyayasamudāyūpapadasya vācakatvasiddhiḥ|
analyzed: vibhāga prakṛti pratyayayoḥ pārthakyena nirṇayaḥ iti arthaḥ asya vaiyākaraṇānām api iti śeṣaḥ pare tu ām ādau pratyaya tvasya adṛṣṭa tvena vām ityādau āmaḥ vaḥ ityādeḥ vasa ādeḥ pratyaya tvam itara aṃśasya prakṛti tvam anumātum aśakyam iti ukta rītyā na prakṛti pratyaya samudāya upapadasya vācaka tva siddhiḥ

original: ghaṭenetyatra tu naśabdasya ṭādeśatvaṃ bhāṣyakṛtaivoktamiti na tatra vibhāgāsiddhiḥ| `ajarghāḥ,acakāt' ityādau tvagatyā 'śiṣyamāṇaṃ lupyamānārthābhidhāyi" iti nyāyāt prakṛtereva vācakatā| astu vā tatrāpi luptapratyayānusandhānād bodhaḥ| prakṛtereva vā svārthaviśiṣṭapratyayārthe lakṣaṇā|
analyzed: ghaṭena iti atra tu naśabdasya ṭādeśa tvam bhāṣyakṛtā eva uktam iti na tatra vibhāga asiddhiḥ ityādau tu agatyā śiṣyamāṇam lupyamāna artha abhidhāyi iti nyāyāt prakṛteḥ eva vācaka tā astu vā tatra api lupta pratyaya anusandhānāt bodhaḥ prakṛteḥ eva vā svārtha viśiṣṭa pratyaya arthe lakṣaṇā

original: sūcyate-samudāyavyatpattyeti samudāyasya vācakatvagraheṇetyarthaḥ| bodhāt-prakṛtyarthaviśiṣṭapratyayārthabodhādityarthaḥ| tatrāpi-suptiṅantarūpapade'pi śaktiriti tatkalpanetyarthaḥ| nanu `ghaṭena' ityādimūlena samayuktikasphoṭadvayopādānāt kathaṃ padasphāṭe sādhye vākyasphoṭasya dṛṣṭāntatvam|

original: kiñcaprathamaṃ padasphoṭāsiddho tadarthasambandharūpavākyārthāprasiddhayā kva vākyārthaśaktikalpanāvasara ityādyoṭaparitoṣāt padasphoṭamevadṛṣṭhakṛtya vākyaśaktiṃ sādhayati-vastuta iti tathāca tatra padeṣveva padārthaśaktigrahāt padopastityā padaśaktigrahasambhavastatra padaśaktyaiva vākyārthabodhaḥ|
analyzed: kiñca prathamam tad artha sambandha rūpa vākyārtha aprasiddhayā kva vākyārtha śakti kalpanā avasaraḥ ityādi oṭa paritoṣāt pada sphoṭam eva dṛṣṭha kṛtya vākya śaktim sādhayati vastutas iti tathā ca tatra padeṣu eva padārtha śakti grahāt pada upastityā pada śakti graha sambhavaḥ tatra pada śaktyā eva vākya artha bodhaḥ

original: yatra tadasambhavo hare'vetyādau, tatrānāyattyā vākyaśaktyaitad‌bodha iti| yadyapi vyavasthitāviti padamahimnā pakṣadvayaṃ vyavasthitamiti labhyate, tathāpi āvaśyakavākyasphodenaivopapattau padasphoṭakalpanaṃ nāvaśyakamiti siddhānte vākyasphoṭa eva paryyavasyatīti bodhyam|

original: vkyasphoṭasyāvaśyakatāmeva darśayati-anyatheti vākyaśaktyanabhyupagame ityarthaḥ| tādṛśeti vākyārthabodhajanakatvapūpavākyaśaktijñānarahitasyāpītyarthaḥ| tatsattve tu tatrāpi bodha iṣṭa eveti bhāvaḥ| bodhaprasaṅgaḥ-ghaṭakarmakānāyanānukūlakṛtibodhāpattiḥ| padavṛttijñānajanyapadārthopasthiteḥ sattvāditi bhāvaḥ| ghaṭamānayetyatreveti|
analyzed: vkya sphoṭasya āvaśyaka tām eva darśayati anyathā iti vākya śakti anabhyupagame iti arthaḥ tādṛśa iti vākya artha bodha janaka tva pūpa vākya śakti jñāna rahitasya api iti arthaḥ tad sattve tu tatra api bodhaḥ iṣṭaḥ eva iti bhāvaḥ bodha prasaṅgaḥ ghaṭa karmaka ānāyana anukūla kṛti bodha āpattiḥ pada vṛtti jñāna janya padārtha upasthiteḥ sattvāt iti bhāvaḥ ghaṭam ānaya ityatra eva iti

original: atra tādṛśabyutpattirahitasyaityanuṣajyate| nanu śābdabodhakāraṇārthatātparyyajñānarūpasahakāryantarābhāvādeva na bodho'ta āha-satyapīti| bodhābhāvāditi tādṛśabodhābhāvādityartha| tathāca yadbhāvāt kāryābhāvastasta taddhetutayā vākyaśaktirāvaśiyaketi bhāvaḥ| etena vyatirekasahacārakāraṇatāgrāhakaḥ pradarśitaḥ|
analyzed: atra tādṛśa byutpatti rahitasya eti anuṣajyate nanu śābdabodha kāraṇa artha tātparyya jñāna rūpa sahakāri antara abhāvāt eva na bodha uta āha sati api iti bodha abhāvāt iti tādṛśa bodha abhāvāt iti artha tathāca yad bhāvāt kārya abhāvaḥ tad hetutayā vākya śaktiḥ āvaśiyakā iti bhāvaḥ etena vyatireka sahacāra kāraṇatā grāhakaḥ pradarśitaḥ

original: anvayaṃ pradarśayan vākyaśaktiṃ vyavasthāpayati-tatraiveti ghaṭamānayetyatraivetyarthaḥ| bodhādityanena svarūpasato hetutvasya vyavacchedaḥ| tādṛśasākāṅ‌kṣajñānaniṣṭhabodhahetutvāsmanmate vākyaśaktitvenākāṅ‌kṣāśaktiriti paribhāṣābhede'pi vākyasphoṭasiddhinirābādhetyaśeyanāha-tarhiti| nanu śābdabodhahetvarthopasthitijanakatvaṃ śaktitvam|
analyzed: anvayam pradarśayan vākya śaktim vyavasthāpayati tatra eva iti ghaṭam ānaya iti atra eva iti arthaḥ bodhāt iti anena svarūpa sataḥ hetutvasya vyavacchedaḥ tādṛśa sākāṅkṣa jñāna niṣṭha bodha hetutva asmad mate vākya śakti tvena ākāṅkṣā śaktiḥ iti paribhāṣā bhede pi vākya sphoṭa siddhi nirābādha iti aśeya nāha tarhi iti nanu śābdabodha hetu artha upasthiti janakatvam śaktitvam

original: tattu pade eva na vākye, tanniṣṭhabodhakatāyāstādṛsopasthityajanakatvādata āha-arthopasthāpaketi| śabdavṛttiti śabdaniṣṭhaṃ yad‌bodhakāraṇatvamityarthaḥ| tathācopasthitau śābdahetutvaniveśe etatkalpe prayojanābhāvena tajjñānasya tādṛśopasthityajanakatve'pi śaktitvā'kṣateḥ| bodhakaśabdasya śabdatvena niveśāccāpabhraṃśasyāpi saṃgraha iti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: tat tu pade eva na vākye tad niṣṭha bodhakatāyāḥ tādṛśa upasthiti ajanakatvāt atas āha artha upasthāpaka iti śabda vṛtti iti śabda niṣṭham yat bodha kāraṇatvam iti arthaḥ tathāca upasthitau śābda hetutva niveśe etad kalpe prayojana abhāvena tad jñānasya tādṛśa upasthiti ajanakatve pi śaktitva akṣateḥ bodhaka śabdasya śabda tvena niveśāt ca apabhraṃśasya api saṃgrahaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: kāryyatāvcachedake'vyavahitottaratvaniveśena tadvāraṇe'pyanupasthitasaṃsarge vākyaśaktigrahasya śābdabodhāt prāgasambhavena kathaṃ tad‌grahasya śābdabodhakāraṇateti cet satyam, saṃsargasya viśiṣyānupasthitāvapi tadādivat kārakavibhaktiviśiṣṭadhātupadaṃ kārakaviśiṣṭakriyābodhakamiti sāmānyatastad‌grahāt| tātparyyagrahasya tvayā'pyevameva vācyatvāt|

original: anantaraṃ padaviśeṣasamabhivyāhāreṇa tātparyyavaśāt saṃsargaviśeṣeṇa tatkārakaviśiṣṭatatkriyābhānam| nāpi saṃsargā''nantyaprayuktaśaktyānantyam, sambandhasyānugamakasya niyāmakatāpyubhayoḥ samaiveti tanmataniṣkarṣaḥ| nanu syādevoktaprakāro yadi vākyaniṣṭhabodhakatāyāḥ śaktitvaṃ sapramāṇaṃ syāt, tadeva tu netyata āha-yuktaṃ caitaditi|
analyzed: anantaram pada viśeṣa samabhivyāhāreṇa tātparyya vaśāt saṃsarga viśeṣeṇa tad kāraka viśiṣṭa tad kriyā bhānam nā api saṃsarga ānantya prayukta śakti ānantyam sambandhasya anugamakasya niyāmaka tā api ubhayoḥ samā eva iti tad mata niṣkarṣaḥ nanu syāt eva ukta prakāraḥ yadi vākya niṣṭha bodhakatāyāḥ śaktitvam sa pramāṇam syāt tat eva tu na iti atas āha yuktam ca etat iti

original: lāghaveneti anyathā ghaṭapadaśaktimaviduṣastatpada jñānavato yatkañcid‌vṛttijñānavato ghaṭamānayeti vākyād bodhāpattyā ghaṭaśābdabodhe ghaṭārthakapadavṛttijñānajanyopasthititvena hetutā vācyetyarthabhedenānantakāryyakāraṇabhāvakalpena gauravam|

original: nanu ghaṭaghaṭatvayorviśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāve viparītyutpannasya ghaṭamānayetyato ghaṭatvaviśiṣṭabodhavāraṇāya ghaṭatvaviśiṣṭabodhe upasthiterghaṭapadavṛttijñānajanyaghaṭatvaviśiṣṭāyā hetutāyā avaśyavācyatayā tata evānatiprasaṅge uktakāryyakāraṇabhāve mānabhāvo'ta āha-vivecetañcaitaditi padapadārthabhedenānantakāryyakāraṇabhāveṣu vṛttipraveśamapekṣya
analyzed: nanu ghaṭa ghaṭa tvayoḥ viśeṣya viśeṣaṇa bhāve viparīti utpannasya ghaṭam ānaya iti atas ghaṭa tva viśiṣṭa bodha vāraṇāya ghaṭa tva viśiṣṭa bodhe upasthiteḥ ghaṭa pada vṛtti jñāna janya ghaṭa tva viśiṣṭāyāḥ hetutāyāḥ avaśyavācyatayā tatas eva anatiprasaṅge ukta kāryya kāraṇa bhāve māna bhāva uta āha viveca itat ca etat iti pada padārtha bhedena ananta kāryya kāraṇa bhāveṣu vṛtti praveśam apekṣya

original: upasthiteḥ padajñānajanyatvenaiva śābdasāmagrīkukṣo praveśa ucitaḥ| tathā sati samāvāyenākāśasya janakatayopasthitasya devadattādeśca śābde bhānāvāraṇāya viṣayatayā śābdasāmānyevṛttijanyopastiterviṣayatayā hetutvaṃ vācyam| evañca saṃsargasya śābde bhānānurodhena saṃsarge'pi vṛttikalpanamāvaśyakam|

original: tathāca padaiḥ padārthānāṃ vākyena vākyār‌thasya bodhāditi vṛttijñānasyeti yathāśrutārthakameva tatra vivecitam| vastutasyu vṛttijñānapadaṃ yathāśrutārthakameva| vṛttijñānasyaityanantaram anuṣaktaviṣayatāsambandhenetyasya vṛttijñānaviṣayabodhakatvaghaṭakabodhīyaviṣayatāsambandhetetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: tathāca padaiḥ padārthānām vākyena vākya arthasya bodhāt iti vṛtti jñānasya iti yathāśruta arthakam eva tatra vivecitam vṛtti jñāna padam yathāśruta arthakam eva vṛtti jñānasya eti anantaram anuṣakta viṣayatā sambandhena iti asya vṛtti jñāna viṣaya bodhakatva ghaṭaka bodhīya viṣayatā sambandheta iti arthaḥ

original: anyathā vākyavṛttijñānajanyopasthitereva śābdabodhatvena tasmim̐stena sambandhena taddhetutvāsambhavena vākyaśaktergarbhastrāvāditi bodhyam| atra vadanti-padajanyapadārthotimantareṇa śābdabodhānudayāttadṛsapadārthopasthiteḥ śābdabodhe hetuteti tāvannirvivādam|
analyzed: anyathā vākya vṛtti jñāna janya upasthiteḥ eva śābdabodha tvena tasmin tena sambandhena tad hetutva asambhavena vākya śakteḥ garbha strāvāt iti bodhyam atra śābdabodha anudayāt śābdabodhe hetutā iti tāvat nirvivādam

original: padasya ca prakṛtyādyatmakasyārthe sambandhaṃ vinā tadupasthāpakatvāśambhavāttasmin vṛttyātmakasambandho'pyāvaśyaka eva, natu tatsamudāyarūpapāribhāṣikapadatya tatsamūharūpavākyasya viśiṣṭhārthe saḥ, taṃ vinā'pi tebhya ākāṅkṣādirūpakāraṇasamavadhānādeva viśiṣṭabodhopapatteḥ| ekapadārthaviśiṣṭāparapadārthaśābdatvasyaiva tatkāryyatāvacchedakatvāt|
analyzed: padasya ca prakṛti ādi atmakasya arthe sambandham vinā tad upasthāpaka tva āśambhavāt tasmin vṛtti ātmaka sambandhaḥ upi āvaśyakaḥ eva na tu tad samudāya rūpa pāribhāṣika tad samūha rūpa vākyasya viśiṣṭha arthe saḥ tam vinā api tebhyaḥ ākāṅkṣā ādi rūpa kāraṇa samavadhānāt eva viśiṣṭa bodha upapatteḥ eka padārtha viśiṣṭa apara padārtha śābda tvasya eva tad kāryya tā avacchedaka tvāt

original: yattu lāghavād vṛttijñānajanyopasthitorvaṣayatāsambandhena hetutvameva vākyaśaktau pramāṇamiti, tanna, svātantryeṇa taddhetutvasyaivāsiddheḥ| tathāhi-tādṛśakāryyakāraṇabhāve vṛttitvena padavṛtterniveśaḥ| kiṃ vākyavṛtteḥ, kiṃ vā vṛttisāmānyasya?| na tāvadadyaḥ, padṛvattijñānajanyopasthiteḥ śābdavodhahetutvasya sarvaiṃrevābhyupagamāt|
analyzed: yat tu lāghavāt hetutvam eva vākya śaktau pramāṇam iti tat na svātantryeṇa tad hetutvasya eva asiddheḥ tathā hi tādṛśa kāryya kāraṇa bhāve vṛtti tvena pada vṛtteḥ niveśaḥ kim vākya vṛtteḥ kim vā vṛtti sāmānyasya na tāvat adyaḥ śābda vodha hetutvasya sarvaiḥ eva abhyupagamāt

original: na dvitīyaḥ, vākyavṛttestataḥ prāgasiddheḥ| ata eva na tṛtīyaḥ, kiñci tava mate vākyaśaktijanyopasthiteḥ śābdabodhātmakatvena tastiṃstadviṣayatvāsambhavādapi noktarītiḥ-sādhīyasī|
analyzed: na dvitīyaḥ vākya vṛtteḥ tatas prāk asiddheḥ atas eva na tṛtīyaḥ kiñci tava mate vākya śakti janya upasthiteḥ śābda bodha ātmaka tvena tastiṃs tad viṣayatva asambhavāt api nā ukta rītiḥ sādhīyasī

original: apica vākyavṛttijñānasya śābsāmānye na svātantryeṇa hetutvaṃ yadā kadācidviparaṇāditā gha ṭādipadaśakta jñānajanyapadārthopasthitidaśāyāṃ ghaṭamānayeti vākyaśaktimaviduṣa ākāṅkṣādivaśācchābdabodhodayena vyabhicārāt| yadapi samabhivyāhārarūpākāṅkṣaiva vākyamiti tadapi na,tathā sati `ghaṭīyā karmatā' ityādibodhe ghaṭamānayeti vākyaṃ sākāṅkṣam|
analyzed: apica vākya vṛtti jñānasya śāp sāmānye na svātantryeṇa hetutvam yadā kadācid viparaṇa āditā gha ṭa ādi pada śakta jñāna janya padārtha upasthiti daśāyām ghaṭam ānaya iti vākya śaktim aviduṣaḥ ākāṅkṣā ādi vaśāt śābda bodha udayena vyabhicārāt yat api samabhivyāhāra rūpa ākāṅkṣā eva vākyam iti tat api na tathā sati ghaṭīyā karmatā ityādi bodhe ghaṭam ānaya iti vākyam sākāṅkṣam

original: nirākāṅkṣañca-ghaṭaḥ karmatvamiti sarvasiddhavyavāhārānupapattiḥ|?tathāca samabhivyāhārasya śābdabodhahetutve'pi vākyasya tattvaṃ durupapādameveti kva vākyasaktisiddhiḥ| sambhivyāhāraniṣṭhabodhajanakatvagrahavato bodhe tajjñānaṃ heturityapi riktaṃ vacaḥ|
analyzed: nirākāṅkṣan ca ghaṭaḥ karmatvam iti sarva siddha vyavāhāra anupapattiḥ tathā ca samabhivyāhārasya śābda bodha hetu tve pi vākyasya tattvam durupapādam eva iti kva vākya sakti siddhiḥ sambhivyāhāra niṣṭha bodha janakatva grahavataḥ bodhe tat jñānam hetuḥ iti api riktam vacaḥ

original: anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ samabhivyāharajñānasyaiva śābdadhīhetutvena tanniṣṭhabodhajanakatvajñānasya hetutāyā evābhāvāt| naca tadapi sambhavati, śābdabodhāt prāk‌saṃsargasyaivānupasthiteḥ| sāmānyatastadupasthitāvapi viśeṣarūpeṇa bhānārthaṃ tātparyyajñānādyapekṣaṇe ca mūlaśaithilyāt tava vākyaśakterevāsiddhayāpattiḥ|
analyzed: anvaya vyatirekābhyām samabhivyāhara jñānasya eva śābda dhī hetutvena tad niṣṭha bodha janakatva jñānasya hetutāyāḥ eva abhāvāt na ca tat api sambhavati śābdabodhāt prāk saṃsargasya eva anupasthiteḥ sāmānyatas tad upasthitau api viśeṣa rūpeṇa bhāna artham tātparyya jñāna ādi apekṣaṇe ca mūla śaithilyāt tava vākya śakteḥ eva asiddhayā āpattiḥ

original: vakṣyamāṇarītyā śābdabodhāt prāk tadupasthityabhyupagame vākyavṛttijñānajanyopasthityanantaraṃ śābdabodhābhyupagame vā śābdaprāmāṇyabhaṅgāpattiḥ, anadhigatārthagrahakāraṇasvaiya pramāṇatvāt| ata eva sūtrakṛtā "kṛttaddhitasamāsāśca" ityatra samāsagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam| vākyaśaktau tu tadvaiyarthya spaṣṭameva|
analyzed: vakṣyamāṇa rītyā śābdabodhāt prāk tad upasthiti abhyupagame vākya vṛtti jñāna janya upasthiti anantaram śābdabodha abhyupagame vā śābda prāmāṇya bhaṅga āpattiḥ anadhigata artha graha kāraṇa pramāṇa tvāt atas eva sūtra kṛtā kṛt taddhita samāsāḥ ca iti atra samāsa grahaṇam kṛtam vākya śaktau tu tad vaiyarthya spaṣṭam eva

original: "sāmāyikaḥ śabdādarthapratyayaḥ" iti kaṇādoklervākyaśaktigrāhakānuśāsanāderabhāvena tad‌grahāsambhavācceti vākyasphoṭa āpātaramaṇīya eveti pūrvoktaraśaktigrahaprakārasya śaithilyaṃ manasi nidhāya tasmin prakārāntaraṃ vaktumagrimagrantha ityāśayenāha-nanviti| apūrvatvāt-śābdabodhāt prāganupasthitatvāt|
analyzed: sāmāyikaḥ śabdāt artha pratyayaḥ iti kaṇāda ukleḥ vākya śakti grāhaka anuśāsana ādeḥ abhāvena tad graha asambhavāt ca iti vākya sphoṭaḥ āpāta ramaṇīyaḥ eva iti pūrva ukta raśakti graha prakārasya śaithilyam manasi nidhāya tasmin prakāra antaram vaktum agrima granthe iti āśayena āha nanu iti apūrva tvāt śābdabodhāt prāk anupasthita tvāt

original: nanu śābdabodhāt pūrva pade pratyakṣād‌yupasthitapadārthanirūpitaśaktigrahaḥ sulabha eveti pade samamiti mūlamanupapannamata āśayaṃ prakāśayati-pade eveti padānāmebānvitapadārthe śaktiḥ, anvayaśca-sāmānyarūpema jñānamaḥ, ata eva ghaṭādipadādanvitaghaṭādyupasthitau niyamena tatpratiyogyākāṅkṣā bhavati-kimanvito ghaṭaḥ kimanvitaṃ
analyzed: nanu śābdabodhāt pūrvam pade pratyakṣa ādi upasthita padārtha nirūpita śakti grahaḥ sulabhaḥ eva iti pade samam iti mūlam anupapannam atas āśayam prakāśayati pade eva iti padānām eva anvita padārthe śaktiḥ anvayaḥ ca sāmānya rūpeṇa jñānamaḥ atas eva ghaṭa ādi padāt anvita ghaṭa ādi upasthitau niyamena tad pratiyogi ākāṅkṣā bhavati kim anvitaḥ ghaṭaḥ kim anvitam

original: karmatvamityādyākārā, sāmānyadharmaprakārakajñānasya viśeṣadharmaprakārakajijñāsājanakatvāt| viśeṣa rūpeṇa bhāne tvamādipadasamabhivyāhāro niyāmako'ta eva tasya śābde bhānam, padavṛttiviṣayatvāt, aśakyasyāpi bhāne'ti prasaṅgāt|
analyzed: karma tvam ityādi ākārā sāmānya dharma prakāraka jñānasya viśeṣa dharma prakāraka jijñāsā janaka tvāt viśeṣa rūpeṇa bhāne tvam ādi pada samabhivyāhāraḥ eva tasya śābde bhānam pada vṛtti viṣaya tvāt aśakyasya api bhānā iti prasaṅgāt

original: nacaivaṃ ghaṭamānayetyatretarānvitaṃ karmatvamitirītyā'nekadhā saṃsargasya bhānāpattiḥ, tattatpadebhyastathārthopasthitāvapyākāṅkṣāvaśādekadhaiva tadbhānaprasaṅgat| nacākāṅkṣāyāstadbhānaniyāmakatvāvaśyakatvena tatra vṛttikalpanā'pārtheti vācyam, aśakyabhānābhiyaiva tadabhyupagamāt|
analyzed: naca evam ghaṭam ānaya iti atra itara anvitam karmatvam iti rītyā anekadhā saṃsargasya bhāna āpattiḥ tad tad padebhyaḥ tathā artha upasthitau api ākāṅkṣā vaśāt ekadhā eva tad bhāna prasaṅgat naca ākāṅkṣāyāḥ tad bhāna niyāmaka tva āvaśyaka tvena tatra vṛtti kalpanā apārthā iti vācyam aśakya bhāna abhiyā eva tad abhyupagamāt

original: tathāca padaśaktyaiva saṃsargabhānopapattau tatra na vākyaśaktiḥ, padatvāpekṣayā vākyatvasya gurutvācceti tanmatam| tathācānivitābhidhānamate'pi pade vākyārthaśaktigrahāsambhavaḥ samāna ityarthaḥ| jñāteti padārthānāṃ prāgupasthityā tatra padārthaśaktigrahasambhavāditi bhāvaḥ| ajñātaiveti vṛttyabhyupagamastu śābde bhānānu papattyaiveti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: tathāca pada śaktyā eva saṃsarga bhāna upapattau tatra na vākya śaktiḥ pada tva apekṣayā vākya tvasya guru tvāt ca iti tad matam tathāca anivita abhidhāna mate pi pade vākya artha śakti graha asambhavaḥ samānaḥ iti arthaḥ jñātā iti padārthānām prāk upasthityā tatra padārtha śakti graha sambhavāt iti bhāvaḥ ajñātā eva iti vṛtti abhyupagamaḥ tu śābde bhāna anu papattyā eva iti bhāvaḥ

original: padārthavaditi sapmyantādvatīḥ, upameye saptamīdarśanāt| vākyārthe'pi saṃsarge'pītyarthaḥ| idañca bodhyatvaṃ śaktirityabhipretya tad‌gāhaḥ-śaktigrahaḥ| lakṣaṇaśabdasya cihnādau prasiddheḥ prakṛtopayogayarthaparatayā ta vyācaṣṭe- lakṣyata iti| mūle arthe iti nirūpitatvaṃ sampamyarthaḥ|
analyzed: padārtha vat iti upameye saptamī darśanāt vākya arthe pi saṃsarge pi iti arthaḥ idam ca bodhyatvam śaktiḥ iti abhipretya lakṣaṇa śabdasya cihna ādau prasiddheḥ vyācaṣṭe lakṣyate iti mūle arthe iti nirūpitatvam sampami arthaḥ

original: tacchabdārthe śaktijñāne'nvetītyabhipretya vyācaṣṭe-pade'pītyādi tad‌graha iti vākyārthanirūpitaśaktigraha ityarthaḥ| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ-ghaṭamānayetyādivṛddhavyavahārādyasya pade padārthaśaktinirṇayastasya tadvākyaśravaṇe padaiḥ padārthepasthityādisambadhāne māsā tatsaṃsargaupasthitirnānupapannā|
analyzed: tad śabda arthe śakti jñānena eti iti abhipretya vyācaṣṭe pade pi ityādi tad grahaḥ iti vākya artha nirūpita śakti grahaḥ iti arthaḥ ayam bhāvaḥ ghaṭam ānaya ityādi vṛddha vyavahāra ādyasya pade padārtha śakti nirṇayaḥ tasya tad vākya śravaṇe padaiḥ padārtha upasthiti ādi sambadhāne māsā tad saṃsarga aupasthitiḥ na anupapannā

original: parantu mānasasya prāyaḥ saṃśayātmakasyāpi sambhavāttinniścayārtha śabdāṃ''daraḥ| tatra śaktigrahahetulaṅgādernirṇāyakasya sattvena saṃśayakatvāsambhavāditi| nanu śabdaniṣṭhaśaktinirmayasyaiva śābdabodhe hetutā'vadhāraṇena tasya śābdabodhāt prāguktarītyā'sambhavena vākyaśakteḥ śābdabodhahetutvaṃ durghaṭamevetyata āha-vastutastviti|
analyzed: parantu mānasasya prāyas saṃśaya ātmakasya api sambhavāt tinniścayārtha śabda āṃdaraḥ tatra śakti graha hetu laṅga ādeḥ nirṇāyakasya sattvena saṃśayaka tva asambhavāt iti nanu śabda niṣṭha śakti nirmayasya eva śābdabodhe hetutā avadhāraṇena tasya śābdabodhāt prāk ukta rītyā asambhavena vākya śakteḥ śābdabodha hetutvam durghaṭam eva iti atas āha vastutas tu iti

original: tad‌grahaḥ viśiṣṭavākyārthaśaktigrahaḥ| tathāca ca śaktigrāhakaśiromaṇinā vyavahāreṇa pūrvaṃ vākye eva śaktigraheṇaṃ tasyaiva śāṃbdabodhahetutvāvadhāraṇāttādṛśavṛtteśca-svāśrayaviṣayakatva-svaviṣayakod‌buddhasaṃskārasāmānādhikaraṇyobhayasambandhena baiśiṣṭayasyedānīntanavākyajñāne'pyakṣatatvānna vṛttijñānasya śābdabodhe hetutāyāṃ vyabhicāparaॉḥ,
analyzed: tad grahaḥ viśiṣṭa vākya artha śakti grahaḥ tathāca ca śakti grāhaka śiromaṇinā vyavahāreṇa pūrvam vākye eva śakti graheṇa tasya eva śāṃbdabodha hetutva avadhāraṇāt tādṛśa vṛtteḥ ca sva āśraya viṣayaka tva sva viṣayaka udbuddha saṃskāra sāmānādhikaraṇya ubhaya sambandhena baiśiṣṭayasya idānīntana vākya jñāne pi akṣata tvāt na vṛtti jñānasya śābdabodhe hetutāyām vyabhicā paraḥ

original: madhye vākyārthopasthiteranapekṣaṇācca noktadoṣāvasara iti bhāvaḥ| nanu tarhi padasphoṭasya nirālambanatāpattirata āha-āvāpodvāpābhyāmiti ānayanāpasāraṇābhyāmekapadopādānāparāpadānupādānābhyāmityarthaḥ| tadgrahaḥ-pratyekapade pratyekapadārthaśaktigrahaḥ|
analyzed: madhye vākya artha upasthiteḥ anapekṣaṇāt ca na ukta doṣa avasaraḥ iti bhāvaḥ nanu tarhi pada sphoṭasya nirālambana tā āpattiḥ atas āha āvāpa udvāpābhyām iti ānayana apasāraṇābhyām eka pada upādāna aparā pada anupādānābhyām iti arthaḥ tad grahaḥ pratyeka pade pratyeka padārtha śakti grahaḥ

original: tathāca pratyekapadaśaktisācitvayenā''kāṅ‌kṣādivaśāt padādvākyārthaśābdabodastadā padasphoṭaḥ, yadā tu tannirapekṣyaiva sā bodhaṃ janayati tadā vākyasphoṭa iti matadvayaṃ paryvasyatīti bhāvaḥ| kecitu-upasthitāḥ padārthastadupasthitirvā śābdabodhahetunatu padajñānamapi, tadvinā'pi śābadbobodayena vyabhicārāt|
analyzed: tathāca pratyeka pada śakti sāci tvayena ākāṅkṣā ādi vaśāt padāt vākya artha śābda bodaḥ tadā pada sphoṭaḥ yadā tu tad nirapekṣya eva sā bodham janayati tadā vākya sphoṭaḥ iti mata dvayam paryvasyati iti bhāvaḥ kecitu upasthitāḥ padārthaḥ tad upasthitiḥ vā śābda bodha hetunā tu pada jñānam api tat vinā api vyabhicārāt

original: taduktam-`paśayataḥ svetamārūpaṃ hreṣāśabdañca śrṛṇvataḥ| khuravikṣepaśabdañca śveto'śvo dhāvatīti dhīḥ' iti, tanna, śabdaṃ vinā jāyamānasya ghaṭādicākṣuṣasyāpi śābdatvāpatteḥ|
analyzed: tat uktam paśayataḥ hreṣā śabdam ca śrṛṇvataḥ khura vikṣepa śabdam ca śveta uśvaḥ dhāvati iti dhīḥ iti tat na śabdam vinā jāyamānasya ghaṭa ādi cākṣuṣasya api śābda tva āpatteḥ

original: tatra paśyāmi, na śābdayāmītyanuvyavasāyānna śābdatvaṃ yadi tadā prakṛte'pi samam, uktapratīteranumānenaiva nirvāhāt, tatra śābdapratyayastpasiddha evetyādi svayamuhyam upalakṣaṇamiti tvanmate `gabhīrāyāṃ nadyāṃ ghoṣaḥ' ityādau pratyekapadaśaktyā|
analyzed: tatra paśyāmi na śābdayāmi iti anuvyavasāyāt na śābda tvam yadi tadā prakṛte api samam ukta pratīteḥ anumānena eva nirvāhāt tatra śābda pratyayaḥ eva ityādi svayam uhyam upalakṣaṇam iti tvad mate gabhīrāyām nadyām ghoṣaḥ ityādau pratyeka pada śaktyā

original: svaśakyasambandharūpalakṣaṇayā vacoktadiśā'bhīpsitārthanveya bodhāsambhavāt sbabodhyasambandhasya lakṣaṇatvābhyupagamena vākyārthamātre vākyalakṣaṇāṅgīkārāditi bhāvaḥ| pakṣadvayamiti padavākyabhedena vyavasthitaṃ sphoṭadvayamityarthaḥ|
analyzed: sva śakya sambandha rūpa lakṣaṇayā vacā ukta diśā abhīpsita artha nveya bodha asambhavāt sba bodhya sambandhasya lakṣaṇatva abhyupagamena vākyārtha mātre vākya lakṣaṇa aṅgīkārāt iti bhāvaḥ pakṣa dvayam iti pada vākya bhedena vyavasthitam sphoṭa dvayam iti arthaḥ

original: anupapattibhevāha-utpannāmanāmiti varṇānityatāvādimate varṇānāṃ yogyavibhuviśeṣaguṇatvena svottarotpannaguṇanāsyatvādekadā'vasthānāsambhavaḥ|
analyzed: anupapatti bhāva āha autpanna āmanām iti varṇa anityatā vādi mate varṇānām yogya vibhu viśeṣa guṇa tvena sva uttara utpanna guṇana āsya tvāt ekadā avasthāna asambhavaḥ

original: śikṣāyāmapi-ātmā budhdyā sametyārthānmano yuṅkte vivakṣayā| manaḥ kāyā'gnimāhanti sa prerayati mārūtam| sodīrṇo mūrdhnyabhihato vaktramāpadya mārūtaḥ| varṇān janayate-ityanena| tathācata hṛdayāvacchinnamadhyamāyāṃ yo nādāṃśa āntarapraṇavarūpaḥ sa eva vācakaḥ| "oṃkāra eva sarvā vāk‌ seṣā sparśoṣmabhirvyajyamānā nānārūpā bhavati" iti śruteḥ|
analyzed: śikṣāyām api ātmā budhdyā sametya arthān manaḥ yuṅkte vivakṣayā manaḥ kāya agnim āhanti sa prerayati mārūtam saḥ udīrṇaḥ mūrdhni abhihataḥ vaktram āpadya mārūtaḥ varṇān janayate iti anena hṛdaya avacchinna madhyamāyām yaḥ nāda aṃśaḥ āntarapraṇava rūpaḥ saḥ eva vācakaḥ oṃkāraḥ eva sarvā vāc sā iṣā sparśa ūṣmabhiḥ vyajyamānā nānā rūpā bhavati iti śruteḥ

original: sarvaprāṇihṛddeśatthatvācva brahmapadavyavahāryarthe'pītyanyatra vistaraḥ| iti pratīteriti anyathā varṇaparamparārūpamālāyāstatsamūharūpapadānatiriktatayā''dhārādheyabhāvāgāhipratītyanupattiriti bhavaḥ| anyatheti pratīteḥ padārthāsādhakatva ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: brahma pada vyavahāri arthe api iti anyatra vistaraḥ iti pratīteḥ iti anyathā varṇa paramparā rūpa mālāyāḥ tad samūha rūpa pada anatirikta tayā ādhāra ādheya bhāva āgāhi pratīti anupattiḥ iti bhavaḥ anyathā iti pratīteḥ padārtha asādhaka tve iti arthaḥ

original: `kapāle ghaṭaḥ' iti pratītyā bhedāvagāhinyā tastiddhiḥ, pratītestadasādhakatve tu ghaṭādyasiddhaḥ spaṣṭaiva| kapālatatsaṃyogānādāyaiva tādṛśapratītyupapatteriti bhāvaḥ| kausetubhe tviti tuśabdenāruciḥ sūcitā| tad‌bījantu varṇātiriktasphoṭānaṅgīkāre'pi noktapratītyanupapattiḥ|
analyzed: kapāle ghaṭaḥ iti pratītyā bheda avagāhinyā tasmāt tiddhiḥ pratīteḥ tad asādhaka tve tu ghaṭa ādi asiddhaḥ spaṣṭā eva kapāla tad saṃyogān ādāya eva tādṛśa pratīti upapatteḥ iti bhāvaḥ kausetubhe tu iti tuśabdena aruciḥ sūcitā tad bījam tu varṇa atirikta sphoṭa anaṅgīkāre pi na ukta pratīti anupapattiḥ

original: ānupūrvyavacchinnavaraṇānāṃ mālāpadārthatvena tatrānuparvorūpadasyādhārādheyabhāvasambhavāt| ghaṭakapālādīnāṃ vijātīyakāraṇajanyatvena tadbhedasyāpalapitumaśaktayatvenoktātiprasaṅgābhāvācceti| anye tu-na varmānāṃ sphoṭātmakatvam| kintu sphoṭasya varṇābhivyaṅgayatvameva|
analyzed: ānupūrvī avacchinna varaṇānām mālā padārtha tvena tatra ādhāra ādheya bhāva sambhavāt ghaṭa kapāla ādīnām vijātīya kāraṇa janya tvena tad bhedasya apalapitum aśakti atvena ukta atiprasaṅga abhāvāt ca iti anye tu na varmānām sphoṭa ātmaka tvam kintu sphoṭasya varṇa abhivyaṅgaya tvam eva

original: naca pratyekavyañjakatvapakṣoktadoṣaḥ, prayogāntargatasakalavarṇānāṃ tad‌vyañjakarūpapratibimbajanyatadrūpārūṣitasyaiva pratītyā nānātvena pratītiraupādhikī ekasyaiva mukhasya kṛpāṇadarpaṇādyabhivyañjakavaśāddairdhyavarttu latvādipratītivat| ata evānugamārthaṃ na tatra jātikalpanā'pi|
analyzed: naca pratyeka vyañjaka tva pakṣa ukta doṣaḥ prayoga antargata sakala varṇānām tad vyañjaka rūpa pratibimba janya tad rūpa ārūṣitasya eva pratītyā nānātvena pratītiḥ aupādhikī ekasya eva mukhasya kṛpāṇa darpaṇa ādi abhivyañjaka vaśāt dairdhya vartu la tva ādi pratīti vat atas eva anugama artham na tatra jāti kalpanā api

original: varṇabhinnavyañjakābhāvācca na kadācidapi varṇarāhityena tatpratītistatpratibambasamarpakāśca saṃskārā eva| te ca yena krameṇa cittasthāstenaiva krameṇa vyañjakarūparūṣitatā tasyaityabhyupagamacca na saro sara ityanayoraviśeṣaḥ|
analyzed: varṇa bhinna vyañjaka abhāvāt ca na kadācid api varṇa rāhityena tad pratītiḥ tad pratibamba samarpakāḥ ca saṃskārāḥ eva te ca yena krameṇa citta sthāḥ tena eva krameṇa vyañjaka rūpa rūṣita tā tasya eti abhyupagamat ca na saraḥ saraḥ iti anayoḥ aviśeṣaḥ

original: vyañjakarūparūṣitasyaiva tasyārthe śaktigrahācca na ghaṭādiparyyāyābhivyaktasphoṭe gṛhītaśaktikasyāprasiddhapadaśravaṇe'rthabodhāpattiḥ, ata evedamekaṃ padamekaṃ vākyamiti vyavahāraḥ svarasataḥ saṅgacchata ityāhuḥ evamiti akhaṇḍasphoṭasyaiva vācakatve ityathaḥ| aprāmāṇyaprasaṅgamevopapādayati-padasyeti vākyasyāpyupalakṣaṇamidam|
analyzed: vyañjaka rūpa rūṣitasya eva tasya arthe śakti grahāt ca na ghaṭa ādi paryyāya abhivyakta sphoṭe gṛhīta śaktikasya aprasiddha pada śravaṇa īrtha bodha āpattiḥ atas eva idam ekam padam ekam vākyam iti vyavahāraḥ svarasataḥ saṅgacchate iti āhuḥ evam iti akhaṇḍa sphoṭasya eva vācaka tve iti athaḥ aprāmāṇya prasaṅgam eva upapādayati padasya iti vākyasya api upalakṣaṇam idam

original: akhaṇḍatvāditi prakṛtipratyayavibhāgāśūnyavādityarthaḥ| tathābhūtasyaiva vācakatāyā bhavadbhirupapāditatvāditi bhāvaḥ| śāstrasya vyākaraṇātmakasya| prakṛtipratyayābhyāmiti tābhyāṃ yad‌ vyutpādanam-śaktibodhanaṃ tanmātraprayojanatvādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: akhaṇḍa tvāt iti prakṛti pratyaya vibhāga aśūnyavāt iti arthaḥ tathābhūtasya eva vācaka tāyāḥ bhavadbhiḥ upapādita tvāt iti bhāvaḥ śāstrasya vyākaraṇa ātmakasya prakṛti pratyayābhyām iti tābhyām yat vyutpādanam śakti bodhanam tanmātra prayojana tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: tathāca prakṛtipratyayavibhāgena padārthavācakatvabodhakasyāsya śāstrasya padasyākhaṇḍatve'prāmāṇyāpattiriti bhāvaḥ| upeyapratipatyartheti vacanavipariṇāmena uttaratrāpyanveti| upeyasya-bodhanīyasya pratipattaye eṣā kalpanā śritā-svīkṛtā munineti śeṣaḥ, pṛṣṭavān sa upācānnaṃ brahma" iti tasyāpi tathātvaṃ bud‌dhvā pṛṣṭaḥ "mano brahma" iti|
analyzed: tathāca prakṛti pratyaya vibhāgena padārtha vācakatva bodhakasya asya śāstrasya padasya akhaṇḍa tve prāmāṇya āpattiḥ iti bhāvaḥ upeya pratipati arthā iti vacana vipariṇāmena uttaratra api anveti upeyasya a bodhanīyasya pratipattaye eṣā kalpanā śritā a svīkṛtā muninā iti śeṣaḥ pṛṣṭavān saḥ upāca annam brahma iti tasya api tathātvam buddhvā pṛṣṭaḥ manaḥ brahma iti

original: tasyā'pyaśitamatannaṃ tredhā bhavati-"prāṇo brahma" iti tasyāpi tathātvaṃ bud‌dhvā pṛṣṭaḥ "mano brahma" iti| tasyā'pyaśitamannaṃ tredā bhavati-"yatsthūlaṃ tatpurīṣam, yanmadhyamaṃ tanmāsaṃ yadaṇīyastanmanaḥ" iti śravaṇādanityatvamabadhārpya punaḥ pṛṣṭaḥ, "vijñānaṃ brahma" iti tasyāpi vṛttyupahitatvaṃ jñātvā punaḥ pṛṣṭenopadiṣṭam-"ānando prahmeti
analyzed: tasya api aśitam atannam tredhā bhavati prāṇaḥ brahma iti tasya api tathātvam buddhvā pṛṣṭaḥ manaḥ brahma iti tasya api aśitam annam tredā bhavati yat sthūlam tat purīṣam yat madhyamam tat māsam yat aṇīyaḥ tat manaḥ iti śravaṇāt anitya tvam abadhārpya punar pṛṣṭaḥ vijñānam brahma iti tasya api vṛtti upahita tvam jñātvā punar pṛṣṭena upadiṣṭam ānando prahma iti

original: vyajānāt"| tato vastuttvaṃ prāpya sthita iti pratipāditam| nanu neyaṃ vallī pañcakośapratipādikā| pañcamasyānupāyatvādakośatvātasyaivava tatra prahṇatvabodhanādityāśaṅ‌kyānandavallīsthipañcakośodāharaṇamāha-yathā veti tatratyā hi pañcakośā upāyā eva, upadiṣṭāñcamānandakoṣasyāpi vaiṣayikatayā'nityatvenābrahmatvāt kintu `bahma pucchaṃ pratiṣṭhā"
analyzed: vyajānāt tatas vastut tvam prāpya sthitaḥ iti pratipāditam nanu nā iyam vallī pañcakośa pratipādikā pañcamasya anupāya tvāt akośa tvāt tasya tatra prahṇa tva bodhanāt iti āśaṅkya ānandavallī sthi pañcakośa udāharaṇam āha yathā vā iti tatratyāḥ hi pañcakośāḥ upāyāḥ eva vaiṣayika tayā anitya tvena abrahma tvāt kintu bahma puccham pratiṣṭhā

original: ityatra śrūyamāṇabrahmapadasyaiva mukhyabrahmaparatvam| ata evā'dhārārthaṃkaḥ pucchaśabdo'pyupapadyate, tasya lāṅ‌gūlarūpamukhyārthasya bādhat|
analyzed: iti atra śrūyamāṇa brahma padasya eva mukhya brahma para tvam atas eva ādhāra arthaṃkaḥ puccha śabdaḥ upi upapadyate tasya lāṅgūla rūpa mukhya arthasya bādhat

original: evañcānandavallayāṃ yathā pañpanakośāḥ sarvādharakabrahmabodhanāyāpāyatayopāttaḥ, teṣāṃ vāstavabrahmatvam, tathehāpyavāstavaprakṛti-pratyayā vācakatvatyutpādāna vāstavsaphoṭaniṣṭhavācakatvabādhanāyetvākhaṇḍalārthaḥ| śravaṇādita iti ādinā mananādiparigrahaḥ|
analyzed: evam ca ānandavallayām yathā pañpana kośāḥ sarva adharaka brahma bodhanāya apāyatayā upāttaḥ teṣām vāstava brahma tvam tathā iha api avāstava prakṛti pratyayāḥ vācaka tu atyutpādān vāstava saphoṭa niṣṭha vācaka tva bādhanāya iti ākhaṇḍala arthaḥ śravaṇa āditaḥ iti ādinā manana ādi parigrahaḥ

original: na śāstramiti etacchāstraṃ vinā'pi śravaṇā'dinā vyabhicārāditi bhāvaḥ| upāyasyopāyāntarādūṣakatve sadṛṣṭāntāṃ yuktimāha-tathāceti vyākaraṇādhyayanasya sphoṭajñānatvaṃ na kāryyatāvacchedakam, kintu tādṛśajñānagatavaijātyam tadavacchinnañva nopāyāntarāditi na vyabhicāraḥ|
analyzed: na śāstram iti etat śāstram vinā api śravaṇa ādinā vyabhicārāt iti bhāvaḥ upāyasya upāya antara dūṣaka tve sa dṛṣṭāntām yuktim āha tathā ca iti vyākaraṇa adhyayanasya sphoṭa jñāna tvam na kāryyatā avacchedakam kintu tādṛśa jñāna gata vaijātyam na upāya antarāt iti na vyabhicāraḥ

original: vaijātyasya prāganupasthitāvapi kāraṇatāgraho vidhivādoktadiśā'vaseya iti bhāvaḥ| mantrajanayamiveti mantrajanyatā'vacchedakamivetyarthaḥ| evamagre'pi| nanu puruṣārthāsādhakasya tasya sampādanavaiyarthyamata āha-tasya ceti sphoṭajñānasya cetyarthaḥ| yajñādīnāmiti kāmanāparityāgena vidhīyamānānāṃ teṣāmityarthaḥ|
analyzed: vaijātyasya prāk anupasthitau api kāraṇatā grahaḥ vidhivāda ukta diśā avaseyaḥ iti bhāvaḥ mantra janayam iva iti mantra janya tā avacchedakam iva iti arthaḥ evam agre pi nanu puruṣa artha asādhakasya tasya sampādana vaiyarthyam atas āhatasya ca iti sphoṭa jñānasya ca iti arthaḥ yajña ādīnām iti kāmanā parityāgena vidhīyamānānām teṣām iti arthaḥ

original: yajñādītyādinā `tameta vedānuvacanena brahmaṇā vividiṣanti yajñena dānena tasā'nāśakena' iti śrutyuktadānādiparigrahaḥ| śarīrādītyādinā vāgindriyaparigrahaḥ| nanu śarīrādiśuddherapyapūruṣārthatayā taduddeśenāpi pravṛttidurghaṭetyata āhṛ-sākṣāditi svargādītyādinā|ṭapavargaparigrahaḥ| sākṣātsvargahetutvam, paramparayā'pavargahetutvañcetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: yajña ādi ityādinā tam eta veda anuvacanena brahmaṇā vividiṣanti yajñena dānena tasā anāśakena iti śruti ukta dāna ādi parigrahaḥ śarīra ādi ityādinā vāc indriya parigrahaḥ nanu śarīra ādi śuddheḥ api apūruṣa artha tayā tad uddeśena api pravṛtti durghaṭā iti atas āhṛ sākṣāt iti svarga ādi ityādinā aṭ apavarga parigrahaḥ sākṣāt svarga hetu tvam paramparayā apavarga hetu tvam ca iti arthaḥ

original: svaragahetutve "caikaḥ śabdaḥ" iti bhāṣyapaṭhitaśrutiḥ, paramparayā mokṣahetutve ca, 'dve brahmaṇī beditavye" iti smṛtiḥ pramāṇam| paramparāghaṭakaṃ cātmatattvajñānam "tameva viditvā" iti śrutyā tadatiriktasya sākṣānmokṣahetutvavyavacchedabodhanāditi bodhyam| uktārtha harisammatimāhṛtaduktamiti| tat-nādātmakasphoṭapratipādakaṃ śāstram|
analyzed: svaraga hetu tve ca ekaḥ śabdaḥ iti bhāṣya paṭhita śrutiḥ paramparayā mokṣa hetu tve ca dve brahmaṇī beditavye iti smṛtiḥ pramāṇam paramparā ghaṭakam ca ātma tattva jñānam tam eva viditvā iti śrutyā tad atiriktasya sākṣāt mokṣa hetu tva vyavaccheda bodhanāt iti bodhyam ukta artha hari sammatim āhṛ tat uktam iti tad nāda ātmaka sphoṭa pratipādakam śāstram

original: apavargasyeti mokṣsayetyarthaḥ| dvāramiti tadupayogītyarthaḥ| hetugarbhaviśeṣaṇamāha-vāṅmalānāmiti|
analyzed: apavargasya iti mokṣsayā iti arthaḥ dvāram iti tad upayogi iti arthaḥ hetu garbha viśeṣaṇam āha vāc malānām iti

original: cikitsitamiti apanayanārthakasannantāt kiteḥ ktapratyaye vāṅmalakarmakāpanayanasādhanaṃ yatastato mokṣadvāramityarthaḥ| panaḥ śuddhau yajñādīnāmiva vāk‌śuddhāveva tasyopayogāditi bhāvaḥ| yataḥ sarvavidyānāṃ madhye pavitramato'dhividyam vidyāsu prakarṣeṇa dīpyata ityarthaḥ. tathocoktam-"teṣāṃ ca sāmargyajuṣāṃ maharṣayo vyākaraṇaṃ nirāhuḥ" iti|
analyzed: cikitsitam iti ktapratyaye vāc mala karmaka apanayana sādhanam yatas tatas mokṣa dvāram iti arthaḥ śuddhau yajña ādīnām iva vāc śuddhau eva tasya upayogāt iti bhāvaḥ yatas sarva vidyānām madhye pavitram atodhividyam vidyāsu prakarṣeṇa dīpyate iti arthaḥ tathā ucca uktam teṣām ca sāma ṛc yajuṣām mahā ṛṣayaḥ vyākaraṇam nirāhuḥ iti

original: idamiti siddhasopānaparvaṇāṃ idaṃ prathamaṃ padasthityadhikaraṇamityarthaḥ| atra-sphoṭe' atītaviparyyāsaḥ -bhrāntiśūnya etattattvajñānavāniti yāvat| kevalām parākhyām| yogajadharmeṇa pratyakṣīkarotītyarthaḥ| tathāca yogitvāsiddho kimavaśiṣyate tattvaśiṣyate tattvajñāna ityarthaḥ taduktaṃ bhāgavate dvādaśe nādanirūpaṇāntaraṃ-
analyzed: idam iti siddha sopānaparvaṇām idam prathamam pada sthiti adhikaraṇam iti arthaḥ atra sphoṭe atīta viparyyāsaḥ bhrānti śūnyaḥ etad tattva jñānavān iti yāvat kevalām para ākhyām yoga ja dharmeṇa pratyakṣīkaroti iti arthaḥ tathā ca kim avaśiṣyate tattva śiṣyate tattva jñāne iti arthaḥ tat uktam bhāgavate dvādaśe nāda nirūpaṇa antaram

original: kiñci varṇānityatvavādināmutpadyate varṇo varṇaṃmutpādayatītyādiprayogā iṣṭhā eveti nānubhavirodho'pītyata āha-kiñceti utpattyāderityādinā `vinaṣṭo varṇaḥ' iti pratītisākṣikavināśaḥ parigṛhyate| paramparayā-svā?yadhvanivyaṅgayatvarūpayā|nātirikteti-varṇānityatvasādhiketyarthaḥ| natu sphoṭātirikteti tadarthaḥ, taiḥ sphoṭānaṅgīkārāt|

original: nanvevaṃ dhvanyutpattyādestādṛśapratītyā varṇoṣvavagāhane bhrāntatvāpattirata āha-paramparayā varṇoti svāśrayasaṃyogāvagāhinyā `lohitaḥ sphaṭikaḥ' iti pratīteryathā na bhramatvam, tathā'syā apiti bhāvaḥ| avaśiṣyate ityasyotpanno varṇa iti pratīteriti śeṣaḥ| nanu tādṛśapratīterniyamena paramparāsambanvaviṣayatvakalpane gauravamata āha-parantviti|

original: atirikteti adhiketyarthaḥ| tathācānekavarṇatad‌dhvaṃsādikalpanāpekṣayā tatpratīterniyamatastadṛsasambandhāvagāhitvakalpanaiva laghīyasīti bhāvaḥ| yadi varṇasthale dhvaninaiyatyaṃ syāt syādeva tadotpattestad‌ghaṭitaparamparāsambandhena varṇaniṣṭhatā| tatrai3va ca mānābāva ityaśaṅkaya nirācaṣṭe-nacetivarṇapārthakyena dhvanerananubhavāditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: atirikta iti adhikā iti arthaḥ tathāca aneka varṇa tad dhvaṃsa ādi kalpanā apekṣayā tad pratītyāḥ niyamataḥ laghīyasī iti bhāvaḥ yadi varṇa sthale dhvani naiyatyam syāt syāt eva tadā utpatteḥ tad ghaṭita paramparā sambandhena varṇa niṣṭha tā tatra eva ca māna abāvaḥ iti aśaṅkaya nirācaṣṭe na ca iti varṇa pārthakyena dhvaneḥ ananubhavāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: hetvasambadhānādapi tatsattvaṃ na ghaṭata ityāha-tadutpādaketi śaṅkhauṣṭhābhighātajavāyusaṃyogāderityarthaḥ| varṇānutpatteriti varṇānabhivyakterittyarthaḥ| darśanāditi dṛśirjñānasāmānyārthaḥ|

original: vastutastu ghaṭādipratyekavyaktyaikye ghaṭa iti sarvāsiddhapratītyā vyavahāreṇa ca siddhyatu ghaṭatvādeḥ pratyekamātravṛttitvam| na hyokavarṇe ghaṭapadādivyavahāro yena padatvādeḥ pratyekavṛttitā syāt kintu padaśabdaḥ padaṃ na prakāra iti vaiparītyamiti vibhāvanīyam| idaṃ purihāvadheyam|
